prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <title>Voxel Art Pagoda Garden</title>
  <style>
    body { margin: 0; }
    canvas { width: 100%; height: 100% }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
  <script>
    // Set up the scene
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // Add lighting
    const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);
    scene.add(ambientLight);
    const pointLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xffffff);
    pointLight.position.set(0, 10, 10);
    scene.add(pointLight);

    // Create the pagoda
    const pagodaGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(5, 10, 5);
    const pagodaMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xd2b48c });
    const pagoda = new THREE.Mesh(pagodaGeometry, pagodaMaterial);
    pagoda.position.set(0, 5, 0);
    scene.add(pagoda);

    // Create the garden
    const gardenGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(50, 1, 50);
    const gardenMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x008000 });
    const garden = new THREE.Mesh(gardenGeometry, gardenMaterial);
    garden.position.set(0, 0, 0);
    scene.add(garden);

    // Create the trees
    const treeGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(3, 6, 3);
    const treeMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x8b4513 });
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const tree = new THREE.Mesh(treeGeometry, treeMaterial);
      tree.position.set(Math.random() * 40 - 20, 3, Math.random() * 40 - 20);
      scene.add(tree);
    }

    // Create the cherry blossoms
    const cherryBlossomGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
    const cherryBlossomMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xff69b4 });
    for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
      const cherryBlossom = new THREE.Mesh(cherryBlossomGeometry, cherryBlossomMaterial);
      cherryBlossom.position.set(Math.random() * 40 - 20, Math.random() * 10 + 5, Math.random() * 40 - 20);
      scene.add(cherryBlossom);
    }

    // Set the camera position
    camera.position.z = 20;
    camera.position.y = 10;

    // Render the scene
    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }
    animate();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>
    <title>Voxel Art Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; }
        canvas { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
        const materials = [
            new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x8B0000 }), // Dark Red
            new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xFFD700 }), // Gold
            new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xFFC0CB }), // Pink
            new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x228B22 }), // Forest Green
            new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00BFFF })  // Deep Sky Blue
        ];

        const pagodaData = [
            { pos: [0, 0, 0], size: [6, 12, 6], mat: 0 },
            { pos: [0, 6, 0], size: [5, 1, 5], mat: 1 },
            { pos: [0, 8, 0], size: [4, 1, 4], mat: 1 },
            { pos: [0, 10, 0], size: [3, 1, 3], mat: 1 },
            { pos: [0, 12, 0], size: [1, 2, 1], mat: 1 }
        ];

        const treeData = [
            { pos: [-6, 0, -6], size: [2, 5, 2], mat: 3 },
            { pos: [-6, 5, -6], size: [4, 4, 4], mat: 2 },
            { pos: [6, 0, -6], size: [2, 4, 2], mat: 3 },
            { pos: [6, 4, -6], size: [3, 3, 3], mat: 4 },
            { pos: [-6, 0, 6], size: [2, 6, 2], mat: 3 },
            { pos: [-6, 6, 6], size: [5, 5, 5], mat: 2 },
            { pos: [6, 0, 6], size: [2, 3, 2], mat: 3 },
            { pos: [6, 3, 6], size: [4, 4, 4], mat: 4 }
        ];

        for (const voxel of pagodaData) {
            const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, materials[voxel.mat]);
            mesh.scale.set(voxel.size[0], voxel.size[1], voxel.size[2]);
            mesh.position.set(voxel.pos[0], voxel.pos[1], voxel.pos[2]);
            scene.add(mesh);
        }

        for (const tree of treeData) {
            const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, materials[tree.mat]);
            mesh.scale.set(tree.size[0], tree.size[1], tree.size[2]);
            mesh.position.set(tree.pos[0], tree.pos[1], tree.pos[2]);
            scene.add(mesh);
        }

        camera.position.set(20, 20, 20);
        camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
<script>
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

// Colors
const colors = {
    pagoda: 0x8B4513,
    roof: 0x800000,
    grass: 0x90EE90,
    trunk: 0x4A3C2A,
    cherry: 0xFFB7C5,
    stone: 0x808080
};

function createVoxel(x, y, z, color, size = 1) {
    const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
    const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color });
    const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
    voxel.position.set(x, y, z);
    scene.add(voxel);
    return voxel;
}

function createPagoda() {
    // Base floor
    for (let x = -2; x <= 2; x++) {
        for (let z = -2; z <= 2; z++) {
            createVoxel(x, 0, z, colors.pagoda);
        }
    }

    // Multiple floors
    for (let y = 1; y <= 15; y += 4) {
        const size = Math.max(5 - Math.floor(y/4), 2);
        for (let x = -size/2; x <= size/2; x++) {
            for (let z = -size/2; z <= size/2; z++) {
                createVoxel(x, y, z, colors.pagoda);
            }
        }
        // Roof
        for (let x = -(size+1)/2; x <= (size+1)/2; x++) {
            for (let z = -(size+1)/2; z <= (size+1)/2; z++) {
                createVoxel(x, y+1, z, colors.roof);
            }
        }
    }
}

function createCherryTree(x, z) {
    // Trunk
    for (let y = 0; y < 5; y++) {
        createVoxel(x, y, z, colors.trunk);
    }
    
    // Blossoms
    for (let bx = -2; bx <= 2; bx++) {
        for (let by = 5; by <= 7; by++) {
            for (let bz = -2; bz <= 2; bz++) {
                if (Math.random() > 0.3) {
                    createVoxel(x + bx, by, z + bz, colors.cherry);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

function createGarden() {
    // Ground
    for (let x = -20; x <= 20; x++) {
        for (let z = -20; z <= 20; z++) {
            createVoxel(x, -1, z, colors.grass);
        }
    }

    // Stone path
    for (let i = -15; i <= 0; i++) {
        createVoxel(i, -0.5, 0, colors.stone);
        createVoxel(i, -0.5, 1, colors.stone);
    }

    // Cherry trees
    createCherryTree(-10, -8);
    createCherryTree(-8, 8);
    createCherryTree(8, -8);
    createCherryTree(10, 8);
}

// Lighting
const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
scene.add(ambientLight);

const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
directionalLight.position.set(10, 20, 10);
scene.add(directionalLight);

// Create scene
createPagoda();
createGarden();

// Camera position
camera.position.set(20, 15, 20);
camera.lookAt(0, 5, 0);

// Animation
let rotation = 0;
function animate() {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    rotation += 0.002;
    camera.position.x = Math.cos(rotation) * 25;
    camera.position.z = Math.sin(rotation) * 25;
    camera.lookAt(0, 5, 0);
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
animate();

// Handle window resize
window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.128.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
    <script>
        let scene, camera, renderer, controls;

        function init() {
            // Scene setup
            scene = new THREE.Scene();
            camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
            renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
            renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
            document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

            // Lighting
            const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
            scene.add(ambientLight);
            
            const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
            directionalLight.position.set(10, 20, 5);
            directionalLight.castShadow = true;
            scene.add(directionalLight);

            // Ground
            const ground = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.PlaneGeometry(40, 40),
                new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: 0x88ff88 })
            );
            ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
            ground.receiveShadow = true;
            scene.add(ground);

            // Create Pagoda
            const pagoda = new THREE.Group();
            
            // Pagoda base
            const base = createVoxelStructure(6, 1, 6, 0xff4444);
            base.position.y = 0.5;
            pagoda.add(base);

            // Pagoda tiers
            const tiers = 5;
            for(let i = 0; i < tiers; i++) {
                const tier = createVoxelStructure(5 - i, 1, 5 - i, 0xffd700);
                tier.position.y = 1.5 + i * 1.2;
                pagoda.add(tier);

                const roof = createPyramidRoof(6 - i, 0x00ffff);
                roof.position.y = 2.2 + i * 1.2;
                pagoda.add(roof);
            }

            // Final spire
            const spire = createVoxelStructure(1, 3, 1, 0xffd700);
            spire.position.y = 1.5 + tiers * 1.2;
            pagoda.add(spire);

            scene.add(pagoda);

            // Create Trees
            const treePositions = [
                [-8, 0, -8], [8, 0, -8], [-8, 0, 8], [8, 0, 8],
                [-12, 0, 0], [12, 0, 0], [0, 0, -12], [0, 0, 12]
            ];

            treePositions.forEach(pos => {
                const tree = createTree();
                tree.position.set(pos[0], 0, pos[2]);
                scene.add(tree);
            });

            // Cherry Blossom Particles
            const petals = new THREE.Group();
            const petalGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.1);
            const petalMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
                color: 0xffb6c1,
                transparent: true,
                opacity: 0.8
            });

            for(let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
                const petal = new THREE.Mesh(petalGeometry, petalMaterial);
                petal.position.set(
                    Math.random() * 30 - 15,
                    Math.random() * 20 + 5,
                    Math.random() * 30 - 15
                );
                petal.castShadow = true;
                petals.add(petal);
            }
            scene.add(petals);

            // Camera and controls
            camera.position.set(20, 15, 20);
            controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
            controls.target.set(0, 5, 0);

            // Animation
            function animate() {
                requestAnimationFrame(animate);
                petals.children.forEach(petal => {
                    petal.position.y -= 0.02;
                    if(petal.position.y < -5) petal.position.y = 20;
                });
                renderer.render(scene, camera);
            }
            animate();

            window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);
        }

        function createVoxelStructure(w, h, d, color) {
            const group = new THREE.Group();
            const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: color });
            
            for(let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
                for(let z = 0; z < d; z++) {
                    for(let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
                        const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(
                            new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1),
                            material
                        );
                        voxel.position.set(x - w/2, y, z - d/2);
                        voxel.castShadow = true;
                        group.add(voxel);
                    }
                }
            }
            return group;
        }

        function createPyramidRoof(baseSize, color) {
            const group = new THREE.Group();
            const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: color });
            
            for(let level = 0; level < baseSize; level++) {
                const size = baseSize - level;
                for(let x = -size/2; x < size/2; x++) {
                    for(let z = -size/2; z < size/2; z++) {
                        const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(
                            new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1),
                            material
                        );
                        voxel.position.set(x, level * 0.6, z);
                        voxel.castShadow = true;
                        group.add(voxel);
                    }
                }
            }
            return group;
        }

        function createTree() {
            const tree = new THREE.Group();
            const trunk = createVoxelStructure(1, 3, 1, 0x8b4513);
            trunk.position.y = 1.5;
            tree.add(trunk);

            const leaves = createVoxelStructure(5, 2, 5, 0x90ee90);
            leaves.position.y = 4;
            leaves.position.x = -2;
            leaves.position.z = -2;
            tree.add(leaves);

            const blossoms = new THREE.Group();
            const blossomGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.3);
            const blossomMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: 0xff69b4 });
            
            for(let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
                const blossom = new THREE.Mesh(blossomGeo, blossomMat);
                blossom.position.set(
                    Math.random() * 4 - 2,
                    Math.random() * 3 + 2,
                    Math.random() * 4 - 2
                );
                blossoms.add(blossom);
            }
            tree.add(blossoms);

            return tree;
        }

        function onWindowResize() {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        }

        init();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <title>Colorful Voxel Pagoda Garden Scene</title>
  <style>
    body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    canvas { display: block; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.152.2/build/three.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.152.2/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
<script>
  // Scene setup
  const scene = new THREE.Scene();
  scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB); // Sky blue background

  // Camera setup
  const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
    45, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000
  );
  camera.position.set(30, 30, 30);
  camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

  // Renderer setup
  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

  // Controls
  const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
  controls.target.set(0, 5, 0);
  controls.update();

  // Helper function to create a voxel cube
  function createVoxel(color, size = 1) {
    const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
    const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color });
    return new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  }

  // Create ground plane
  const groundGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(60, 60);
  const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x228B22 });
  const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);
  ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
  scene.add(ground);

  // Add ambient and directional lights
  const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
  scene.add(ambientLight);

  const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
  dirLight.position.set(20, 40, 20);
  scene.add(dirLight);

  // Function to create a stylized cherry blossom tree
  function createCherryTree(posX, posZ) {
    const trunkColor = 0x8B4513; // Brown
    const blossomColor = 0xFF69B4; // Pink
    const leavesColor = 0x00FF7F; // Spring green

    // Trunk
    const trunkHeight = 4;
    for (let i = 0; i < trunkHeight; i++) {
      const trunk = createVoxel(trunkColor);
      trunk.position.set(posX, i + 0.5, posZ);
      scene.add(trunk);
    }

    // Foliage (cherry blossoms)
    const blossomRadius = 3;
    for (let x = -blossomRadius; x <= blossomRadius; x++) {
      for (let y = -blossomRadius; y <= blossomRadius; y++) {
        for (let z = -blossomRadius; z <= blossomRadius; z++) {
          const dist = Math.sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z);
          if (dist <= blossomRadius) {
            const blossom = createVoxel(blossomColor);
            blossom.position.set(posX + x, trunkHeight + y, posZ + z);
            scene.add(blossom);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Create multiple cherry blossom trees
  createCherryTree(-15, -15);
  createCherryTree(15, -15);
  createCherryTree(-15, 15);
  createCherryTree(15, 15);
  createCherryTree(0, -20);
  createCherryTree(0, 20);

  // Function to create a pagoda
  function createPagoda() {
    const baseColor = 0x8B0000; // Dark red
    const roofColor = 0xFF8C00; // Dark orange
    const accentColor = 0xFFD700; // Gold

    // Base platform
    const baseSize = 8;
    for (let x = -baseSize/2; x <= baseSize/2; x++) {
      for (let z = -baseSize/2; z <= baseSize/2; z++) {
        const block = createVoxel(0x8B0000);
        block.position.set(x, 0.5, z);
        scene.add(block);
      }
    }

    // Main tower - multi-tiered
    const tiers = [
      { size: 6, height: 2, yOffset: 1 },
      { size: 4, height: 2, yOffset: 3 },
      { size: 2, height: 2, yOffset: 5 },
    ];
    tiers.forEach((tier, index) => {
      const yBase = tier.yOffset;
      for (let x = -tier.size/2; x <= tier.size/2; x++) {
        for (let z = -tier.size/2; z <= tier.size/2; z++) {
          const block = createVoxel(baseColor);
          block.position.set(x, yBase + 0.5, z);
          scene.add(block);
        }
      }
    });

    // Roof (multi-tiered)
    tiers.forEach((tier, index) => {
      const size = tier.size + 2;
      const yBase = tier.yOffset + tier.height;
      for (let x = -size/2; x <= size/2; x++) {
        for (let z = -size/2; z <= size/2; z++) {
          // Create cone-like effect with color variation
          if (Math.abs(x) + Math.abs(z) <= size/2) {
            const roofBlock = createVoxel(roofColor);
            roofBlock.position.set(x, yBase + 0.5, z);
            scene.add(roofBlock);
          }
        }
      }
    });

    // Top ornament (a small golden sphere)
    const topSphere = createVoxel(accentColor);
    topSphere.scale.set(0.5, 0.5, 0.5);
    topSphere.position.set(0, tiers[tiers.length -1].yOffset + tiers[tiers.length -1].height + 0.5, 0);
    scene.add(topSphere);
  }

  // Create the pagoda at center
  createPagoda();

  // Add decorative lanterns hanging from the pagoda
  function addLanterns() {
    const lanternColor = 0xFFA500; // Orange
    const lanternPositions = [
      { x: 0, y: 7, z: 0 },
      { x: 2, y: 5, z: 2 },
      { x: -2, y: 5, z: -2 }
    ];
    lanternPositions.forEach(pos => {
      const lantern = createVoxel(lanternColor);
      lantern.scale.set(0.3, 0.3, 0.3);
      lantern.position.set(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z);
      scene.add(lantern);
    });
  }
  addLanterns();

  // Animate scene
  function animate() {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
  }
  animate();

  // Handle window resize
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  });
</script>
</body>
</html>

<body>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Set up the scene, camera, and renderer
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Add lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
        directionalLight.position.set(1, 1, 1).normalize();
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Function to create a voxel cube
        function createVoxel(position, color) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
            const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: color });
            const cube = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            cube.position.set(position.x, position.y, position.z);
            return cube;
        }

        // Create the pagoda
        function createPagoda() {
            const pagodaColors = [0x8B0000, 0xFF4500, 0xFFD700];
            const pagodaHeight = 5;
            for (let i = 0; i < pagodaHeight; i++) {
                const level = createVoxel({ x: 0, y: i, z: 0 }, pagodaColors[i % pagodaColors.length]);
                level.scale.set(3 - i, 0.5, 3 - i); // Taper the levels
                scene.add(level);
            }
        }

        // Create cherry blossom trees
        function createCherryBlossomTree(position) {
            const trunk = createVoxel({ x: position.x, y: position.y, z: position.z }, 0x8B4513);
            trunk.scale.set(0.2, 1, 0.2);
            scene.add(trunk);

            const blossomColors = [0xFFB6C1, 0xFF69B4];
            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                const blossom = createVoxel({ x: position.x + (Math.random() - 0.5), y: position.y + 1 + Math.random(), z: position.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) }, blossomColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * blossomColors.length)]);
                blossom.scale.set(0.5, 0.5, 0.5);
                scene.add(blossom);
            }
        }

        // Create a garden with cherry blossoms and trees
        function createGarden() {
            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                const x = Math.random() * 20 - 10;
                const z = Math.random() * 20 - 10;
                createCherryBlossomTree({ x: x, y: 0, z: z });
            }
        }

        // Initialize the scene
        createPagoda();
        createGarden();

        // Set camera position
        camera.position.z = 10;

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden Scene</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
        directionalLight.position.set(10, 20, 10);
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Helper function to create a voxel (cube)
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, color, size = 1) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
            const material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color });
            const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            voxel.position.set(x, y, z);
            scene.add(voxel);
            return voxel;
        }

        // Ground (Garden Base)
        const groundSize = 30;
        for (let x = -groundSize; x < groundSize; x++) {
            for (let z = -groundSize; z < groundSize; z++) {
                createVoxel(x, 0, z, 0x4ca64c); // Green grass
            }
        }

        // Stone Path to Pagoda
        for (let x = -5; x <= 5; x++) {
            for (let z = -groundSize + 5; z <= -10; z++) {
                createVoxel(x, 0.1, z, 0x808080); // Gray stone path
            }
        }

        // Pagoda Construction
        function buildPagodaTier(xCenter, yBase, zCenter, width, height, color) {
            for (let x = xCenter - width / 2; x < xCenter + width / 2; x++) {
                for (let y = yBase; y < yBase + height; y++) {
                    for (let z = zCenter - width / 2; z < zCenter + width / 2; z++) {
                        if (y === yBase || y === yBase + height - 1 || 
                            x === xCenter - width / 2 || x === xCenter + width / 2 - 1 ||
                            z === zCenter - width / 2 || z === zCenter + width / 2 - 1) {
                            createVoxel(x, y, z, color);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // Build a 3-tier pagoda
        buildPagodaTier(0, 1, 0, 10, 5, 0x8b0000); // Base tier (dark red)
        buildPagodaTier(0, 6, 0, 8, 4, 0x8b0000);  // Middle tier
        buildPagodaTier(0, 10, 0, 6, 3, 0x8b0000); // Top tier
        // Roof details with gold accents
        for (let x = -6; x <= 6; x++) {
            createVoxel(x, 5, -6, 0xdaa520); // Gold edge base tier
            createVoxel(x, 5, 6, 0xdaa520);
        }
        for (let x = -5; x <= 5; x++) {
            createVoxel(x, 9, -5, 0xdaa520); // Gold edge middle tier
            createVoxel(x, 9, 5, 0xdaa520);
        }
        for (let x = -4; x <= 4; x++) {
            createVoxel(x, 12, -4, 0xdaa520); // Gold edge top tier
            createVoxel(x, 12, 4, 0xdaa520);
        }

        // Trees and Cherry Blossoms
        function createTree(x, y, z, trunkHeight, canopySize, trunkColor, leafColor, blossomColor) {
            // Trunk
            for (let h = 0; h < trunkHeight; h++) {
                createVoxel(x, y + h, z, trunkColor);
            }
            // Canopy
            for (let cx = -canopySize; cx <= canopySize; cx++) {
                for (let cy = -canopySize; cy <= canopySize; cy++) {
                    for (let cz = -canopySize; cz <= canopySize; cz++) {
                        if (Math.random() > 0.3) {
                            createVoxel(x + cx, y + trunkHeight + cy, z + cz, leafColor);
                        } else if (Math.random() > 0.7) {
                            createVoxel(x + cx, y + trunkHeight + cy, z + cz, blossomColor); // Cherry blossoms
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        createTree(-15, 1, -15, 5, 3, 0x4a2f10, 0x2d5a27, 0xffb6c1); // Tree 1 with blossoms
        createTree(15, 1, -15, 4, 2, 0x4a2f10, 0x2d5a27, 0xffb6c1);  // Tree 2 with blossoms
        createTree(-10, 1, 15, 6, 3, 0x4a2f10, 0x2d5a27, 0xffb6c1);  // Tree 3 with blossoms
        createTree(10, 1, 15, 5, 2, 0x4a2f10, 0x2d5a27, 0xffb6c1);   // Tree 4 with blossoms

        // Garden Details (Bushes and Flowers)
        function createBush(x, y, z, size, color) {
            for (let bx = -size; bx <= size; bx++) {
                for (let by = 0; by <= size; by++) {
                    for (let bz = -size; bz <= size; bz++) {
                        if (Math.random() > 0.4) {
                            createVoxel(x + bx, y + by, z + bz, color);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        createBush(-8, 1, -8, 1, 0x2d5a27); // Bush 1
        createBush(8, 1, -8, 1, 0x2d5a27);  // Bush 2
        // Flowers
        function createFlower(x, y, z, color) {
            createVoxel(x, y, z, 0x2d5a27); // Stem
            createVoxel(x, y + 1, z, color); // Flower head
        }
        createFlower(-10, 1, -10, 0xff4500); // Orange flower
        createFlower(10, 1, -10, 0xffff00);  // Yellow flower
        createFlower(-12, 1, -12, 0xff69b4); // Pink flower
        createFlower(12, 1, -12, 0x800080);  // Purple flower

        // Water Pond
        for (let x = -20; x <= -15; x++) {
            for (let z = 5; z <= 10; z++) {
                createVoxel(x, 0.2, z, 0x1e90ff); // Blue water
            }
        }
        // Lily Pads
        createVoxel(-18, 0.3, 7, 0x2d5a27);
        createVoxel(-17, 0.3, 9, 0x2d5a27);

        // Camera position
        camera.position.set(20, 15, 25);
        camera.lookAt(0, 5, 0);

        // Skybox (Simple gradient background)
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87ceeb); // Light blue sky

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            // Simple rotation for viewing the scene
            camera.position.x = 20 * Math.cos(Date.now() * 0.001);
            camera.position.z = 25 * Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.001);
            camera.lookAt(0, 5, 0);
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

</head>
<body>
    <script>
        // Set up the scene
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(0, 10, 30);  // Position camera for a good overview
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
        
        const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;
        controls.screenSpacePanning = false;
        controls.minDistance = 10;
        controls.maxDistance = 50;
        
        // Add lights for a vibrant, colorful look
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);  // Soft white ambient light
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);  // Brighter directional light
        directionalLight.position.set(5, 10, 7.5);  // Position for dynamic shadows and highlights
        scene.add(directionalLight);
        
        // Helper function to create a voxel (1x1x1 cube)
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
            const material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: color });
            const cube = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            cube.position.set(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5);  // Offset for grid alignment
            scene.add(cube);
            return cube;
        }
        
        // Create the garden ground with varied green shades for a natural look
        for (let x = -30; x <= 30; x++) {
            for (let z = -30; z <= 30; z++) {
                const grassColor = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 0x228B22 : 0x006400;  // Forest green or dark green
                createVoxel(x, 0, z, grassColor);  // Base layer for grass
            }
        }
        
        // Add paths around the pagoda for variety
        for (let x = -5; x <= 5; x++) {
            for (let z = -5; z <= 5; z += 2) {
                createVoxel(x, 0.1, z, 0xDEB887);  // Burlywood for paths
            }
        }
        
        // Build the elaborate pagoda: A 5-tier structure with colorful roofs and details
        const pagodaBaseX = 0;  // Center the pagoda
        const pagodaBaseZ = 0;
        
        // Base platform with stone-like voxels
        for (let x = -4; x <= 4; x++) {
            for (let z = -4; z <= 4; z++) {
                createVoxel(pagodaBaseX + x, 1, pagodaBaseZ + z, 0x808080);  // Gray stone
            }
        }
        
        // First tier: Walls and supports
        for (let y = 2; y <= 4; y++) {
            for (let x = -3; x <= 3; x++) {
                for (let z = -3; z <= 3; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x) === 3 || Math.abs(z) === 3) {  // Only edges for walls
                        createVoxel(pagodaBaseX + x, y, pagodaBaseZ + z, 0xA0522D);  // Sienna for wood
                    }
                }
            }
            // Add decorative elements on tier edges
            createVoxel(pagodaBaseX - 3.5, y, pagodaBaseZ, 0xFF4500);  // Orange red accents
            createVoxel(pagodaBaseX + 3.5, y, pagodaBaseZ, 0xFF4500);
        }
        
        // Second tier: Smaller and elevated
        for (let y = 5; y <= 7; y++) {
            for (let x = -2; x <= 2; x++) {
                for (let z = -2; z <= 2; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x) === 2 || Math.abs(z) === 2) {
                        createVoxel(pagodaBaseX + x, y, pagodaBaseZ + z, 0xCD853F);  // Peru for varied wood tone
                    }
                }
            }
            // Curved roof approximation with colorful voxels
            for (let x = -2.5; x <= 2.5; x += 0.5) {
                createVoxel(pagodaBaseX + x, y + 1, pagodaBaseZ - 2.5, 0xDC143C);  // Crimson for roof edge
                createVoxel(pagodaBaseX + x, y + 1, pagodaBaseZ + 2.5, 0xDC143C);

            for (let z = -1.5; z <= 1.5; z += 0.5) {

                createVoxel(pagodaBaseX + 2.5, y + 1, pagodaBaseZ + z, 0xDC143C);

        for (let y = 8; y <= 10; y++) {

                for (let z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {

                        createVoxel(pagodaBaseX + x, y, pagodaBaseZ + z, 0xF4A460);  // Sandy brown
                    }
                }

            for (let x = -1.5; x <= 1.5; x += 0.5) {
                createVoxel(pagodaBaseX + x, y + 1, pagodaBaseZ - 1.5, 0xFFD700);  // Gold
                createVoxel(pagodaBaseX + x, y + 1, pagodaBaseZ + 1.5, 0xFFD700);

            for (let z = -0.5; z <= 0.5; z += 0.5) {
                createVoxel(pagodaBaseX - 1.5, y + 1, pagodaBaseZ + z, 0xFFD700);
                createVoxel(pagodaBaseX + 1.5, y + 1, pagodaBaseZ + z, 0xFFD700);

        for (let y = 11; y <= 13; y++) {
            createVoxel(pagodaBaseX, y, pagodaBaseZ, 0x4B0082);  // Indigo for spire
        }
        
        // Add trees with cherry blossoms
        function createTree(x, z) {
            // Trunk with brown voxels
            for (let y = 1; y <= 4; y++) {

            // Foliage with green and pink cherry blossoms for variety
            for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {

                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Extra cherry blossoms floating around for a dynamic feel
            for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {

                const blossomZ = z + (Math.random() * 4 - 2);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
      body {
        margin: 0;
        background-color: #f0f0f0;
      }
      #canvas {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100vh;
        display: block;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script>
      const scene = new THREE.Scene();
      const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
      const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
        canvas: document.getElementById('canvas'),
        antialias: true
      });

      // Voxel Data
      const voxelData = {
        size: 100,
        data: []
      };

      // Generate Voxel Data
      for (let x = 0; x < voxelData.size; x++) {
        for (let y = 0; y < voxelData.size; y++) {
          for (let z = 0; z < voxelData.size; z++) {
            let voxel = null;

            // Pagoda
            if (x >= 40 && x <= 60 && y >= 30 && y <= 50 && z >= 20 && z <= 40) {
              voxel = {
                color: 0xffc080, // Wooden color
                opacity: 1
              };
            }

            // Cherry Blossom Trees
            if (x >= 20 && x <= 30 && y >= 10 && y <= 20 && z >= 10 && z <= 20) {
              voxel = {
                color: 0xff69b4, // Pink color
                opacity: 0.5
              };
            }
            if (x >= 70 && x <= 80 && y >= 10 && y <= 20 && z >= 10 && z <= 20) {
              voxel = {
                color: 0xff69b4, // Pink color
                opacity: 0.5
              };
            }

            // Greenery
            if (x >= 10 && x <= 90 && y >= 10 && y <= 30 && z >= 10 && z <= 30) {
              voxel = {
                color: 0x34c759, // Green color
                opacity: 0.3
              };
            }

            // Pathway
            if (x >= 30 && x <= 70 && y >= 0 && y <= 10 && z >= 20 && z <= 40) {
              voxel = {
                color: 0xffffff, // White color
                opacity: 0.5
              };
            }

            voxelData.data.push(voxel);
          }
        }
      }

      // Create Voxel Mesh
      const voxelMesh = new THREE.Mesh();
      voxelMesh.geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      const voxelPositions = [];
      const voxelColors = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < voxelData.data.length; i++) {
        const voxel = voxelData.data[i];
        if (voxel) {
          voxelPositions.push(i % voxelData.size, Math.floor(i / voxelData.size) % voxelData.size, Math.floor(i / voxelData.size / voxelData.size));
          voxelColors.push(voxel.color, voxel.opacity);
        }
      }

      voxelMesh.geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(voxelPositions, 3));
      voxelMesh.geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(voxelColors, 4));
      voxelMesh.material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        vertexColors: true,
        transparent: true
      });

      scene.add(voxelMesh);

      // Camera Position
      camera.position.z = 50;

      // Render Loop
      function animate() {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
      }

      animate();
    </script>
  </body>

<!DOCTYPE html>

        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
<script>
    // Basic scene setup
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB); // Sky blue

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    camera.position.set(10, 15, 20);

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // Create the pagoda
    function createPagoda() {
        const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 2, 2);
        const pagoda = new THREE.Group();
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            const material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xFFC080 - i * 0x101010 });
            const level = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            level.scale.set(1 + i * 0.2, 0.5 + i * 0.1, 1 + i * 0.2);
            level.position.set(0, i * 1.5, 0);
            pagoda.add(level);
        }
        pagoda.position.set(0, 2, 0);
        scene.add(pagoda);
    }

    // Function to create a voxel tree
    function createTree(position, isCherryBlossom = false) {
        const tree = new THREE.Group();
        const trunkGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 2, 1);
        const trunkMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x964B00 });
        const trunk = new THREE.Mesh(trunkGeometry, trunkMaterial);
        trunk.position.set(position.x, position.y + 1, position.z);
        tree.add(trunk);

        const foliageGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(3, 3, 3);
        const foliageMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ 
            color: isCherryBlossom ? 0xFFC5C5 : 0x00FF00 
        });
        const foliage = new THREE.Mesh(foliageGeometry, foliageMaterial);
        foliage.position.set(position.x, position.y + 4, position.z);
        tree.add(foliage);

        scene.add(tree);
    }

    // Create garden elements
    createPagoda();
    for (let i = -5; i <= 5; i++) {
        for (let j = -5; j <= 5; j++) {
            if (Math.random() < 0.2) {
                const isCherryBlossom = Math.random() < 0.3;
                createTree(new THREE.Vector3(i * 2, 0, j * 2), isCherryBlossom);
            }
        }
    }

    // Animation loop
    function animate() {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        camera.rotation.y += 0.001;
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    animate();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
  <style>
    body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    canvas { display: block; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/three@0.150.1/build/three.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/three@0.150.1/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
  <script>
    // scene setup
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87ceeb);
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, innerWidth/innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    camera.position.set(30, 20, 30);
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias: true});
    renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
    const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
    controls.target.set(0,5,0);

    // lights
    const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x444444, 1.2);
    hemi.position.set(0, 50, 0);
    scene.add(hemi);
    const dir = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
    dir.position.set(-30, 50, -30);
    scene.add(dir);

    // unit cube geometry for voxels
    const cubeGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1);

    function addVoxel(x, y, z, hex) {
      const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: hex });
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(cubeGeo, mat);
      mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
      scene.add(mesh);
    }

    // ground (30×30)
    const size = 30;
    for(let i= -size/2; i < size/2; i++) {
      for(let j= -size/2; j < size/2; j++) {
        const variation = Math.random() * 0.1;
        addVoxel(i, 0, j, new THREE.Color(0x228B22).offsetHSL(0, 0, variation));
      }
    }

    // pagoda base
    const P = {
      baseSize: 7,
      floors: 3,
      roofOffsets: [0,1,2]
    };
    // platform
    for(let x= -P.baseSize; x<=P.baseSize; x++) {
      for(let z= -P.baseSize; z<=P.baseSize; z++) {
        addVoxel(x, 1, z, 0x8B4513);
      }
    }
    // walls
    for(let y=2; y<5; y++) {
      for(let x= -3; x<=3; x++) {
        for(let z= -3; z<=3; z++) {
          if(Math.abs(x)==3 || Math.abs(z)==3) addVoxel(x, y, z, 0xdeb887);
        }
      }
    }
    // tiered roofs
    const roofColors = [0x8B0000, 0xB22222, 0xCD5C5C];
    for(let t=0; t<3; t++) {
      const h = 5 + t*2;
      const s = 7 - t*2;
      for(let x= -s; x<=s; x++) {
        for(let z= -s; z<=s; z++) {
          if(Math.abs(x)<=s - t && Math.abs(z)<=s - t) {
            const y = h - Math.abs(x)%2*0.2 - Math.abs(z)%2*0.2;
            addVoxel(x, y, z, roofColors[t]);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    // spire
    for(let y=11; y<15; y++) addVoxel(0, y, 0, 0xDAA520);

    // trees
    function addTree(x,z, trunkHeight, foliageColor, bloom=false) {
      for(let y=1; y<=trunkHeight; y++) addVoxel(x, y, z, 0x8B4513);
      const foliageStart = trunkHeight + 1;
      for(let dx=-2; dx<=2; dx++) for(let dy=0; dy<=2; dy++) for(let dz=-2; dz<=2; dz++) {
        const d = Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy)+Math.abs(dz);
        if(d<4) {
          const col = bloom && Math.random()<0.3 ? 0xFFC0CB : foliageColor;
          addVoxel(x+dx, foliageStart+dy, z+dz, col);
        }
      }
    }
    addTree(-10,-8, 4, 0x006400);
    addTree(12,-5, 3, 0x006400, true);
    addTree(-7,12, 5, 0x006400, true);

    // animate
    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      controls.update();
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }
    animate();

    // handle resize
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      camera.aspect = innerWidth/innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
    });
  </script>
</body>

        const groundGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100)
        const groundMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ 
            color: 0x80c040, 
            vertexColors: true 
        })
        const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeo, groundMat)
        ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2
        scene.add(ground)

        // Pagoda base
        const base = new THREE.Mesh(
            new THREE.BoxGeometry(8, 2, 8),
            new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x663300 })
        )
        base.position.y = 1
        scene.add(base)

        // Pagoda tiers
        const tiers = [6,5,4,3,2].map((size,i) => {
            const tier = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, 2, size),
                new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                    color: i%2 ? 0xffa500 : 0xcc9977
                })
            )
            tier.position.y = 2 + 2*i + 1
            return tier
        })
        tiers.forEach(t => scene.add(t))

        // Pagoda roof
        const roof = new THREE.Mesh(
            new THREE.ConeGeometry(6.5, 3, 4),
            new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffd700 })
        )
        roof.rotation.x = Math.PI/2
        roof.position.y = 18
        scene.add(roof)

        // Cherry trees
        const treeCount = 20
        for(let i=0; i<treeCount; i++) {
            const trunk = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.5, 0.5, 5, 4),
                new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8B4513 })
            )
            trunk.position.set(
                Math.random()*20-10, 
                2.5, 
                Math.random()*20-10
            )
            const canopy = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.SphereGeometry(3, 8, 8),
                new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ 
                    color: 0xFF69B4,
                    transparent: true,
                    opacity: 0.8
                })
            )
            canopy.position.y = 5
            trunk.add(canopy)
            scene.add(trunk)
        }

        // Cherry blossoms
        const particles = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
        const particleCount = 1000
        const positions = new Float32Array(particleCount * 3)
        const colors = new Float32Array(particleCount * 3)
        for(let i=0; i<particleCount; i++) {
            positions[i*3] = Math.random()*20-10
            positions[i*3+1] = Math.random()*20
            positions[i*3+2] = Math.random()*20-10
            colors[i*3] = Math.random()*0.5 + 0.5
            colors[i*3+1] = Math.random()*0.5 + 0.5
            colors[i*3+2] = Math.random()*0.2
        }
        particles.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
        particles.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3))
        const pMaterial = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
            size: 0.3,
            sizeAttenuation: true,
            vertexColors: true,
            opacity: 0.8,
            transparent: true
        })
        const blossoms = new THREE.Points(particles, pMaterial)
        scene.add(blossoms)

        // Lighting
        const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1)
        light.position.set(30,50,30)
        scene.add(light)
        scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040))

        // Render function
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate)
            controls.update()
            renderer.render(scene, camera)
        }
        animate()

        // Window resize handling
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix()
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight)
        })
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden – Three.js</title>
    <style>
        body { margin:0; overflow:hidden; background:#87ceeb; }
        canvas { display:block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
    import * as THREE from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.163.0/build/three.module.js';
    import { OrbitControls } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.163.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1️⃣ Setup renderer, scene, camera, controls
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, innerWidth / innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    camera.position.set(30, 30, 60);
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
    controls.enableDamping = true;
    controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2️⃣ Helpers – a simple voxel function
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    const voxelSize = 1;
    const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(voxelSize, voxelSize, voxelSize);

    // Cache materials by color for reuse
    const materialCache = {};

    function getMaterial(hex) {
        if (!materialCache[hex]) {
            materialCache[hex] = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color: hex});
        }
        return materialCache[hex];
    }

    function addVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, getMaterial(color));
        mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
        scene.add(mesh);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3️⃣ Build the ground (grass)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    const groundSize = 50;
    for (let x = -groundSize/2; x < groundSize/2; x++) {
        for (let z = -groundSize/2; z < groundSize/2; z++) {
            // 80% grass, 20% light green for variation
            const col = Math.random() < 0.2 ? 0x88cc88 : 0x2ecc71;
            addVoxel(x, -0.5, z, col);
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4️⃣ Pagoda – 5 stacked blocks with curved roofs
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    const pagodaBaseX = 0;
    const pagodaBaseZ = 0;
    const pagodaHeight = 12; // total height in voxels

    // Colors
    const roofColor = 0xe74c3c; // red
    const wallColor = 0xf1c40f; // golden
    const floorColor = 0xecf0f1; // light

    // Build levels
    for (let level = 0; level < 5; level++) {
        const levelHeight = level * 2; // each level 2 voxels high
        const size = 10 - level * 2; // decreasing size
        const y = levelHeight;
        const half = size / 2;

        // Walls
        for (let x = -half; x < half; x++) {
            for (let z = -half; z < half; z++) {
                // Outer ring walls
                if (Math.abs(x) === half-1 || Math.abs(z) === half-1) {
                    for (let h = 0; h < 2; h++) {
                        addVoxel(pagodaBaseX + x, y + h, pagodaBaseZ + z, wallColor);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Roof – a simple sloped roof made of triangles (approximated with voxels)
        const roofY = y + 2;
        const roofRadius = half + 1;
        for (let x = -roofRadius; x <= roofRadius; x++) {
            for (let z = -roofRadius; z <= roofRadius; z++) {
                const dist = Math.max(Math.abs(x), Math.abs(z));
                const h = Math.max(0, roofRadius - dist);
                // Fill roof voxels
                for (let k = 0; k <= h; k++) {
                    const color = (k === h) ? roofColor : wallColor;
                    addVoxel(pagodaBaseX + x, roofY + k, pagodaBaseZ + z, color);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 🌳  Trees – simple trunk + leaf canopy
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    function addTree(x, z) {
        // trunk
        const trunkHeight = 5 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
        for (let y = 0; y < trunkHeight; y++) {
            addVoxel(x, y, z, 0x8b5a2b);
        }
        // canopy (green voxels)
        const canopyRadius = 4;
        const topY = trunkHeight;
        for (let dx = -canopyRadius; dx <= canopyRadius; dx++) {
            for (let dz = -canopyRadius; dz <= canopyRadius; dz++) {
                const distance = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz);
                const h = Math.floor(Math.sqrt(canopyRadius*canopyRadius - distance*distance));
                if (h > 0) {
                    for (let dy = 0; dy < h; dy++) {
                        const hue = (Math.random() * 0.1 + 0.33).toString(16).substring(0,4);
                        const col = 0x2ecc71; // leaf green
                        addVoxel(x + dx, topY + dy, z + dz, col);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Randomly place 12 trees around the pagoda
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
        const x = Math.floor(Math.random() * 30 - 15);
        const z = Math.floor(Math.random() * 30 - 15);
        // avoid placing inside the pagoda area
        if (Math.abs(x) < 12 && Math.abs(z) < 12) continue;
        addTree(x, z);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 🌸 Cherry blossoms – pink particles floating above
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    const blossomCount = 200;
    const blossomMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color: 0xffc0cb});
    const blossomGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.2, 6, 6);
    const blossomGroup = new THREE.Group();

    for (let i = 0; i < blossomCount; i++) {
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(blossomGeometry, blossomMaterial);
        const x = Math.random() * 30 - 15;
        const y = Math.random() * 6 + 5;
        const z = Math.random() * 30 - 15;
        mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
        blossomGroup.add(mesh);
    }
    scene.add(blossomGroup);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 🌞 Lighting & sky
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
    scene.add(ambient);

    const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.0);
    sun.position.set(30, 50, -30);
    scene.add(sun);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 🎞️ Animation loop (animate blossoms)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    function animate() {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        controls.update();

        // tiny floating motion for blossoms
        const time = Date.now() * 0.001;
        blossomGroup.children.forEach((p, i) => {
            p.position.y += Math.sin(time + i) * 0.001;
        });

        renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }
    animate();

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 📐 Resize handling
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
        const w = innerWidth, h = innerHeight;
        renderer.setSize(w, h);
        camera.aspect = w / h;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    });
</script>
</body>
</html>

prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
<style>
  body {margin:0; overflow:hidden;}
  canvas {display:block;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.154.0/build/three.module.js';
import { OrbitControls } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.154.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';

/* ---------- Basic Scene Setup ---------- */
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87ceeb); // light blue sky

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
camera.position.set(30, 30, 40);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.dampingFactor = 0.1;

/* ---------- Lighting ---------- */
const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
dirLight.position.set(10, 20, 10);
scene.add(dirLight);

const ambLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040, 0.5);
scene.add(ambLight);

/* ---------- Utility Functions ---------- */
const voxelSize = 1;
const voxelGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(voxelSize, voxelSize, voxelSize);

function createVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
  const material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color});
  const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(voxelGeometry, material);
  voxel.position.set(x, y, z);
  scene.add(voxel);
}

/* ---------- Ground ---------- */
const groundSize = 40;
for (let i = -groundSize/2; i < groundSize/2; i++) {
  for (let j = -groundSize/2; j < groundSize/2; j++) {
    createVoxel(i, 0, j, 0x228B22); // forest green
  }
}

/* ---------- Pagoda ---------- */
function buildPagoda(baseX, baseY, baseZ, baseSize, levels) {
  const woodColor = 0x8B4513; // saddle brown
  const roofColor = 0xB22222; // firebrick
  const spireColor = 0xFFD700; // gold

  // Build tiers
  for (let lvl = 0; lvl < levels; lvl++) {
    const tierSize = baseSize - lvl*2;
    const y = baseY + lvl;
    const half = tierSize/2 - 0.5;
    for (let i = -half; i <= half; i++) {
      for (let j = -half; j <= half; j++) {
        // Leave center hollow for spire
        if (Math.abs(i) < tierSize/4 && Math.abs(j) < tierSize/4 && lvl === levels-1) continue;
        createVoxel(baseX + i, y, baseZ + j, woodColor);
      }
    }
  }

  // Build roof
  const roofY = baseY + levels;
  const roofHalf = baseSize/2 - 0.5;
  for (let i = -roofHalf; i <= roofHalf; i++) {
    for (let j = -roofHalf; j <= roofHalf; j++) {
      createVoxel(baseX + i, roofY, baseZ + j, roofColor);
    }
  }

  // Build spire
  const spireY = roofY + 3;
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
    createVoxel(baseX, spireY + k, baseZ, spireColor);
  }
}

buildPagoda(0, 1, 0, 10, 5);

/* ---------- Trees ---------- */
function buildTree(x, z, height) {
  const trunkColor = 0x8B4513;
  const foliageColor = 0x006400; // dark green
  // Trunk
  for (let y = 1; y <= height; y++) {
    createVoxel(x, y, z, trunkColor);
  }
  // Foliage
  const foliageStart = height + 1;
  for (let y = foliageStart; y < foliageStart + 4; y++) {
    const radius = Math.abs(y - foliageStart) < 2 ? 2 : 1;
    for (let i = -radius; i <= radius; i++) {
      for (let j = -radius; j <= radius; j++) {
        if (i*i + j*j <= radius*radius) {
          createVoxel(x + i, y, z + j, foliageColor);
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

// Randomly scatter trees
for (let i = -15; i <= 15; i += 8) {
  for (let j = -15; j <= 15; j += 8) {
    if (Math.random() > 0.3) continue; // skip some spots
    buildTree(i, j, 5 + Math.floor(Math.random()*3));
  }
}

/* ---------- Cherry Blossoms ---------- */
function addCherryBlossom(x, y, z) {
  const colors = [0xFFB7C5, 0xFFC0CB, 0xFFF0F5]; // pink hues
  createVoxel(x, y, z, colors[Math.floor(Math.random()*colors.length)]);
}

function scatterBlossoms() {
  const blossomCount = 200;
  for (let i = 0; i < blossomCount; i++) {
    const x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
    const z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
    const y = Math.floor(Math.random() * 8) + 2;
    addCherryBlossom(x, y, z);
  }
}

scatterBlossoms();

/* ---------- Animation ---------- */
function animate() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  controls.update();
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
animate();

/* ---------- Handle Resize ---------- */
window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
  camera.aspect = window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
});
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #87CEEB; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040, 0.6);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        directionalLight.position.set(-10, 20, 10);
        directionalLight.castShadow = true;
        directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 2048;
        directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 2048;
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Voxel Materials
        const materials = {
            grass: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x228B22 }),
            wood: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x8B4513 }),
            roof: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xDC143C }),
            stone: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x696969 }),
            leaf: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x32CD32 }),
            blossom: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xFFB6C1 }),
            water: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x4682B4, transparent: true, opacity: 0.7 }),
            flower: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xFFD700 })
        };

        // Voxel Function
        function addVoxel(x, y, z, material) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
            const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
            mesh.castShadow = true;
            mesh.receiveShadow = true;
            scene.add(mesh);
        }

        // Ground
        for (let x = -50; x <= 50; x++) {
            for (let z = -50; z <= 50; z++) {
                addVoxel(x, 0, z, materials.grass);
            }
        }

        // Pond
        for (let x = 20; x <= 30; x++) {
            for (let z = 20; z <= 30; z++) {
                addVoxel(x, 0.5, z, materials.water);
            }
        }

        // Pagoda Base
        const pagodaX = 0;
        const pagodaZ = 0;
        for (let y = 1; y <= 20; y++) {
            for (let x = pagodaX - 4; x <= pagodaX + 4; x++) {
                for (let z = pagodaZ - 4; z <= pagodaZ + 4; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x - pagodaX) <= 3 && Math.abs(z - pagodaZ) <= 3) {
                        addVoxel(x, y, z, materials.stone);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Pagoda Pillars
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const px = [pagodaX - 3, pagodaX + 3, pagodaX - 3, pagodaX + 3][i];
            const pz = [pagodaZ - 3, pagodaZ - 3, pagodaZ + 3, pagodaZ + 3][i];
            for (let y = 1; y <= 19; y++) {
                addVoxel(px, y, pz, materials.wood);
            }
        }

        // Pagoda Roofs (Multi-tiered)
        function addRoof(level, height, size) {
            for (let x = pagodaX - size; x <= pagodaX + size; x++) {
                for (let z = pagodaZ - size; z <= pagodaZ + size; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x - pagodaX) + Math.abs(z - pagodaZ) <= size) {
                        addVoxel(x, height, z, materials.roof);
                    }
                }
            }
            // Roof Corners
            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                const cx = [pagodaX - size, pagodaX + size, pagodaX - size, pagodaX + size][i];
                const cz = [pagodaZ - size, pagodaZ - size, pagodaZ + size, pagodaZ + size][i];
                addVoxel(cx, height, cz, materials.flower); // Decorative
            }
        }
        addRoof(1, 6, 4);
        addRoof(2, 12, 3);
        addRoof(3, 18, 2);
        addRoof(4, 24, 1);

        // Trees
        function addTree(tx, ty, tz, height) {
            for (let y = ty; y <= ty + height - 1; y++) {
                addVoxel(tx, y, tz, materials.wood);
            }
            for (let x = tx - 2; x <= tx + 2; x++) {
                for (let y = ty + height - 2; y <= ty + height + 2; y++) {
                    for (let z = tz - 2; z <= tz + 2; z++) {
                        if (Math.random() > 0.3) {
                            addVoxel(x, y, z, materials.leaf);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        addTree(-20, 1, -20, 5);
        addTree(20, 1, -20, 6);
        addTree(-20, 1, 20, 4);
        addTree(20, 1, 20, 5);
        addTree(-15, 1, 0, 7);
        addTree(15, 1, 0, 6);

        // Cherry Blossoms
        function addBlossom(bx, by, bz) {
            for (let x = bx - 1; x <= bx + 1; x++) {
                for (let z = bz - 1; z <= bz + 1; z++) {
                    if (Math.random() > 0.4) {
                        addVoxel(x, by, z, materials.blossom);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        addBlossom(-20, 8, -20);
        addBlossom(20, 9, -20);
        addBlossom(-20, 6, 20);
        addBlossom(20, 7, 20);
        addBlossom(-15, 10, 0);
        addBlossom(15, 9, 0);

        // Flowers in Garden
        for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
            const fx = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100) - 50;
            const fz = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100) - 50;
            if (fx > 10 || fx < -10 || fz > 10 || fz < -10) {
                addVoxel(fx, 1, fz, materials.flower);
            }
        }

        // Camera
        camera.position.set(20, 15, 20);
        camera.lookAt(0, 10, 0);

        // Animation
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            // Slight camera rotation for dynamism
            camera.position.x = 20 * Math.cos(Date.now() * 0.0005);
            camera.position.z = 20 * Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.0005);
            camera.lookAt(0, 10, 0);
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // Resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
