prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #87CEEB; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040, 0.6);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
        directionalLight.position.set(50, 100, 50);
        directionalLight.castShadow = true;
        directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 2048;
        directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 2048;
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Voxel size and grid
        const voxelSize = 1;
        const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(voxelSize, voxelSize, voxelSize);

        // Materials for colorful voxels
        const materials = {
            wood: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x8B4513 }),
            roof: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x2F4F2F }),
            roofAccent: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xFF4500 }),
            stone: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x696969 }),
            grass: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x228B22 }),
            leaf: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x32CD32 }),
            cherryBlossom: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xFFB6C1 }),
            trunk: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xA0522D }),
            path: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xF5DEB3 }),
            flower: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xFF69B4 })
        };

        // Function to create a voxel at position
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, material) {
            const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            mesh.position.set(x * voxelSize, y * voxelSize, z * voxelSize);
            mesh.castShadow = true;
            mesh.receiveShadow = true;
            scene.add(mesh);
            return mesh;
        }

        // Pagoda base (multi-tiered foundation)
        function buildPagodaBase() {
            // Ground level platform
            for (let x = -5; x <= 5; x++) {
                for (let z = -5; z <= 5; z++) {
                    createVoxel(x, 0, z, materials.stone);
                }
            }
            // Elevated base layer
            for (let x = -3; x <= 3; x++) {
                for (let z = -3; z <= 3; z++) {
                    createVoxel(x, 1, z, materials.stone);
                }
            }
        }

        // Pagoda structure (multi-level)
        function buildPagodaStructure() {
            // Main pillar levels
            for (let level = 2; level <= 5; level++) {
                const size = 6 - level; // Decreasing size per level
                for (let x = -size/2; x <= size/2; x++) {
                    for (let z = -size/2; z <= size/2; z++) {
                        if (Math.abs(x) <= size/2 && Math.abs(z) <= size/2) {
                            createVoxel(x, level, z, materials.wood);
                        }
                    }
                }
                // Roof at each level
                buildRoof(level + 1, size);
            }
            // Central spire
            for (let y = 6; y <= 10; y++) {
                createVoxel(0, y, 0, materials.roofAccent);
            }
        }

        // Roof construction (curved pagoda style with accents)
        function buildRoof(yLevel, baseSize) {
            // Base roof layer
            for (let x = -baseSize/2 - 1; x <= baseSize/2 + 1; x++) {
                for (let z = -baseSize/2 - 1; z <= baseSize/2 + 1; z++) {
                    const dist = Math.sqrt(x*x + z*z);
                    if (dist <= baseSize/2 + 1) {
                        createVoxel(x, yLevel, z, materials.roof);
                    }
                }
            }
            // Roof accents (ornate edges)
            for (let x = -baseSize/2 - 2; x <= baseSize/2 + 2; x += 2) {
                for (let z = -baseSize/2 - 2; z <= baseSize/2 + 2; z += 2) {
                    if (Math.abs(x) > baseSize/2 || Math.abs(z) > baseSize/2) {
                        createVoxel(x, yLevel + 1, z, materials.roofAccent);
                    }
                }
            }
            // Curved roof effect with varying heights
            for (let x = -baseSize/2; x <= baseSize/2; x++) {
                for (let z = -baseSize/2; z <= baseSize/2; z++) {
                    const heightOffset = Math.sin(x / (baseSize/2) * Math.PI) * 0.5 + Math.sin(z / (baseSize/2) * Math.PI) * 0.5;
                    if (heightOffset > 0.3) {
                        createVoxel(x, yLevel + 2 + Math.floor(heightOffset), z, materials.roofAccent);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Garden ground (varied terrain)
        function buildGardenGround() {
            // Main garden area
            for (let x = -20; x <= 20; x++) {
                for (let z = -20; z <= 20; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x) < 5 && Math.abs(z) < 5) continue; // Skip pagoda area
                    const height = Math.floor(Math.sin(x * 0.1) * Math.cos(z * 0.1) * 2); // Wavy terrain
                    createVoxel(x, height, z, materials.grass);
                }
            }
            // Winding path
            const pathPoints = [
                {x: -15, z: -15}, {x: -10, z: -10}, {x: -5, z: 0}, {x: 0, z: 5},
                {x: 5, z: 0}, {x: 10, z: -5}, {x: 15, z: -10}
            ];
            for (let i = 0; i < pathPoints.length - 1; i++) {
                const start = pathPoints[i], end = pathPoints[i+1];
                const steps = Math.max(Math.abs(end.x - start.x), Math.abs(end.z - start.z));
                for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
                    const x = Math.floor(start.x + (end.x - start.x) * s / steps);
                    const z = Math.floor(start.z + (end.z - start.z) * s / steps);
                    for (let px = -1; px <= 1; px++) {
                        for (let pz = -1; pz <= 1; pz++) {
                            createVoxel(x + px, 0, z + pz, materials.path);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Trees (varied types)
        function buildTrees() {
            // Pine-like trees around pagoda
            const treePositions = [
                {x: -10, z: -10}, {x: 10, z: -10}, {x: -10, z: 10}, {x: 10, z: 10},
                {x: -15, z: 0}, {x: 15, z: 0}, {x: 0, z: -15}, {x: 0, z: 15}
            ];
            treePositions.forEach(pos => {
                // Trunk
                for (let y = 0; y <= 8; y++) {
                    createVoxel(pos.x, y, pos.z, materials.trunk);
                }
                // Branches
                for (let level = 3; level <= 8; level++) {
                    const branchSize = 2 + Math.floor((level - 3) / 2);
                    for (let bx = -branchSize; bx <= branchSize; bx++) {
                        for (let bz = -branchSize; bz <= branchSize; bz++) {
                            if (Math.sqrt(bx*bx + bz*bz) <= branchSize) {
                                createVoxel(pos.x + bx, level, pos.z + bz, materials.leaf);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });

            // Cherry blossom trees (pink flowers)
            const cherryPositions = [
                {x: -8, z: 8}, {x: 8, z: 8}, {x: -8, z: -8}, {x: 8, z: -8}
            ];
            cherryPositions.forEach(pos => {
                // Trunk
                for (let y = 0; y <= 6; y++) {
                    createVoxel(pos.x, y, pos.z, materials.trunk);
                }
                // Blossoms (clustered pink voxels)
                for (let level = 4; level <= 7; level++) {
                    const blossomSize = 3;
                    for (let bx = -blossomSize; bx <= blossomSize; bx++) {
                        for (let bz = -blossomSize; bz <= blossomSize; bz++) {
                            const dist = Math.sqrt(bx*bx + bz*bz);
                            if (dist <= blossomSize && Math.random() > 0.3) { // Sparse blossoms
                                createVoxel(pos.x + bx, level, pos.z + bz, materials.cherryBlossom);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                // Falling petals effect (scattered)
                for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                    const px = pos.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6;
                    const pz = pos.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6;
                    const py = Math.random() * 3;
                    createVoxel(Math.floor(px), Math.floor(py), Math.floor(pz), materials.cherryBlossom);
                }
            });
        }

        // Additional garden elements (flowers, rocks)
        function buildGardenDetails() {
            // Flower beds
            const flowerBeds = [
                {x: -12, z: 5, size: 3}, {x: 12, z: -5, size: 2},
                {x: -5, z: 12, size: 4}, {x: 5, z: -12, size: 3}
            ];
            flowerBeds.forEach(bed => {
                for (let fx = -bed.size; fx <= bed.size; fx++) {
                    for (let fz = -bed.size; fz <= bed.size; fz++) {
                        if (Math.random() > 0.4) {
                            createVoxel(bed.x + fx, 1, bed.z + fz, materials.flower);
                        }
                    }
                }
            });

            // Decorative rocks
            const rockPositions = [{x: -18, z: -5}, {x: 18, z: 5}, {x: -3, z: -18}, {x: 3, z: 18}];
            rockPositions.forEach(pos => {
                for (let rx = -1; rx <= 1; rx++) {
                    for (let rz = -1; rz <= 1; rz++) {
                        for (let ry = 0; ry <= Math.random() * 3 + 1; ry++) {
                            if (Math.random() > 0.2) {
                                createVoxel(pos.x + rx, ry, pos.z + rz, materials.stone);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });

            // Pond (blue water voxels, simplified)
            for (let px = -4; px <= -2; px++) {
                for (let pz = 8; pz <= 10; pz++) {
                    createVoxel(px, 0.5, pz, new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x4169E1, transparent: true, opacity: 0.7 }));
                }
            }
        }

        // Build the entire scene
        buildPagodaBase();
        buildPagodaStructure();
        buildGardenGround();
        buildTrees();
        buildGardenDetails();

        // Camera position
        camera.position.set(0, 15, 25);
        camera.lookAt(0, 5, 0);

        // Animation loop with subtle rotation for impressiveness
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            // Gentle scene rotation
            scene.rotation.y += 0.002;
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // Handle resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        const voxelGroup = new THREE.Group();
        scene.add(voxelGroup);

        // Function to create a colored voxel
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(voxelSize, voxelSize, voxelSize);
            const material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: color });
            const cube = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            cube.position.set(x * voxelSize, y * voxelSize, z * voxelSize);
            cube.castShadow = true;
            cube.receiveShadow = true;
            voxelGroup.add(cube);
            return cube;
        }

        // Garden ground (green grass layer)
        for (let x = -50; x < 50; x++) {
            for (let z = -50; z < 50; z++) {
                if (Math.random() > 0.7) { // Sparse flowers
                    createVoxel(x, 0, z, Math.random() > 0.5 ? 0xff69b4 : 0x00ff00); // Pink or green variations
                } else {
                    createVoxel(x, 0, z, 0x228B22); // Forest green
                }
            }
        }

        // Pagoda base (gray stone)
        const pagodaX = 0, pagodaZ = 0;
        for (let x = pagodaX - 5; x <= pagodaX + 5; x++) {
            for (let z = pagodaZ - 5; z <= pagodaZ + 5; z++) {
                for (let y = 1; y <= 3; y++) {
                    createVoxel(x, y, z, 0x808080); // Gray base
                }
            }
        }

        // Pagoda first level walls (red accents)
        for (let x = pagodaX - 4; x <= pagodaX + 4; x++) {
            for (let z = pagodaZ - 4; z <= pagodaZ + 4; z++) {
                if (Math.abs(x - pagodaX) <= 3 && Math.abs(z - pagodaZ) <= 3) {
                    createVoxel(x, 4, z, 0x8B0000); // Dark red walls
                }
            }
        }
        // Pillars on first level
        const pillarPositions = [[-4,4,-4], [-4,4,4], [4,4,-4], [4,4,4]];
        pillarPositions.forEach(pos => createVoxel(pagodaX + pos[0], pos[1], pagodaZ + pos[2], 0x654321)); // Brown pillars

        // First roof (curved effect with layered voxels, green tiles)
        for (let layer = 0; layer < 3; layer++) {
            const size = 9 - layer * 2;
            for (let x = pagodaX - Math.floor(size/2); x < pagodaX + Math.ceil(size/2); x++) {
                for (let z = pagodaZ - Math.floor(size/2); z < pagodaZ + Math.ceil(size/2); z++) {
                    createVoxel(x, 5 + layer, z, 0x006400); // Dark green tiles
                }
            }
        }

        // Second level (smaller)
        for (let x = pagodaX - 3; x <= pagodaX + 3; x++) {
            for (let z = pagodaZ - 3; z <= pagodaZ + 3; z++) {
                for (let y = 6; y <= 8; y++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x - pagodaX) <= 2 && Math.abs(z - pagodaZ) <= 2) {
                        createVoxel(x, y, z, 0x8B0000); // Red walls
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // Second level pillars
        const pillar2Positions = [[-3,6,-3], [-3,6,3], [3,6,-3], [3,6,3]];
        pillar2Positions.forEach(pos => createVoxel(pagodaX + pos[0], pos[1], pagodaZ + pos[2], 0x654321));

        // Second roof (layered)
        for (let layer = 0; layer < 3; layer++) {
            const size = 7 - layer * 2;
            for (let x = pagodaX - Math.floor(size/2); x < pagodaX + Math.ceil(size/2); x++) {
                for (let z = pagodaZ - Math.floor(size/2); z < pagodaZ + Math.ceil(size/2); z++) {
                    createVoxel(x, 9 + layer, z, 0x006400); // Green tiles
                }
            }
        }

        // Top spire (golden)
        for (let y = 12; y <= 15; y++) {
            createVoxel(pagodaX, y, pagodaZ, 0xFFD700); // Gold
        }

        // Trees around the pagoda
        function createTree(x, z, height, trunkColor, leafColor) {
            // Trunk
            for (let y = 1; y <= height; y++) {
                createVoxel(x, y, z, trunkColor);
            }
            // Leaves (spherical-ish)
            for (let lx = -2; lx <= 2; lx++) {
                for (let ly = height; ly <= height + 4; ly++) {
                    for (let lz = -2; lz <= 2; lz++) {
                        const dist = Math.sqrt(lx*lx + (ly - height - 2)* (ly - height - 2) + lz*lz);
                        if (dist < 3 + Math.random()) {
                            createVoxel(x + lx, ly, z + lz, leafColor);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Regular green trees
        createTree(-20, -20, 8, 0x8B4513, 0x228B22);
        createTree(20, -15, 10, 0x8B4513, 0x32CD32);
        createTree(-15, 25, 7, 0x8B4513, 0x006400);

        // Cherry blossom trees (pink flowers)
        function createCherryTree(x, z, height) {
            createTree(x, z, height, 0x8B4513, 0xFF69B4); // Pink blossoms
            // Add falling petals effect (sparse pink voxels)
            for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                const px = x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10;
                const pz = z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10;
                const py = 1 + Math.random() * 5;
                createVoxel(Math.round(px), Math.round(py), Math.round(pz), 0xFFB6C1); // Light pink petals
            }
        }

        createCherryTree(10, 20, 9);
        createCherryTree(-25, 10, 8);
        createCherryTree(25, 5, 10);

        // Varied elements: Rocks (gray), pond (blue voxels)
        // Rocks
        for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            const rx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80;
            const rz = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80;
            const ry = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
            createVoxel(rx, ry, rz, 0x696969); // Gray rock
        }

        // Small pond
        for (let x = 15; x < 20; x++) {
            for (let z = 15; z < 20; z++) {
                createVoxel(x, 0.5, z, 0x4169E1); // Royal blue water, slightly above ground
            }
        }

        // Camera position
        camera.position.set(30, 20, 30);
        camera.lookAt(0, 5, 0);

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            controls.update();
            voxelGroup.rotation.y += 0.001; // Subtle rotation for dynamism
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // Handle resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.155.0/build/three.min.js"></script>
<script>
    // Scene setup
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB); // Sky blue

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    camera.position.z = 15;

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // Voxel grid helper
    const voxelSize = 1;
    const gridSize = 20;

    // Create ground
    const groundGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(gridSize*voxelSize, 1, gridSize*voxelSize);
    const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x228B22 });
    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);
    ground.position.y = 0.5;
    scene.add(ground);

    // Create pagoda
    const pagodaColors = [0x8B4513, 0xFFD700, 0x4682B4, 0xFF4500];
    const pagodaGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(5, 10, 5);
    const pagodaMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8B4513 });
    const pagoda = new THREE.Mesh(pagodaGeometry, pagodaMaterial);
    pagoda.position.set(0, 5, 0);
    scene.add(pagoda);

    // Add pagoda details (simplified voxel layers)
    const addVoxelLayer = (x, y, z, color) => {
        const cube = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(voxelSize, voxelSize, voxelSize), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color }));
        cube.position.set(x*voxelSize, y*voxelSize, z*voxelSize);
        scene.add(cube);
    };

    // Build pagoda structure with colored layers
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        for (let x = -2; x <= 2; x++) {
            for (let z = -2; z <= 2; z++) {
                addVoxelLayer(x, 5 + i, z, pagodaColors[i]);
            }
        }
    }

    // Add trees
    const treeColors = [0x228B22, 0x4682B4, 0x90EE90];
    const treeHeight = 8;
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const treeX = Math.random() * 10 - 5;
        const treeZ = Math.random() * 10 - 5;
        const treeGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 0.5, treeHeight, 4);
        const treeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: treeColors[i % 3] });
        const tree = new THREE.Mesh(treeGeometry, treeMaterial);
        tree.position.set(treeX, 0.5, treeZ);
        scene.add(tree);
    }

    // Add cherry blossoms
    const blossomCount = 50;
    for (let i = 0; i < blossomCount; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * 10 - 5;
        const z = Math.random() * 10 - 5;
        const y = Math.random() * 3 + 1;
        const blossom = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.5, 8, 8), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xFFB6C1 }));
        blossom.position.set(x, y, z);
        scene.add(blossom);
    }

    // Add some rocks
    const rockColors = [0x8B4513, 0xA52A2A];
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const rockX = Math.random() * 8 - 4;
        const rockZ = Math.random() * 8 - 4;
        const rock = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 1, 2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: rockColors[i % 2] }));
        rock.position.set(rockX, 0.5, rockZ);
        scene.add(rock);
    }

    // Lighting
    const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
    light.position.set(5, 10, 5);
    scene.add(light);

    // Animation loop
    const animate = () => {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
    };
    animate();
</script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #87CEEB, #98FB98); }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.128.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x87CEEB, 50, 200);

        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(30, 20, 30);

        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        directionalLight.position.set(50, 50, 50);
        directionalLight.castShadow = true;
        directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 2048;
        directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 2048;
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Voxel size and group
        const voxelSize = 1;
        const voxelGroup = new THREE.Group();
        scene.add(voxelGroup);

        // Function to create a voxel (cube)
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, color, size = voxelSize) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
            const material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: color });
            const cube = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            cube.position.set(x * size, y * size, z * size);
            cube.castShadow = true;
            cube.receiveShadow = true;
            voxelGroup.add(cube);
            return cube;
        }

        // Garden floor: Green grass base
        for (let x = -25; x < 25; x++) {
            for (let z = -25; z < 25; z++) {
                if (Math.random() > 0.3) { // Sparse grass for variety
                    createVoxel(x, 0, z, 0x228B22); // Forest green
                } else {
                    createVoxel(x, 0, z, 0x32CD32); // Lime green variation
                }
            }
        }

        // Path: Stone path leading to pagoda
        for (let i = -5; i <= 5; i++) {
            for (let j = -10; j < 10; j++) {
                createVoxel(i, 0, j, 0xA9A9A9); // Gray stone
            }
        }

        // Pagoda construction
        const pagodaX = 0;
        const pagodaZ = 0;

        // Base platform (gray stone)
        for (let x = -4; x <= 4; x++) {
            for (let z = -4; z <= 4; z++) {
                for (let y = 0; y < 2; y++) {
                    createVoxel(pagodaX + x, y, pagodaZ + z, 0x696969);
                }
            }
        }

        // Main structure walls (multi-level)
        const levels = [6, 8, 10]; // Heights for tiers
        const wallColor = 0xF5F5DC; // Beige walls
        const roofColor = 0x8B0000; // Dark red roofs

        let currentHeight = 2;
        for (let level = 0; level < 3; level++) {
            const size = 8 - level * 2; // Shrinking tiers
            for (let x = -size/2 + 0.5; x < size/2; x++) {
                for (let z = -size/2 + 0.5; z < size/2; z++) {
                    // Walls (hollow inside)
                    if (Math.abs(x) <= size/2 - 1 && Math.abs(z) <= size/2 - 1) {
                        for (let y = currentHeight; y < currentHeight + levels[level]; y++) {
                            if (Math.abs(x) > 0.5 || Math.abs(z) > 0.5 || y === currentHeight || y === currentHeight + levels[level] - 1) {
                                createVoxel(pagodaX + x, y, pagodaZ + z, wallColor);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            currentHeight += levels[level];

            // Roof: Overhanging, multi-layered
            const roofSize = size + 2;
            for (let x = -roofSize/2; x <= roofSize/2; x++) {
                for (let z = -roofSize/2; z <= roofSize/2; z++) {
                    const dist = Math.sqrt(x*x + z*z);
                    if (dist <= roofSize/2) {
                        // Curved roof effect with varying height
                        const roofY = currentHeight + Math.floor((roofSize/2 - dist) * 0.5);
                        createVoxel(pagodaX + x, roofY, pagodaZ + z, roofColor);
                        // Roof tiles variation
                        if (Math.random() > 0.7) {
                            createVoxel(pagodaX + x, roofY + 0.5, pagodaZ + z, 0xDC143C); // Brighter red
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            currentHeight += 2; // Space for next level
        }

        // Spire on top: Golden
        for (let y = currentHeight; y < currentHeight + 6; y++) {
            const spireSize = Math.max(1, 8 - (y - currentHeight) * 1.5);
            for (let x = -spireSize/2 + 0.5; x < spireSize/2; x++) {
                for (let z = -spireSize/2 + 0.5; z < spireSize/2; z++) {
                    createVoxel(pagodaX + x, y, pagodaZ + z, 0xFFD700);
                }
            }
        }

        // Decorative elements on pagoda: Lanterns (orange)
        createVoxel(pagodaX + 3, 5, pagodaZ + 3, 0xFF8C00);
        createVoxel(pagodaX - 3, 5, pagodaZ - 3, 0xFF8C00);
        createVoxel(pagodaX + 3, 12, pagodaZ + 3, 0xFF8C00);
        createVoxel(pagodaX - 3, 12, pagodaZ - 3, 0xFF8C00);

        // Trees: Varied shapes
        function createTree(tx, tz, height, trunkColor = 0x8B4513, leafColor = 0x228B22, isCherry = false) {
            // Trunk
            for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
                createVoxel(tx, y, tz, trunkColor);
                // Slight variation in trunk width
                if (y > height * 0.3 && Math.random() > 0.8) {
                    createVoxel(tx + 1, y, tz, trunkColor);
                    createVoxel(tx - 1, y, tz, trunkColor);
                }
            }

            // Leaves: Spherical-ish canopy
            const canopyHeight = height + 3;
            for (let y = height; y < canopyHeight; y++) {
                const radius = Math.floor(4 - (y - height) * 0.8);
                for (let x = -radius; x <= radius; x++) {
                    for (let z = -radius; z <= radius; z++) {
                        if (Math.sqrt(x*x + z*z) <= radius && Math.random() > 0.2) { // Sparse for natural look
                            const color = isCherry && Math.random() > 0.6 ? 0xFFB6C1 : leafColor; // Pink blossoms
                            createVoxel(tx + x, y, tz + z, color);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Multiple trees around the garden
        createTree(-15, -15, 8); // Tall pine-like
        createTree(15, -10, 6); // Medium
        createTree(-10, 15, 10); // Tall with variation
        createTree(12, 18, 7);
        createTree(-18, 10, 5, 0x654321, 0x556B2F); // Darker colors for variety

        // Cherry blossom trees: More pink
        createTree(5, -15, 7, 0xA0522D, 0x90EE90, true);
        createTree(-12, -5, 9, 0xCD853F, 0x98FB98, true);
        createTree(18, 5, 6, 0xD2691E, 0xF0E68C, true); // Light yellow-green with pink

        // Scattered cherry blossoms on ground
        for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
            const gx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
            const gz = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
            if (Math.random() > 0.7) {
                createVoxel(gx, 0.5, gz, 0xFFB6C1, 0.8); // Smaller pink petals
            }
        }

        // Rocks and bushes for variety
        for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            const rx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
            const rz = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
            const rockColor = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 0x696969 : 0x8B4513;
            createVoxel(rx, 0, rz, rockColor, 1.5); // Larger rocks
        }

        // Bushes: Small green clusters
        for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            const bx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
            const bz = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
            for (let y = 0; y < 3; y++) {
                for (let x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
                    for (let z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {
                        if (Math.random() > 0.4) {
                            createVoxel(bx + x, y, bz + z, 0x228B22);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            controls.update();
            voxelGroup.rotation.y += 0.002; // Subtle rotation for dynamism
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // Handle resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <title>Voxel Garden Oasis</title>
  <style>
    html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    canvas { display: block; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="voxelfield"></canvas>

<script>
// Load ThreeJS & GLTFLoader
function loadScript(src, callback) {
  const script = document.createElement('script');
  script.type = 'module';
  script.src = src;
  script.onload = callback;
  document.head.appendChild(script);
}

// Load assets
const assets = {
  voxels: {
    pagoda: 'https://i.imgur.com/3QTk4PG.png',  // Voxel texture atlas
    blossom: 'https://i.imgur.com/7Yl0eSL.png' // Particle texture
  }
};

// === Begin Scene Setup ===
async function init() {
  // Container & Renderer
  const container = document.createElement('div');
  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: true });
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
  document.body.appendChild(container);

  // Scene & Camera
  const scene = new THREE.Scene();
  const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
  camera.position.set(50, 30, 50);

  // Lighting
  const ambient = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0xcccccc, 1.2);
  scene.add(ambient);
  const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.5);
  dirLight.position.set(-50, 70, -50);
  scene.add(dirLight);

  // Background with fog
  scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB);
  scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x87CEEB, 0.0005);

  // Skybox
  const skyGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry();
  const skyMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xcee0e2, side: THREE.BackSide });
  scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(skyGeo, skyMat));

  // User Controls
  const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
  controls.enablePan = false;
  controls.minDistance = 15;
  controls.maxDistance = 100;

  // === Voxel Generator ===
  function makeVoxel(x, y, z, color, size=1, transparent=false) {
    const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
    const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ 
      color, 
      transparent: transparent ? true : false,
      opacity: transparent ? 0.8 : 1
    });
    return new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat).position.set(x, y, z);
  }

  // === Create Voxel Pagoda ===
  function createPagoda() {
    const tiers = 5;
    const colors = [
      0x8B4513, 0x6C6C6C, 0xB22222, 0x228B22, 0x4169E1
    ];
    
    const pagoda = new THREE.Group();
    let height = 3;
    
    for (let i = 0; i < tiers; i++) {
      // Storeys
      for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
        for (let x = -4 + i; x <= 4 - i; x++) {
          for (let z = -4 + i; z <= 4 - i; z++) {
            pagoda.add(makeVoxel(
              x*5, height + j*4, z*5,
              colors[i],
              j+1
            ));
          }
        }
      }
      
      // Roof decorations
      const row = [i*2+1, i*2+2];
      for (let y = 0; y < 3; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < row.length; x++) {
          const size = 1 - y/2;
          pagoda.add(makeVoxel(
            -5 + i + x*9, height + 3 + y*3, -5 + i + x*9,
            colors[i],
            size
          ));
        }
      }
      
      height += 10;
    }
    
    scene.add(pagoda);
  }

  // === Create Voxel Garden ===
  function createGarden() {
    // Ground
    const ground = makeVoxel(0, -1.5, 0, 0x2E8B57, 100, true);
    ground.scale.set(10, 1, 10);
    scene.add(ground);

    // Flower Beds
    const flowers = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
        const x = Math.cos(i*0.3) * 15;
        const z = Math.sin(i*0.3) * 15;
        const flower = makeVoxel(x, 2, z, 0xFF69B4, 1, true);
        flowers.push(flower);
        scene.add(flower);
        
        // Animate flower rotations
        flower.rotationX = Math.PI/4;
        flower.rotationY = Math.PI/6;
      }
    }

    // Voxel Trees
    const treePositions = [
      [5, 3, 5], [-5, 3, -5], [0, 3, 10], [0, 3, -10]
    ];
    
    treePositions.forEach(([x, y, z]) => {
      // Trunk
      const trunk = makeVoxel(x, y, z, 0x8B4513, 2, false);
      trunk.scale.set(2, 8, 2);
      scene.add(trunk);

      // Leaves
      for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        const leaf = makeVoxel(
          x + Math.random()*4 - 2,
          y + 4 + Math.random()*3,
          z + Math.random()*4 - 2, 
          (Math.random() > 0.5) ? 0x228B22 : 0x8C564B
        );
        leaf.scale.set(3, 3, 3);
        scene.add(leaf);
      }
    });
  }

  // === Cherry Blossoms Rain ===
  async function createBlossoms() {
    const loader = new THREE.TextureLoader();
    const texture = await loader.load(assets.voxels.blossom);
    const material = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ map: texture, size: 1.5 });

    const blossoms = new THREE.Points(
      new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(
        Array.from({length: 1000}, () => new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.random()*60 - 30, 
          Math.random()*20 + 15,
          Math.random()*60 - 30
        ))
      ),
      material
    );
    
    scene.add(blossoms);
    
    // Animation
    let time = 0;
    const speed = 0.0005;
    
    function animateBlossoms() {
      blossoms.rotation.y += speed;
      setTimeout(animateBlossoms, 1000/60);
    }
    animateBlossoms();
  }

  // === Animated Fireflies ===
  async function createFireflies() {
    const loader = new THREE.TextureLoader();
    const texture = await loader.load(
      'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@r126/examples/js/libs/fierydust.png' 
    );
    
    const fireflies = new THREE.Points(
      new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(
        Array.from({length: 200}, () => new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.random()*60 - 30, 
          Math.random()*20 + 15,
          Math.random()*60 - 30
        ))
      ),
      new THREE.PointsMaterial({
        map: texture,
        blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
        depthTest: false,
        alphaTest: 0.5,
        size: 4
      })
    );
    
    fireflies.name = 'fireflies';
    scene.add(fireflies);
    
    // Animation
    let time = 0;
    const speed = 0.001;
    
    setInterval(() => {
      fireflies.rotation.set(0, time, 0);
      // Move fireflies upward
      fireflies.position.y = Math.sin(time)*1.5 + 2;
      time += speed;
    }, 33);
  }

  // === Load Models & Start Scene ===
  await loadScript('https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r126/build/three.min.js');
  await loadScript('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three.js@r126/examples/js/loaders/GLTFLoader.js', () => {
    loadScript('https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r126/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js', () => {
      // Clean up node chains
      document.body.removeChild(container);
      document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

      // Create content
      createPagoda();
      createGarden();
      createBlossoms();
      createFireflies();

      // Animation loop
      function animate() {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
      }
      animate();
    });
  });
}

// Initialize everything
init();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">

    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>

        body { margin: 0; }

    </style>

<body>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        let scene, camera, renderer;
        let voxelSize = 1;
        let voxelData = [];

        init();
        animate();

        function init() {
            scene = new THREE.Scene();
            camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
            renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
            document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

            // Set camera position
            camera.position.set(20, 20, 20);
            camera.lookAt(scene.position);

            // Add lighting
            const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
            scene.add(ambientLight);
            const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
            directionalLight.position.set(1, 1, 1).normalize();
            scene.add(directionalLight);

            // Create pagoda
            createPagoda(0, 0, 0);

            // Create garden with trees
            createGarden();

            // Resize handler
            window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);
        }

        function createPagoda(x, y, z) {
            // Base
            addBox(x, y, z, 10, 1, 10, 0x8b4513); // Brown base

            // Main structure
            addBox(x, y + 1, z, 8, 5, 8, 0xffe4c4); // Bisque pagoda body
            addBox(x, y + 6, z, 6, 1, 6, 0xd2691e); // Chocolate roof base

            // Roof tiers
            addBox(x, y + 7, z, 4, 1, 4, 0xd2691e);
            addBox(x, y + 8, z, 2, 1, 2, 0xb8860b);
        }

        function createGarden() {
            // Ground
            addBox(-50, 0, -50, 100, 1, 100, 0x8fbc8f); // Green grass

            // Trees (simple representation)
            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                let x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80;
                let z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80;
                addBox(x, 1, z, 1, 5, 1, 0x8b4513); // Tree trunk
                addSphere(x, 6, z, 3, 0x90ee90); // Light green leaves

                // Cherry blossoms (pink)
                if (i % 2 === 0) {
                    addSphere(x, 8, z, 2, 0xff69b4); // Pink cherry blossoms
                }
            }
        }

        function addBox(x, y, z, sx, sy, sz, color) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(sx * voxelSize, sy * voxelSize, sz * voxelSize);
            const material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: color });
            const cube = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            cube.position.set(x, y, z);
            scene.add(cube);
        }

        function addSphere(x, y, z, radius, color) {
            const geometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(radius * voxelSize, 8, 8);
            const material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: color });
            const sphere = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            sphere.position.set(x, y, z);
            scene.add(sphere);
        }

        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        function onWindowResize() {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r155/three.min.js"></script>
<script>

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87c9ff);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 5000);
camera.position.set(60, 60, 120);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias: false});
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const controlsScript = document.createElement('script');
controlsScript.src = "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r155/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js";
document.head.appendChild(controlsScript);

controlsScript.onload = () => {
  const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
  controls.target.set(0, 20, 0);
  controls.update();
};

// Simple directional light + ambient
const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
dirLight.position.set(50, 100, 50);
scene.add(dirLight);

scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.4));

// A function to place a voxel
function addVoxel(x, y, z, color, size=1) {
  const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
  const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color});
  const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
  voxel.position.set(x, y, z);
  scene.add(voxel);
}

// Build ground
for (let i = -80; i <= 80; i+=2) {
  for (let j = -80; j <= 80; j+=2) {
    addVoxel(i, 0, j, 0x3da93d, 2);
  }
}

// Pagoda base platform
for (let i = -15; i <= 15; i+=2) {
  for (let j = -15; j <= 15; j+=2) {
    addVoxel(i, 2, j, 0xc0b9a0, 2);
  }
}

// Pagoda levels: alternating roof layers and pillars
function buildPagodaLevel(yBase, scale) {
  // Pillars at corners
  const pillarColor = 0x553311;
  const roofColor = 0xc02d2d;

  const offset = 10 * scale;
  const pillars = [
    [-offset, yBase, -offset],
    [offset, yBase, -offset],
    [-offset, yBase, offset],
    [offset, yBase, offset]
  ];
  for (const p of pillars) {
    for (let h = 0; h < 15 * scale; h+=2) {
      addVoxel(p[0], yBase + h, p[2], pillarColor, 2);
    }
  }

  // Roof layer
  const roofY = yBase + 15 * scale;
  for (let i = -offset-4; i <= offset+4; i+=2) {
    for (let j = -offset-4; j <= offset+4; j+=2) {
      if (Math.abs(i) >= offset || Math.abs(j) >= offset) {
        addVoxel(i, roofY, j, roofColor, 2);
      }
    }
  }
}

// Three stacked levels
buildPagodaLevel(4, 1.0);
buildPagodaLevel(22, 0.7);
buildPagodaLevel(36, 0.45);

// Cherry blossom trees
function addTree(baseX, baseZ) {
  // Trunk
  for (let y = 2; y <= 14; y+=2) addVoxel(baseX, y, baseZ, 0x7a4a1d, 2);
  // Blossoms random sphere-ish
  for (let i = -6; i <= 6; i+=2) {
    for (let j = -6; j <= 6; j+=2) {
      for (let k = 0; k <= 6; k+=2) {
        if (i*i + j*j + k*k < 36) {
          const pinks = [0xffb7d5, 0xff9bcf, 0xfcb2d4];
          const c = pinks[Math.floor(Math.random()*pinks.length)];
          addVoxel(baseX+i, 14+k, baseZ+j, c, 2);
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

addTree(-40, -20);
addTree(-50, 30);
addTree(40, -10);
addTree(55, 25);

// Random green trees
function addGreenTree(x, z) {
  for (let y = 2; y <= 12; y+=2) addVoxel(x, y, z, 0x7a4a1d, 2);
  for (let i = -6; i <= 6; i+=2) {
    for (let j = -6; j <= 6; j+=2) {
      if (i*i + j*j < 36) addVoxel(x+i, 14, z+j, 0x2f7d32, 2);
    }
  }
}

addGreenTree(-20, 50);
addGreenTree(20, 55);
addGreenTree(-60, 10);
addGreenTree(60, -30);

// Flowers on ground
for (let n=0; n<200; n++) {
  const fx = Math.floor(Math.random()*160 - 80);
  const fz = Math.floor(Math.random()*160 - 80);
  const colors = [0xffff66, 0xff66ff, 0xffffff];
  addVoxel(fx, 2, fz, colors[Math.floor(Math.random()*colors.length)], 1);
}

// Render loop
function animate() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
animate();

// Resize
window.addEventListener('resize', ()=> {
  camera.aspect = window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
});

</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
<style>
    body { margin: 0; background: #080010; overflow: hidden; }
    canvas { display: block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r152/three.min.js"></script>
<script>
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x0d0d14, 0.02);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 2000);
camera.position.set(40, 35, 65);
camera.lookAt(0, 5, 0);

const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.minDistance = 20;
controls.maxDistance = 120;
controls.maxPolarAngle = Math.PI / 2;

const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.1);
light.position.set(50, 70, 50);
light.castShadow = true;
light.shadow.camera.left = -90;
light.shadow.camera.right = 90;
light.shadow.camera.top = 90;
light.shadow.camera.bottom = -90;
scene.add(light);

const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x666688, 0.6);
scene.add(ambient);

function voxelCube(color) {
    const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1);
    const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color,
        roughness: 0.4,
        metalness: 0.1,
    });
    return new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
}

const base = new THREE.Group();
const baseMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x3f1e0d, roughness:0.8 });
for(let x=-9; x<=9; x++) {
    for(let z=-12; z<=12; z++) {
        if(Math.abs(x)===9 || Math.abs(z)===12 || (Math.abs(x)<=7 && Math.abs(z)<=10 && (x+z)%4===0)) {
            const block = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1), baseMat);
            block.position.set(x, 0, z);
            block.castShadow = true;
            block.receiveShadow = true;
            base.add(block);
        }
    }
}
scene.add(base);

const pathMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8c6c3a });
for(let x=-3; x<=3; x++) {
    for(let z=-8; z<=8; z++) {
        if(Math.abs(z)%2===0){
            const brick = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,0.2,1), pathMat);
            brick.position.set(x, 0.6, z);
            brick.receiveShadow = true;
            brick.castShadow = true;
            base.add(brick);
        }
    }
}

function addColumn(x,z,y,height) {
    const column = new THREE.Group();
    for(let h=0; h<height; h++) {
        const block = voxelCube(0xf3d7c0);
        block.position.set(x, y+h, z);
        block.castShadow = true;
        block.receiveShadow = true;
        column.add(block);
    }
    scene.add(column);
}

function createPagoda() {
    const pagoda = new THREE.Group();
    const roofColors = [0xd946ff,0xeb8af6,0xbe34ff,0x8b54f5];
    for(let level=0; level<5; level++) {
        const y = level*2 + 1;
        const size = 11 - level*2;
        const wallColor = 0xf4f0d3;
        for(let x=-size/2; x<=size/2; x++) {
            for(let z=-size/2; z<=size/2; z++) {
                if(Math.abs(x) === size/2 || Math.abs(z) === size/2) {
                    const block = voxelCube(wallColor);
                    block.position.set(x, y, z);
                    block.castShadow = true;
                    block.receiveShadow = true;
                    pagoda.add(block);
                }
            }
        }
        const roof = voxelCube(roofColors[level % roofColors.length]);
        roof.scale.set(size+2, 0.6, size+2);
        roof.position.set(0, y+1.3, 0);
        roof.castShadow = true;
        roof.receiveShadow = true;
        pagoda.add(roof);
        for(let i=0; i<4; i++) {
            const corner = voxelCube(0x2e1f1b);
            corner.scale.set(1,2.2,1);
            const angle = (Math.PI/2)*i;
            const dist = size/2 + 0.5;
            corner.position.set(dist*Math.sin(angle), y+1.2, dist*Math.cos(angle));
            corner.castShadow = true;
            corner.receiveShadow = true;
            pagoda.add(corner);

    }

    entrance.scale.set(2,3,0.6);
    entrance.position.set(0, 2.5, -5.5);
    entrance.castShadow = true;
    entrance.receiveShadow = true;
    pagoda.add(entrance);
    pagoda.position.y = 1;
    scene.add(pagoda);
}

    for(let i=0;i<6;i++){

        petal.position.set(x + Math.cos(angle)*dist, top-0.4 + Math.random()*0.5, z + Math.sin(angle)*dist);
        petal.scale.set(0.5,0.2,0.5);

}
addCherryTree(-5,10,4);
addCherryTree(5,10,4);
addCherryTree(-6,-11,5);
addCherryTree(6,-11,5);
scene.add(blossomGroup);

const lanternGroup = new THREE.Group();
const lanternMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffd371, emissive:0xff914d, emissiveIntensity:0.6, roughness:0.4 });
for(let i=-6;i<=6;i+=3){
    const lantern = voxelCube(0xffe3a5);
    lantern.position.set(i, 2.2, 13.5);
    lantern.scale.set(0.8,1.6,0.8);
    lantern.castShadow=true;

const pond = new THREE.Group();
const pondMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2f9cc0, roughness: 0.3, metalness:0.2 });
for(let dx=-5; dx<=5; dx++){

for(let i=0;i<6;i++){

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #87CEEB 0%, #E0F6FF 100%); }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.167.0/build/three.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.167.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x87CEEB, 60, 250);

        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
        renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
        renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.2;
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;

        // Lighting
        const hemiLight = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x87CEEB, 0x228B22, 0.6);
        scene.add(hemiLight);
        const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xFFDDAA, 0.8);
        dirLight.position.set(50, 100, 50);
        dirLight.castShadow = true;
        dirLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 4096;
        dirLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 4096;
        dirLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
        dirLight.shadow.camera.far = 500;
        dirLight.shadow.camera.left = -100;
        dirLight.shadow.camera.right = 100;
        dirLight.shadow.camera.top = 100;
        dirLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -100;
        scene.add(dirLight);

        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040, 0.4);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        // Ground
        const groundGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(300, 300);
        const groundMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x90EE90 });
        const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeo, groundMat);
        ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        ground.receiveShadow = true;
        scene.add(ground);

        // Voxel setup
        const voxelSize = 1;
        const voxelPositions = new Map();
        const colors = {
            grass: 0x228B22,
            dirt: 0x8B4513,
            stone: 0x808080,
            water: 0x4169E1,
            pagoda_wall: 0xF5F5F5,
            pagoda_base: 0xD2B48C,
            roof_red: 0x8B0000,
            roof_dark: 0x4B0082,
            trunk: 0x8B4513,
            leaves_green: 0x228B22,
            leaves_dark: 0x006400,
            cherry_pink: 0xFFB6C1,
            flower_yellow: 0xFFD700,
            lantern_red: 0xDC143C,
            path_gray: 0x696969,
            rock_gray: 0xA9A9A9
        };

        function addVoxelToMap(x, y, z, colorHex) {
            const key = `0x${colorHex.toString(16).padStart(6, '0')}`;
            if (!voxelPositions.has(key)) voxelPositions.set(key, []);
            voxelPositions.get(key).push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.floor(x), Math.floor(y), Math.floor(z)));
        }

        function fillSolid(x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1, col) {
            for (let x = Math.floor(x0); x <= Math.floor(x1); x++) {
                for (let y = Math.floor(y0); y <= Math.floor(y1); y++) {
                    for (let z = Math.floor(z0); z <= Math.floor(z1); z++) {
                        addVoxelToMap(x, y, z, col);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        function fillWalls(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmax, col) {
            // Back wall
            fillSolid(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmax - 0, zmax, col);
            // Front wall (partial for door illusion)
            fillSolid(xmin, xmin + 1, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmin, col);
            fillSolid(xmax - 1, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmin, col);
            // Left
            fillSolid(xmin, xmin, ymin, ymax, zmin + 1, zmax - 1, col);
            // Right
            fillSolid(xmax, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin + 1, zmax - 1, col);
        }

        function placeSphere(cx, cy, cz, radius, col) {
            const r2 = radius * radius * 0.6;
            for (let dx = -Math.floor(radius); dx <= Math.floor(radius); dx++) {
                for (let dy = -Math.floor(radius); dy <= Math.floor(radius); dy++) {
                    for (let dz = -Math.floor(radius); dz <= Math.floor(radius); dz++) {
                        if (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= r2) {
                            addVoxelToMap(cx + dx, cy + dy, cz + dz, col);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        function buildTree(cx, cz, height = 12, trunkW = 1, folR = 3.5, folCol = colors.leaves_green) {
            const tw = Math.floor(trunkW);
            fillSolid(cx - tw / 2, cx + tw / 2, 0, height, cz - tw / 2, cz + tw / 2, colors.trunk);
            for (let ly = 0; ly < 5; ly++) {
                const fy = height - ly * 1.8;
                const fr = folR - ly * 0.8;
                if (fr < 0.5) break;
                placeSphere(cx, fy, cz, fr, folCol);
            }
        }

        function buildCherryTree(cx, cz, h = 16) {
            buildTree(cx, cz, h, 1, 4, colors.cherry_pink);
        }

        function buildRock(cx, cz) {
            placeSphere(cx, 1.5, cz, 2, colors.rock_gray);
            placeSphere(cx + 1, 1, cz + 1, 1.2, colors.rock_gray);
            placeSphere(cx - 0.8, 0.8, cz - 0.5, 0.8, colors.rock_gray);
        }

        function buildBush(cx, cz) {
            placeSphere(cx, 2, cz, 2.5, colors.leaves_dark);
            placeSphere(cx + 0.5, 1.8, cz - 0.5, 1.8, colors.leaves_green);
        }

        function buildLantern(cx, cz) {
            fillSolid(cx - 0.5, cx + 0.5, 0, 3, cz - 0.5, cz + 0.5, colors.stone);
            fillSolid(cx - 0.8, cx + 0.8, 4, 4.5, cz - 0.8, cz + 0.8, colors.lantern_red);
            placeSphere(cx, 5, cz, 0.6, 0xFFD700);
        }

        function buildBamboo(cx, cz, h = 20) {
            for (let off = 0; off < 3; off++) {
                const bx = cx + (off - 1) * 0.3;
                const bz = cz + (off - 1) * 0.3;
                for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 2.5) {
                    fillSolid(bx, bx, y, y + 1.5, bz, bz, colors.leaves_dark);
                }
            }
        }

        // Build Pagoda at (0,0,0)
        fillSolid(-12, 12, 0, 1, -12, 12, colors.pagoda_base); // Platform
        fillWalls(-8, 8, 2, 10, -8, 8, colors.pagoda_wall); // Tier 1 walls
        fillSolid(-7, 7, 2, 2, -7, 7, colors.dirt); // Floor 1
        // Tier 1 Roof
        fillSolid(-10, 10, 11, 11, -10, 10, colors.roof_dark);
        fillSolid(-9, 9, 12, 12, -9, 9, colors.roof_red);
        fillSolid(-8, 8, 13, 13, -8, 8, colors.roof_dark);
        fillWalls(-5, 5, 14, 19, -5, 5, colors.pagoda_wall); // Tier 2
        fillSolid(-4, 4, 14, 14, -4, 4, colors.dirt);
        // Tier 2 Roof
        fillSolid(-7, 7, 20, 20, -7, 7, colors.roof_dark);
        fillSolid(-6, 6, 21, 21, -6, 6, colors.roof_red);
        fillSolid(-5, 5, 22, 22, -5, 5, colors.roof_dark);
        fillWalls(-3, 3, 23, 27, -3, 3, colors.pagoda_wall); // Tier 3
        fillSolid(-2, 2, 23, 23, -2, 2, colors.dirt);
        // Tier 3 Roof
        fillSolid(-4, 4, 28, 28, -4, 4, colors.roof_dark);
        fillSolid(-3, 3, 29, 29, -3, 3, colors.roof_red);
        // Spire
        fillSolid(-1, 1, 30, 36, -1, 1, colors.roof_dark);
        placeSphere(0, 37, 0, 1.2, 0xFFD700); // Orb

        // Trees
        buildCherryTree(-22, 18);
        buildCherryTree(25, 22);
        buildCherryTree(-20, -25);
        buildCherryTree(28, -20);
        buildCherryTree(-15, 32);
        buildCherryTree(18, -30);
        buildCherryTree(-28, -8);
        buildCherryTree(20, 8);
        buildCherryTree(-32, 5);
        buildTree(35, 12, 14);
        buildTree(-35, 2, 15);
        buildTree(12, 42, 11);
        buildTree(-12, -38, 13);
        buildTree(42, -28, 12);
        buildTree(-40, 28, 10);

        // Pond
        fillSolid(-15, 15, -1.5, 0, -48, -12, colors.water);

        // Bridge
        fillSolid(-6, 6, 0, 2, -28, -22, colors.trunk);

        // Path
        for (let i = -55; i < 5; i += 3.5) {
            const xo = Math.sin(i * 0.08) * 1.5;
            fillSolid(-2.5 + xo, 2.5 + xo, 0, 0.3, i, i + 2.5, colors.path_gray);
        }

        // Lanterns
        buildLantern(-1.5, -32);
        buildLantern(1.2, -22);
        buildLantern(-0.8, -12);
        buildLantern(2, -2);

        // Rocks
        buildRock(-18, -42);
        buildRock(16, 38);
        buildRock(-25, 12);
        buildRock(30, -32);
        buildRock(-10, 45);

        // Bushes
        buildBush(8, 15);
        buildBush(-8, 18);
        buildBush(22, 35);
        buildBush(-22, -35);
        buildBush(35, -8);
        buildBush(-35, 18);

        // Bamboo cluster
        buildBamboo(32, -15);
        buildBamboo(-33, 25);

        // Flowers
        for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
            const x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 120 + (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 0 : 0);
            const z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 120;
            if (Math.abs(x) < 10 && Math.abs(z) < 10) continue; // avoid pagoda
            addVoxelToMap(x, 0, z, colors.flower_yellow);
        }

        // Build voxel meshes
        const voxelGroup = new THREE.Group();
        scene.add(voxelGroup);

        const boxGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(voxelSize * 0.95, voxelSize * 0.95, voxelSize * 0.95); // Slight gap for edges

        voxelPositions.forEach((positions, key) => {
            const color = parseInt(key);
            const count = positions.length;
            const material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color });
            const instancedMesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(boxGeo, material, count);
            const matrix = new THREE.Matrix4();

            positions.forEach((pos, index) => {
                matrix.setPosition(pos.x * voxelSize, (pos.y + 0.5) * voxelSize, pos.z * voxelSize);
                instancedMesh.setMatrixAt(index, matrix);
            });

            instancedMesh.castShadow = true;
            instancedMesh.receiveShadow = true;
            voxelGroup.add(instancedMesh);
        });

        // Falling petals
        const petalGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.6, 0.4);
        const petalMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: colors.cherry_pink, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
        const petals = new THREE.Group();
        for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
            const petal = new THREE.Mesh(petalGeo, petalMat);
            petal.position.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * 150, 20 + Math.random() * 30, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 150);
            petal.rotation.set(Math.random() * Math.PI, Math.random() * Math.PI, 0);
            petal.userData = {
                velY: -0.02 - Math.random() * 0.03,
                velX: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.08,
                velZ: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.08,
                rotSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1
            };
            petals.add(petal);
        }
        scene.add(petals);

        // Camera
        camera.position.set(8, 28, -55);
        controls.target.set(0, 15, 0);
        controls.update();

        // Animate
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            controls.update();

            // Animate petals
            petals.children.forEach(petal => {
                petal.position.x += petal.userData.velX;
                petal.position.y += petal.userData.velY;
                petal.position.z += petal.userData.velZ;
                petal.rotation.z += petal.userData.rotSpeed;
                if (petal.position.y < -5) {
                    petal.position.y = 50;
                    petal.position.x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 150;
                    petal.position.z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 150;
                }
            });

            // Gentle scene rotation for interest
            voxelGroup.rotation.y += 0.0003;

            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // Resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
