                instances.set(color, []);
            }
            const pos = new THREE.Vector3(x * voxelSize, y * voxelSize, z * voxelSize);
            instances.get(color).push(pos);
        }

        function addBox(x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2, color) {
            for (let x = Math.floor(x1); x <= Math.floor(x2); x++) {
                for (let y = Math.floor(y1); y <= Math.floor(y2); y++) {
                    for (let z = Math.floor(z1); z <= Math.floor(z2); z++) {
                        addVoxel(x, y, z, color);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Ground - flat grass with gentle hills
        for (let x = -70; x <= 70; x++) {
            for (let z = -70; z <= 70; z++) {
                let hillHeight = 0;
                const distToCenter = Math.sqrt(x * x + z * z);
                if (distToCenter > 25) {
                    hillHeight = Math.floor(Math.sin(x * 0.08) * Math.cos(z * 0.06) * 1.5);
                }
                addVoxel(x, 0, z, colors.grass);
                for (let hy = 1; hy <= hillHeight; hy++) {
                    addVoxel(x, hy, z, colors.dirt);
                    addVoxel(x, hy, z, colors.grass); // top grass
                }
            }
        }

        // Winding stone path
        let pathX = 0;
        for (let step = 0; step < 60; step++) {
            const zz = -55 + step * 1.5;
            pathX += Math.sin(step * 0.15) * 0.8;
            const px = Math.floor(pathX);
            addBox(px - 2, 1, zz - 0.5, px + 2, 2, zz + 0.5, colors.pathStone);
        }

        // Pagoda platform
        addBox(-18, 1, -18, 18, 3, 18, colors.stone);

        // Pagoda structure - multi-tiered with detailed roofs
        const tierSizes = [16, 13, 10, 8, 6];
        const tierYs = [8, 13, 18, 23, 28];
        let wallYStart = 4;
        for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) {
            const wSize = tierSizes[t] - 2;
            const wHalf = Math.floor(wSize / 2);
            // Walls
            addBox(-wHalf, wallYStart, -wHalf, wHalf, tierYs[t] - 1, wHalf, colors.pagodaWall);
            // Roof base
            const half = Math.floor(tierSizes[t] / 2);
            addBox(-half, tierYs[t], -half, half, tierYs[t], half, colors.pagodaRoof);
            // Stepped upturned eaves
            for (let rs = 1; rs < 4; rs++) {
                const rSize = tierSizes[t] - rs * 1;
                const rHalf = Math.floor(rSize / 2);
                const ry = tierYs[t] + rs * 0.7;
                addBox(-rHalf, ry, -rHalf, rHalf, ry, rHalf, colors.pagodaRoof);
            }
            // Gold roof edges and finials
            const topY = tierYs[t] + 2;
            addBox(-half + 1, topY, -half + 1, half - 1, topY, half - 1, colors.pagodaRoofEdge);
            addVoxel(0, topY + 1, 0, colors.pagodaRoofEdge);
            wallYStart = tierYs[t] + 2;
        }
        // Central spire
        addBox(-1, 30, -1, 1, 42, 1, colors.pagodaRoofEdge);
        addVoxel(0, 43, 0, 0xFFFF00); // Golden orb

        // Trees
        function addTree(tx, tyBase, tz, type = 'normal') {
            const trunkH = Math.floor(7 + Math.random() * 6);
            addBox(tx, tyBase, tz, tx, tyBase + trunkH - 1, tz, colors.trunk);
            const canopyY = tyBase + trunkH;
            for (let ly = 0; ly < 5; ly++) {
                const yy = canopyY - ly;
                const w = 2 + ly * 0.8;
                const hwx = Math.floor(w / 2);
                let col;
                if (type === 'cherry') {
                    col = Math.random() < 0.65 ? colors.blossomPink : colors.leavesDark;
                } else {
                    col = Math.random() < 0.7 ? colors.leavesGreen : colors.leavesDark;
                }
                addBox(tx - hwx, yy, tz - hwx, tx + hwx, yy, tz + hwx, col);
            }
        }

        // Cherry blossom trees around pagoda
        for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            const ang = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2;
            const dist = 20 + Math.sin(i * 0.5) * 4;
            const tx = Math.round(Math.cos(ang) * dist);
            const tz = Math.round(Math.sin(ang) * dist);
            addTree(tx, 1, tz, 'cherry');
        }
        // Normal trees
        for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
            const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            const dist = 28 + Math.random() * 40;
            const tx = Math.round(Math.cos(ang) * dist);
            const tz = Math.round(Math.sin(ang) * dist);
            addTree(tx, 1, tz, 'normal');
        }

        // Pond
        for (let dx = -8; dx <= 8; dx++) {
            for (let dz = -8; dz <= 8; dz++) {
                if (dx * dx + dz * dz <= 55) {
                    addVoxel(35 + dx, 1, 25 + dz, colors.water);
                }
            }
        }

        // Bridge over pond
        addBox(28, 2, 22, 42, 4, 28, colors.pagodaWood);

        // Lanterns
        function addLantern(lx, lz) {
            addBox(lx, 1, lz, lx, 7, lz, colors.lanternStone);
            addBox(lx - 1, 7, lz - 1, lx + 1, 8, lz + 1, colors.lanternRed);
            addVoxel(lx, 9, lz, colors.lanternRed);
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            const zz = -50 + i * 9;
            addLantern(-10, zz);
            addLantern(10, zz);
        }

        // Rocks
        function addRockCluster(rx, rz) {
            const numRocks = 6 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8);
            for (let j = 0; j < numRocks; j++) {
                const ox = Math.floor((Math.random() - 0.5) * 5);
                const oy = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) + 1;
                const oz = Math.floor((Math.random() - 0.5) * 5);
                addVoxel(rx + ox, oy, rz + oz, colors.rock);
            }
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            const dist = 15 + Math.random() * 45;
            const rx = Math.round(Math.cos(ang) * dist);
            const rz = Math.round(Math.sin(ang) * dist);
            addRockCluster(rx, rz);
        }

        // Flowers and fallen cherry blossoms
        for (let i = 0; i < 800; i++) {
            const x = Math.floor(-65 + Math.random() * 131);
            const z = Math.floor(-65 + Math.random() * 131);
            const rand = Math.random();
            if (rand < 0.08) {
                addVoxel(x, 2, z, colors.flowerRed);
            } else if (rand < 0.16) {
                addVoxel(x, 2, z, colors.flowerYellow);
            } else if (rand < 0.35) {
                addVoxel(x, 1, z, colors.blossomPink);
            } else if (rand < 0.45) {
                addVoxel(x, 1, z, colors.blossomWhite);
            }
        }

        // Bamboo grove
        for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            const bx = Math.floor(-52 + Math.random() * 12);
            const bz = Math.floor(12 + Math.random() * 20);
            const bh = 12 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 6);
            addBox(bx, 1, bz, bx, bh, bz, colors.trunk);
            addVoxel(bx, bh + 1, bz, colors.bambooTip);
        }

        // Create instanced meshes
        function createInstancedMesh(positions, color) {
            const material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: color });
            material.flatShading = true;
            const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geometry, material, positions.length);
            mesh.castShadow = true;
            mesh.receiveShadow = true;
            const matrix = new THREE.Matrix4();
            positions.forEach((pos, i) => {
                matrix.setPosition(pos);
                mesh.setMatrixAt(i, matrix);
            });
            mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
            scene.add(mesh);
        }

        instances.forEach((positions, color) => {
            createInstancedMesh(positions, color);
        });

        // Camera position
        camera.position.set(45, 28, -55);
        camera.lookAt(0, 15, 0);

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            controls.update();
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // Resize handler
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #87CEEB, #E0F7FF);
        }
        canvas {
            display: block;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.132.2/build/three.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.132.2/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x87CEEB, 0.0005);

        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(30, 20, 30);

        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.setClearColor(0x87CEEB);
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Controls
        const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040, 0.8);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        directionalLight.position.set(50, 100, 50);
        directionalLight.castShadow = true;
        directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 2048;
        directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 2048;
        directionalLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
        directionalLight.shadow.camera.far = 200;
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Voxel geometry helper
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, color, size = 1) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
            const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
                color: color,
                flatShading: true,
                shininess: 0
            });
            const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            voxel.position.set(x, y, z);
            voxel.castShadow = true;
            voxel.receiveShadow = true;
            return voxel;
        }

        // Ground
        function createGround() {
            const groundSize = 100;
            const ground = new THREE.Group();

            // Grass base
            for (let x = -groundSize/2; x < groundSize/2; x += 2) {
                for (let z = -groundSize/2; z < groundSize/2; z += 2) {
                    const grassColor = new THREE.Color(
                        0x4CAF50 + Math.random() * 0x202020
                    );
                    const grass = createVoxel(x, -1, z, grassColor, 2);
                    ground.add(grass);
                }
            }

            // Path
            const pathPoints = [
                {x: -20, z: -20}, {x: -15, z: -10}, {x: -10, z: 0},
                {x: -5, z: 10}, {x: 0, z: 15}, {x: 5, z: 10},
                {x: 10, z: 5}, {x: 15, z: 0}, {x: 20, z: -5}
            ];

            for (let i = 0; i < pathPoints.length; i++) {
                const p1 = pathPoints[i];
                const p2 = pathPoints[i + 1] || p1;

                const steps = 10;
                for (let j = 0; j < steps; j++) {
                    const t = j / steps;
                    const x = p1.x + (p2.x - p1.x) * t;
                    const z = p1.z + (p2.z - p1.z) * t;

                    const stoneColor = new THREE.Color(
                        0x8B4513 + Math.random() * 0x202020
                    );
                    const stone = createVoxel(x, -0.9, z, stoneColor, 1.5);
                    ground.add(stone);
                }
            }

            return ground;
        }

        // Trees
        function createTree(x, z, isCherry = false) {
            const tree = new THREE.Group();
            tree.position.set(x, 0, z);

            // Trunk
            const trunkHeight = 5 + Math.random() * 3;
            for (let y = 0; y < trunkHeight; y++) {
                const trunkColor = new THREE.Color(
                    0x8B4513 + Math.random() * 0x101010
                );
                const trunk = createVoxel(0, y, 0, trunkColor, 1);
                tree.add(trunk);
            }

            // Leaves
            const leafColors = isCherry ?
                [0xFFB6C1, 0xFFC0CB, 0xFF69B4, 0xFF1493] :
                [0x2E8B57, 0x3CB371, 0x20B2AA, 0x90EE90];

            const leafRadius = 3 + Math.random() * 2;
            for (let y = trunkHeight - 1; y < trunkHeight + leafRadius; y++) {
                const radius = leafRadius - (y - trunkHeight);
                for (let dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
                    for (let dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
                        if (Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz) <= radius) {
                            const leafColor = leafColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * leafColors.length)];
                            const leaf = createVoxel(dx, y, dz, leafColor, 1);
                            tree.add(leaf);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Cherry blossoms
            if (isCherry) {
                for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
                    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                    const distance = Math.random() * leafRadius * 0.8;
                    const x = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
                    const z = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
                    const y = trunkHeight + Math.random() * leafRadius * 0.5;

                    const blossomColor = new THREE.Color(
                        0xFFB6C1 + Math.random() * 0x202020
                    );
                    const blossom = createVoxel(x, y, z, blossomColor, 0.5);
                    tree.add(blossom);
                }
            }

            return tree;
        }

        // Pagoda
        function createPagoda() {
            const pagoda = new THREE.Group();

            // Base
            const baseSize = 8;
            for (let x = -baseSize/2; x <= baseSize/2; x++) {
                for (let z = -baseSize/2; z <= baseSize/2; z++) {
                    const baseColor = new THREE.Color(0xD2B48C);
                    const base = createVoxel(x, 0, z, baseColor, 1);
                    pagoda.add(base);
                }
            }

            // First level
            const firstLevelHeight = 5;
            for (let y = 1; y <= firstLevelHeight; y++) {
                const levelSize = baseSize - y * 0.5;
                for (let x = -levelSize/2; x <= levelSize/2; x++) {
                    for (let z = -levelSize/2; z <= levelSize/2; z++) {
                        if (Math.abs(x) === levelSize/2 || Math.abs(z) === levelSize/2) {
                            const wallColor = new THREE.Color(0xCD853F);
                            const wall = createVoxel(x, y, z, wallColor, 1);
                            pagoda.add(wall);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Roof 1
            const roof1Size = baseSize + 2;
            for (let x = -roof1Size/2; x <= roof1Size/2; x++) {
                for (let z = -roof1Size/2; z <= roof1Size/2; z++) {
                    const distance = Math.max(Math.abs(x), Math.abs(z));
                    if (distance <= roof1Size/2 && distance >= roof1Size/2 - 1) {
                        const roofColor = new THREE.Color(0xB22222);
                        const roof = createVoxel(x, firstLevelHeight + 1, z, roofColor, 1);
                        pagoda.add(roof);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Second level
            const secondLevelHeight = 4;
            const secondLevelSize = baseSize - 2;
            for (let y = firstLevelHeight + 2; y <= firstLevelHeight + secondLevelHeight; y++) {
                const levelSize = secondLevelSize - (y - (firstLevelHeight + 2)) * 0.5;
                for (let x = -levelSize/2; x <= levelSize/2; x++) {
                    for (let z = -levelSize/2; z <= levelSize/2; z++) {
                        if (Math.abs(x) === levelSize/2 || Math.abs(z) === levelSize/2) {
                            const wallColor = new THREE.Color(0xCD853F);
                            const wall = createVoxel(x, y, z, wallColor, 1);
                            pagoda.add(wall);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Roof 2
            const roof2Size = secondLevelSize + 2;
            for (let x = -roof2Size/2; x <= roof2Size/2; x++) {
                for (let z = -roof2Size/2; z <= roof2Size/2; z++) {
                    const distance = Math.max(Math.abs(x), Math.abs(z));
                    if (distance <= roof2Size/2 && distance >= roof2Size/2 - 1) {
                        const roofColor = new THREE.Color(0xB22222);
                        const roof = createVoxel(x, firstLevelHeight + secondLevelHeight + 2, z, roofColor, 1);
                        pagoda.add(roof);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Spire
            const spireHeight = 6;
            for (let y = firstLevelHeight + secondLevelHeight + 3; y <= firstLevelHeight + secondLevelHeight + spireHeight; y++) {
                const spireSize = 1 + (spireHeight - (y - (firstLevelHeight + secondLevelHeight + 3))) * 0.2;
                for (let x = -spireSize/2; x <= spireSize/2; x++) {
                    for (let z = -spireSize/2; z <= spireSize/2; z++) {
                        if (Math.abs(x) === spireSize/2 || Math.abs(z) === spireSize/2) {
                            const spireColor = new THREE.Color(0xFFD700);
                            const spire = createVoxel(x, y, z, spireColor, 1);
                            pagoda.add(spire);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Final spire point
            const pointColor = new THREE.Color(0xFFD700);
            const point = createVoxel(0, firstLevelHeight + secondLevelHeight + spireHeight + 1, 0, pointColor, 1);
            pagoda.add(point);

            return pagoda;
        }

        // Lanterns
        function createLantern(x, y, z) {
            const lantern = new THREE.Group();
            lantern.position.set(x, y, z);

            // Base
            const baseColor = new THREE.Color(0xCD853F);
            const base = createVoxel(0, 0, 0, baseColor, 0.8);
            lantern.add(base);

            // Top
            const topColor = new THREE.Color(0xB22222);
            const top = createVoxel(0, 1.5, 0, topColor, 1.2);
            lantern.add(top);

            // Light
            const lightColor = new THREE.Color(0xFFFACD);
            const light = createVoxel(0, 1, 0, lightColor, 0.6);
            lantern.add(light);

            // Add point light
            const pointLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xFFFACD, 1, 10);
            pointLight.position.set(0, 1, 0);
            lantern.add(pointLight);

            return lantern;
        }

        // Create scene elements
        const ground = createGround();
        scene.add(ground);

        const pagoda = createPagoda();
        scene.add(pagoda);

        // Add trees
        const treePositions = [
            {x: -15, z: -10, isCherry: true},
            {x: -20, z: 15, isCherry: false},
            {x: -5, z: -20, isCherry: true},
            {x: 10, z: -15, isCherry: false},
            {x: 15, z: 10, isCherry: true},
            {x: 20, z: -5, isCherry: false},
            {x: -10, z: 20, isCherry: true},
            {x: 5, z: 20, isCherry: false}
        ];

        treePositions.forEach(pos => {
            const tree = createTree(pos.x, pos.z, pos.isCherry);
            scene.add(tree);
        });

        // Add lanterns
        const lanternPositions = [
            {x: -8, y: 2, z: -5},
            {x: 8, y: 2, z: 5},
            {x: -5, y: 2, z: 8},
            {x: 5, y: 2, z: -8},
            {x: 0, y: 2, z: 10},
            {x: 0, y: 2, z: -10}
        ];

        lanternPositions.forEach(pos => {
            const lantern = createLantern(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z);
            scene.add(lantern);
        });

        // Add some floating cherry blossoms
        for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
            const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            const distance = 10 + Math.random() * 15;
            const x = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
            const z = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
            const y = 5 + Math.random() * 10;

            const blossomColor = new THREE.Color(
                0xFFB6C1 + Math.random() * 0x202020
            );
            const blossom = createVoxel(x, y, z, blossomColor, 0.3);
            scene.add(blossom);
        }

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            controls.update();
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<body>

        function init() {

            scene = new THREE.Scene();
            camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
            renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
            document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

            // Lighting
            const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
            scene.add(ambientLight);
            const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
            directionalLight.position.set(10, 20, 5);
            scene.add(directionalLight);

            createGarden();

            // Camera position
            camera.position.set(15, 20, 30);
            camera.lookAt(0, 5, 0);

            // Controls
            const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);

            // Animation
            animate();
        }

        function createPagoda() {
            pagoda = new THREE.Group();
            const colors = {
                roof: [0xFF4444, 0xFF8888, 0xFFAAAA],
                walls: 0xF4E9D6,
                base: 0x664422
            };

            // Base platform
            createLayer(0, -1, 0, 14, 1, 14, colors.base);

            // Tower layers
            for(let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                const height = i * 4;
                const width = 10 - i * 2;
                createLayer(0, height, 0, width, 2, width, colors.walls);
                createRoof(0, height + 2, 0, width + 2, colors.roof[i % 3]);
                
                // Add decorative corners
                if(i < 4) createUpwardCurveDecorations(width, height + 2);
            }

            scene.add(pagoda);
        }

        function createLayer(x, y, z, w, h, d, color) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d);
            const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: color });
            const layer = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            layer.position.set(x, y + h/2, z);
            pagoda.add(layer);
        }

        function createRoof(x, y, z, size, color) {
            const roof = new THREE.Group();
            const base = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.BoxGeometry(size + 0.5, 0.5, size + 0.5),
                new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: color })
            );
            base.position.set(x, y + 0.25, z);
            
            const pyramid = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.ConeGeometry(size * 0.8, 2, 4),
                new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: color })
            );
            pyramid.rotation.y = Math.PI/4;
            pyramid.position.set(x, y + 1.25, z);
            
            roof.add(base);
            roof.add(pyramid);
            pagoda.add(roof);
        }

        function createUpwardCurveDecorations(size, height) {
            const curvePoints = [];
            for(let i = 0; i <= 5; i++) {
                curvePoints.push(new THREE.Vector3(
                    Math.cos(i * Math.PI/10) * size/2,
                    i * 0.2,
                    Math.sin(i * Math.PI/10) * size/2
                ));
            }

            const curveGeometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(curvePoints);
            const curveMaterial = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xFFD700 });
            const curve = new THREE.Line(curveGeometry, curveMaterial);
            curve.position.y = height;
            pagoda.add(curve);
        }

        function createGarden() {
            // Ground
            const ground = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100),
                new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: 0x88FF88 })
            );
            ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
            scene.add(ground);

            // Trees
            const treePositions = [
                [-20, 0, -15], [15, 0, -20], [-10, 0, 25],
                [25, 0, 10], [-25, 0, 10], [10, 0, -25]
            ];

            treePositions.forEach(pos => {
                const tree = createTree(pos[0], pos[1], pos[2]);
                scene.add(tree);
            });

            // Cherry blossom particles
            createFallingBlossoms();
        }

        function createTree(x, y, z) {
            const tree = new THREE.Group();
            
            // Trunk
            const trunk = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 5 + Math.random() * 3, 1),
                new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: 0x4A2B0F })
            );
            trunk.position.set(x, y + 2.5, z);
            
            // Foliage
            const foliage = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.SphereGeometry(3 + Math.random() * 2),
                new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ 
                    color: Math.random() > 0.5 ? 0x88FF88 : 0xFF8888,
                    transparent: true,
                    opacity: 0.8
                })
            );
            foliage.position.set(x, y + 6 + Math.random() * 2, z);
            
            tree.add(trunk);
            tree.add(foliage);
            
            // Add blossoms if pink foliage
            if(foliage.material.color.getHex() === 0xFF8888) {
                addCherryBlossoms(foliage.position);
            }

            return tree;
        }

        function addCherryBlossoms(position) {
            const blossoms = new THREE.Group();
            for(let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                const blossom = new THREE.Mesh(
                    new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.1),
                    new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: 0xFFB5E8 })
                );
                blossom.position.copy(position);
                blossom.position.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4;
                blossom.position.y += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
                blossom.position.z += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4;
                blossoms.add(blossom);
            }
            scene.add(blossoms);
        }

        function createFallingBlossoms() {
            const blossoms = new THREE.Group();
            const geometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.1);
            const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: 0xFFB5E8 });
            
            for(let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
                const blossom = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
                blossom.position.set(
                    Math.random() * 50 - 25,
                    Math.random() * 20,
                    Math.random() * 50 - 25
                );
                blossom.userData.velocity = Math.random() * 0.02;
                blossoms.add(blossom);
            }
            
            scene.add(blossoms);
            return blossoms;
        }

        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);

            // Rotate pagoda slowly
            if(pagoda) pagoda.rotation.y += 0.002;

            // Animate falling blossoms
            scene.traverse(obj => {
                if(obj instanceof THREE.Mesh && obj.material.color.getHex() === 0xFFB5E8) {
                    obj.position.y -= obj.userData.velocity;
                    obj.material.opacity *= 0.998;
                    if(obj.position.y < 0 || obj.material.opacity < 0.1) {
                        obj.position.y = 20;
                        obj.material.opacity = 1;
                    }
                }
            });

            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);
        function onWindowResize() {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        }

        init();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        camera.lookAt(0, 5, 0);

        // Animation loop

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.132.2/build/three.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.132.2/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB); // Sky blue

        // Camera
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(30, 20, 30);

        // Renderer
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Controls
        const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040, 0.5);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        directionalLight.position.set(50, 100, 50);
        directionalLight.castShadow = true;
        directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 2048;
        directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 2048;
        directionalLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
        directionalLight.shadow.camera.far = 200;
        directionalLight.shadow.camera.left = -50;
        directionalLight.shadow.camera.right = 50;
        directionalLight.shadow.camera.top = 50;
        directionalLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -50;
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Voxel geometry helper
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, color, size = 1) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
            const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
                color: color,
                flatShading: true
            });
            const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            voxel.position.set(x, y, z);
            voxel.castShadow = true;
            voxel.receiveShadow = true;
            return voxel;
        }

        // Ground
        function createGround() {
            const groundSize = 100;
            const ground = new THREE.Group();

            // Grass base
            for (let x = -groundSize/2; x < groundSize/2; x += 1) {
                for (let z = -groundSize/2; z < groundSize/2; z += 1) {
                    const grassColor = new THREE.Color(
                        0.3 + Math.random() * 0.1,
                        0.5 + Math.random() * 0.1,
                        0.2 + Math.random() * 0.1
                    );
                    const voxel = createVoxel(x, -0.5, z, grassColor, 1);
                    ground.add(voxel);
                }
            }

            // Path
            for (let i = -20; i <= 20; i++) {
                const pathColor = new THREE.Color(0.8, 0.7, 0.6);
                const pathVoxel1 = createVoxel(i, -0.4, 0, pathColor, 1);
                const pathVoxel2 = createVoxel(0, -0.4, i, pathColor, 1);
                ground.add(pathVoxel1);
                ground.add(pathVoxel2);
            }

            scene.add(ground);
        }

        // Trees
        function createTree(x, z, height = 8, isCherry = false) {
            const tree = new THREE.Group();
            tree.position.set(x, 0, z);

            // Trunk
            const trunkHeight = height * 0.3;
            for (let y = 0; y < trunkHeight; y++) {
                const trunkColor = new THREE.Color(0.5, 0.35, 0.2);
                const trunkVoxel = createVoxel(0, y, 0, trunkColor, 1);
                tree.add(trunkVoxel);

                if (y % 2 === 0) {
                    const branchLength = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2) + 1;
                    for (let i = 1; i <= branchLength; i++) {
                        const branchVoxel = createVoxel(i, y, 0, trunkColor, 1);
                        tree.add(branchVoxel);
                        const branchVoxel2 = createVoxel(-i, y, 0, trunkColor, 1);
                        tree.add(branchVoxel2);
                        const branchVoxel3 = createVoxel(0, y, i, trunkColor, 1);
                        tree.add(branchVoxel3);
                        const branchVoxel4 = createVoxel(0, y, -i, trunkColor, 1);
                        tree.add(branchVoxel4);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Leaves
            const leafHeight = height - trunkHeight;
            const leafRadius = Math.floor(height * 0.3);

            for (let y = trunkHeight; y < height; y++) {
                const radius = leafRadius * (1 - (y - trunkHeight) / leafHeight);

                for (let i = -radius; i <= radius; i++) {
                    for (let j = -radius; j <= radius; j++) {
                        if (Math.sqrt(i*i + j*j) <= radius) {
                            let leafColor;
                            if (isCherry) {
                                leafColor = new THREE.Color(
                                    0.9 + Math.random() * 0.1,
                                    0.6 + Math.random() * 0.1,
                                    0.7 + Math.random() * 0.1
                                );
                            } else {
                                leafColor = new THREE.Color(
                                    0.2 + Math.random() * 0.1,
                                    0.6 + Math.random() * 0.1,
                                    0.2 + Math.random() * 0.1
                                );
                            }
                            const leafVoxel = createVoxel(i, y, j, leafColor, 1);
                            tree.add(leafVoxel);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Cherry blossoms
            if (isCherry) {
                for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
                    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                    const distance = Math.random() * leafRadius * 0.8;
                    const x = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
                    const z = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
                    const y = trunkHeight + Math.random() * leafHeight;

                    const blossomColor = new THREE.Color(
                        0.95 + Math.random() * 0.05,
                        0.7 + Math.random() * 0.1,
                        0.8 + Math.random() * 0.1
                    );
                    const blossom = createVoxel(x, y, z, blossomColor, 0.7);
                    tree.add(blossom);
                }
            }

            scene.add(tree);
        }

        // Pagoda
        function createPagoda() {
            const pagoda = new THREE.Group();
            const levels = 5;
            const baseSize = 8;
            const height = 20;

            // Base
            for (let x = -baseSize/2; x <= baseSize/2; x++) {
                for (let z = -baseSize/2; z <= baseSize/2; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x) === baseSize/2 || Math.abs(z) === baseSize/2) {
                        const baseColor = new THREE.Color(0.8, 0.7, 0.6);
                        const baseVoxel = createVoxel(x, 0, z, baseColor, 1);
                        pagoda.add(baseVoxel);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Levels
            for (let level = 0; level < levels; level++) {
                const levelHeight = height * (level + 1) / levels;
                const levelSize = baseSize * (1 - level * 0.15);

                // Platform
                for (let x = -levelSize/2; x <= levelSize/2; x++) {
                    for (let z = -levelSize/2; z <= levelSize/2; z++) {
                        if (Math.abs(x) === levelSize/2 || Math.abs(z) === levelSize/2) {
                            const platformColor = new THREE.Color(0.8, 0.7, 0.6);
                            const platformVoxel = createVoxel(x, levelHeight, z, platformColor, 1);
                            pagoda.add(platformVoxel);
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Roof
                const roofSize = levelSize + 2;
                const roofHeight = levelHeight + 2;

                for (let x = -roofSize/2; x <= roofSize/2; x++) {
                    for (let z = -roofSize/2; z <= roofSize/2; z++) {
                        const distance = Math.sqrt(x*x + z*z);
                        if (distance <= roofSize/2 && distance >= roofSize/2 - 1) {
                            const roofColor = new THREE.Color(0.5, 0.2, 0.1);
                            const roofVoxel = createVoxel(x, roofHeight, z, roofColor, 1);
                            pagoda.add(roofVoxel);
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Roof tip
                const tipColor = new THREE.Color(0.8, 0.6, 0.2);
                const tipVoxel = createVoxel(0, roofHeight + 1, 0, tipColor, 1);
                pagoda.add(tipVoxel);
            }

            // Details
            for (let level = 0; level < levels; level++) {
                const levelHeight = height * (level + 1) / levels;
                const levelSize = baseSize * (1 - level * 0.15);

                // Columns
                for (let x = -levelSize/2 + 1; x <= levelSize/2 - 1; x += 2) {
                    for (let z = -levelSize/2 + 1; z <= levelSize/2 - 1; z += 2) {
                        if (Math.abs(x) === levelSize/2 - 1 || Math.abs(z) === levelSize/2 - 1) {
                            const columnColor = new THREE.Color(0.6, 0.4, 0.2);
                            for (let y = levelHeight; y < levelHeight + 2; y++) {
                                const columnVoxel = createVoxel(x, y, z, columnColor, 0.8);
                                pagoda.add(columnVoxel);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Railings
                for (let x = -levelSize/2; x <= levelSize/2; x++) {
                    for (let z = -levelSize/2; z <= levelSize/2; z++) {
                        if (Math.abs(x) === levelSize/2 || Math.abs(z) === levelSize/2) {
                            if (x % 2 === 0 || z % 2 === 0) {
                                const railingColor = new THREE.Color(0.7, 0.5, 0.3);
                                const railingVoxel = createVoxel(x, levelHeight + 1, z, railingColor, 0.5);
                                pagoda.add(railingVoxel);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            scene.add(pagoda);
        }

        // Lanterns
        function createLantern(x, y, z) {
            const lantern = new THREE.Group();
            lantern.position.set(x, y, z);

            // Base
            const baseColor = new THREE.Color(0.8, 0.6, 0.4);
            const baseVoxel = createVoxel(0, 0, 0, baseColor, 0.8);
            lantern.add(baseVoxel);

            // Post
            for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
                const postVoxel = createVoxel(0, i, 0, baseColor, 0.5);
                lantern.add(postVoxel);
            }

            // Lantern body
            const bodyColor = new THREE.Color(0.9, 0.8, 0.6);
            for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
                for (let j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {
                    if (Math.abs(i) + Math.abs(j) <= 1) {
                        const bodyVoxel = createVoxel(i, 4, j, bodyColor, 0.8);
                        lantern.add(bodyVoxel);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Light
            const lightColor = new THREE.Color(0.9, 0.7, 0.3);
            const lightVoxel = createVoxel(0, 4, 0, lightColor, 0.6);
            lantern.add(lightVoxel);

            // Top
            const topColor = new THREE.Color(0.7, 0.5, 0.3);
            const topVoxel = createVoxel(0, 5, 0, topColor, 0.8);
            lantern.add(topVoxel);

            scene.add(lantern);
        }

        // Rocks
        function createRock(x, z, size = 3) {
            const rock = new THREE.Group();
            rock.position.set(x, 0, z);

            const rockColor = new THREE.Color(
                0.4 + Math.random() * 0.1,
                0.4 + Math.random() * 0.1,
                0.4 + Math.random() * 0.1
            );

            for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (let j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    for (let k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                        if (Math.random() > 0.5) {
                            const voxel = createVoxel(
                                i - size/2,
                                k,
                                j - size/2,
                                rockColor,
                                1
                            );
                            rock.add(voxel);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            scene.add(rock);
        }

        // Create scene elements
        function initScene() {
            createGround();
            createPagoda();

            // Trees
            createTree(15, 15, 10);
            createTree(-15, 15, 12);
            createTree(15, -15, 9);
            createTree(-15, -15, 11);
            createTree(0, 20, 13);
            createTree(0, -20, 10);
            createTree(20, 0, 12);
            createTree(-20, 0, 9);

            // Cherry trees
            createTree(10, 10, 8, true);
            createTree(-10, 10, 7, true);
            createTree(10, -10, 9, true);
            createTree(-10, -10, 8, true);

            // Lanterns
            createLantern(5, 0, 5);
            createLantern(-5, 0, 5);
            createLantern(5, 0, -5);
            createLantern(-5, 0, -5);
            createLantern(0, 0, 8);
            createLantern(0, 0, -8);
            createLantern(8, 0, 0);
            createLantern(-8, 0, 0);

            // Rocks
            createRock(12, 12, 2);
            createRock(-12, 12, 3);
            createRock(12, -12, 2);
            createRock(-12, -12, 3);
            createRock(18, 5, 2);
            createRock(-18, -5, 3);
        }

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            controls.update();
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        initScene();
        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }</style>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://threejs.org/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB); // Sky blue
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(0, 10, 20);
        
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        const sunLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffdd88, 1);
        sunLight.position.set(10, 20, 10);
        scene.add(sunLight);

        // Materials
        const materials = {
            wood: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x8B4513 }),
            roof: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xD2691E }),
            gold: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xFFD700, emissive: 0x332200 }),
            stone: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x808080 }),
            grass: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x2E8B57 }),
            cherry: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xFFB7C5 }),
            leaf: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x32CD32 })
        };

        // Voxel Building Functions
        function createCube(x, y, z, size, material) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
            const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
            return mesh;
        }

        // Pagoda Construction
        function buildPagoda() {
            const pagoda = new THREE.Group();

            // Base platform
            for (let i = -4; i <= 4; i++) {
                for (let j = -4; j <= 4; j++) {
                    if (Math.sqrt(i*i + j*j) <= 4) {
                        pagoda.add(createCube(i*1.2, 0, j*1.2, 1, materials.stone));
                    }
                }
            }

            // Main tower (4 levels)
            const levels = [2, 3, 2, 1];
            let height = 0;
            levels.forEach((level, idx) => {
                const radius = 2 - idx * 0.5;
                for (let az = 0; az < Math.PI * 2; az += Math.PI / 8) {
                    for (let r = 0; r < radius; r += 0.8) {
                        const x = Math.cos(az) * r;
                        const z = Math.sin(az) * r;
                        pagoda.add(createCube(x, height + 1, z, 1, materials.wood));
                    }
                }
                // Roofs
                const roofRadius = radius + 0.5;
                for (let az = 0; az < Math.PI * 2; az += Math.PI / 12) {
                    for (let r = roofRadius; r <= roofRadius + 1; r += 0.4) {
                        const x = Math.cos(az) * r;
                        const z = Math.sin(az) * r;
                        pagoda.add(createCube(x, height + level, z, 1, materials.roof));
                    }
                }
                // Golden accents
                if (idx === levels.length - 1) {
                    for (let az = 0; az < Math.PI * 2; az += Math.PI / 6) {
                        const r = roofRadius + 1.2;
                        const x = Math.cos(az) * r;
                        const z = Math.sin(az) * r;
                        pagoda.add(createCube(x, height + level + 0.5, z, 0.5, materials.gold));
                    }
                }
                height += level;
            });

            pagoda.position.y = 1;
            scene.add(pagoda);
        }

        // Garden Elements
        function buildGarden() {
            // Ground
            for (let x = -20; x <= 20; x += 1) {
                for (let z = -20; z <= 20; z -= 1) {
                    if (Math.sqrt(x*x + z*z) < 18) {
                        scene.add(createCube(x, -0.5, z, 1, materials.grass));
                    }
                }
            }

            // Trees
            for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
                const tree = new THREE.Group();
                const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 5;
                const x = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
                const z = Math.sin(angle) * radius;

                // Trunk
                for (let y = 0; y < 4; y++) {
                    tree.add(createCube(x, y + 0.5, z, 0.5, materials.wood));
                }

                // Leaves
                for (let y = 3; y < 6; y++) {
                    for (let az = 0; az < Math.PI * 2; az += Math.PI / 8) {
                        for (let r = 0; r < 2; r += 0.6) {
                            const lx = x + Math.cos(az) * r;
                            const lz = z + Math.sin(az) * r;
                            tree.add(createCube(lx, y, lz, 0.8, materials.leaf));
                        }
                    }
                }
                scene.add(tree);
            }

            // Cherry Blossoms
            for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
                const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const radius = 5 + Math.random() * 10;
                const x = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
                const z = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
                const y = 5 + Math.random() * 3;
                scene.add(createCube(x, y, z, 0.3, materials.cherry));
            }
        }

        // Build scene
        buildPagoda();
        buildGarden();

        // Camera controls
        const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            controls.update();
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // Resize handler
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Voxel Art Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            background-color: #f0f8ff;
        }
        canvas {
            display: block;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.128.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xf0f8ff);

        // Camera setup
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(30, 20, 30);

        // Renderer setup
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Controls
        const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        directionalLight.position.set(1, 1, 1);
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Voxel material
        const voxelMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
            color: 0xffffff,
            flatShading: true,
            vertexColors: true
        });

        // Create a voxel
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
            const material = voxelMaterial.clone();
            material.color.set(color);
            const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            voxel.position.set(x, y, z);
            return voxel;
        }

        // Create the pagoda
        function createPagoda() {
            const pagoda = new THREE.Group();

            // Base
            for (let x = -3; x <= 3; x++) {
                for (let z = -3; z <= 3; z++) {
                    pagoda.add(createVoxel(x, 0, z, 0x8B4513)); // Brown base
                }
            }

            // Pillars
            for (let x = -2; x <= 2; x += 4) {
                for (let z = -2; z <= 2; z += 4) {
                    for (let y = 1; y <= 5; y++) {
                        pagoda.add(createVoxel(x, y, z, 0xFFD700)); // Gold pillars
                    }
                }
            }

            // Roof levels
            const roofColors = [0xFF0000, 0x00FF00, 0x0000FF, 0xFFFF00, 0xFF00FF];
            for (let level = 0; level < 3; level++) {
                const size = 4 - level;
                const height = 6 + level * 2;
                const color = roofColors[level % roofColors.length];

                for (let x = -size; x <= size; x++) {
                    for (let z = -size; z <= size; z++) {
                        if (Math.abs(x) === size || Math.abs(z) === size) {
                            pagoda.add(createVoxel(x, height, z, color));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Top ornament
            pagoda.add(createVoxel(0, 12, 0, 0xFFD700)); // Gold top

            return pagoda;
        }

        // Create a tree
        function createTree(x, z) {
            const tree = new THREE.Group();

            // Trunk
            for (let y = 0; y < 4; y++) {
                tree.add(createVoxel(x, y, z, 0x8B4513)); // Brown trunk
            }

            // Leaves
            const leafColors = [0x228B22, 0x32CD32, 0x00FF00];
            for (let y = 3; y < 7; y++) {
                for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
                    for (let dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) {
                        if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dz) <= 2) {
                            const color = leafColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * leafColors.length)];
                            tree.add(createVoxel(x + dx, y, z + dz, color));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            return tree;
        }

        // Create cherry blossom
        function createCherryBlossom(x, z) {
            const blossom = new THREE.Group();

            // Trunk
            for (let y = 0; y < 3; y++) {
                blossom.add(createVoxel(x, y, z, 0x8B4513)); // Brown trunk
            }

            // Blossoms
            const blossomColors = [0xFFB6C1, 0xFF69B4, 0xFF1493];
            for (let y = 2; y < 6; y++) {
                for (let dx = -3; dx <= 3; dx++) {
                    for (let dz = -3; dz <= 3; dz++) {
                        if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dz) <= 3) {
                            const color = blossomColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * blossomColors.length)];
                            blossom.add(createVoxel(x + dx, y, z + dz, color));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            return blossom;
        }

        // Create the garden
        function createGarden() {
            const garden = new THREE.Group();

            // Ground
            for (let x = -20; x <= 20; x++) {
                for (let z = -20; z <= 20; z++) {
                    garden.add(createVoxel(x, -1, z, 0x228B22)); // Green ground
                }
            }

            // Path
            for (let x = -10; x <= 10; x++) {
                for (let z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {
                    garden.add(createVoxel(x, -0.5, z, 0xD2B48C)); // Tan path
                }
            }

            // Trees
            const treePositions = [
                [-15, -10], [-10, -15], [10, -15], [15, -10],
                [-15, 10], [-10, 15], [10, 15], [15, 10]
            ];

            treePositions.forEach(pos => {
                garden.add(createTree(pos[0], pos[1]));
            });

            // Cherry blossoms
            const blossomPositions = [
                [-5, -10], [5, -10], [-5, 10], [5, 10]
            ];

            blossomPositions.forEach(pos => {
                garden.add(createCherryBlossom(pos[0], pos[1]));
            });

            // Pagoda
            garden.add(createPagoda());

            return garden;
        }

        // Add the garden to the scene
        scene.add(createGarden());

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            controls.update();
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });

        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

content:
**Creación de Escena de Arte Voxel: Un Pagoda en un Jardín Exuberante con Cerezos en Flor**  

**Objetivo:** Crear una escena 3D envolvente en la web que presente un pagoda espectacular, rodeado de cerezos en flor, insertado en un jardín vibrante y detallado, utilizando técnicas de arte voxel. La escena debe ser visualmente impactante, colorida y variada, optimizada para una sola página web con Three.js.  

**1. Configuración del Escenario (Three.js Scene Setup)**  
```javascript
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
```

**2. Creación del Pagoda (Voxel Art Techniques)**  
- Usar `THREE.BoxGeometry` para construir la estructura del pagoda, controlando cuidadosamente la posición de cada caja para formar las capas y detalles.  
- Aplicar `MeshStandardMaterial` con colores cálidos (rojos, dorados) para los techos y materiales de madera para las paredes.  
- Añadir detalles decorativos como linternas flotantes (cajas pequeñas con luces puntuales) alrededor del pagoda para un efecto místico.  

**3. Elementos del Jardín (Garden Elements)**  
- Generar árboles de cerezo con `THREE.Points` para los pétalos flotando. Usar pequeñas texturas de pétalos rosa y distribuir aleatoriamente alrededor de las ramas.  
- Colocar árboles voxelados con múltiples capas de ramas y hojas, usando `THREE.Group` para cada árbol. Variar las formas y tamaños para un efecto realista.  
- Incluir un estanque con peces Koi (modelados como cubos pequeños con colores vibrantes) nadando entre nenúfares, generados con `THREE.PlaneGeometry`.  

**4. Iluminación y Efectos Visuales (Lighting and Post-Processing)**  
- Usar `THREE.DirectionalLight` con sombras para la luz del sol, simulando un atardecer. Complementar con luces de ambiente para realzar los colores.  
- Aplicar efectos como niebla suave (`THREE.FogExp2`) para crear atmósfera y un efecto de desenfoque en los elementos de fondo.  

**5. Detalles y Composición (Scene Composition)**  
- Agregar elementos decorativos como puentes de madera, pagodas pequeños y estatuas tradicionales.  
- Usar plataformas elevadas para dar profundidad al jardín, con caminos de piedra que conduzcan al pagoda central.  

**6. Optimización para la Web (Performance Optimization)**  
- Limitar el número de luces y usar sombras optimizadas para rendimiento en navegadores.  
- Asegurar que todos los elementos se rendericen eficientemente en dispositivos móviles y de escritorio.  

**Resultado:** Una página web interactiva y visualmente atractiva con Three.js, donde el usuario puede explorar un pagoda impresionante rodeado de naturaleza vibrante y detallada, optimizada para dispositivos de escritorio y móviles. **La escena se ajusta a las mejores prácticas de diseño web y rendering 3D, garantizando una experiencia inmersiva y eficiente.**  

**Tutorial y Referencias para el Usuario:**  
- Para profundizar, consulta documentación de Three.js, tutoriales de modelado voxel y guías de iluminación realista.  
- Ejemplo de código: [Código de Three.js](https://threejs.org/docs/) y [Tutoriales de Arte Voxel](https://voxel-art.com).  

**Nota:** Este diseño combina tradición japonesa con tecnología moderna, ofreciendo una experiencia única y cautivadora en la web.

<title>Voxel Garden – Pagoda & Cherry Blossoms</title>
<style>
  body { margin:0; overflow:hidden; background:#87ceeb; }
  canvas { display:block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.158.0/build/three.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.158.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
<script>
// ----- Boilerplate -----
let scene, camera, renderer, controls;
init();
animate();

function init() {
  // Scene & Camera
  scene = new THREE.Scene();
  camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
  camera.position.set(30, 30, 40);
  // Renderer
  renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
  // Controls
  controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
  controls.enableDamping = true;
  // Light
  const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
  scene.add(ambient);
  const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
  dirLight.position.set(20, 40, 10);
  scene.add(dirLight);
  // Resize handling
  window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize);
}

// ----- Voxel Helpers -----
const voxelSize = 1;
const voxelGeom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(voxelSize, voxelSize, voxelSize);
function addVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
  const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color});
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(voxelGeom, mat);
  mesh.position.set(x*voxelSize, y*voxelSize, z*voxelSize);
  scene.add(mesh);
}

// ----- Ground -----
function createGround(width, depth) {
  const grass = 0x6ab04c;
  for(let i=-width/2;i<width/2;i++) {
    for(let j=-depth/2;j<depth/2;j++) {
      addVoxel(i, 0, j, grass);
    }
  }
}
createGround(40, 40);

// ----- Trees -----
function createTree(baseX, baseZ, height, hasBlossoms) {
  const trunkColor = 0x8b4513;
  const leafColor = 0x2ecc71;
  const blossomColor = 0xff6b81;
  // Trunk
  for(let y=1; y<=height; y++) {
    addVoxel(baseX, y, baseZ, trunkColor);
  }
  // Leaves (simple sphere)
  const leafRadius = Math.round(height/2);
  for(let x=-leafRadius; x<=leafRadius; x++) {
    for(let y=-leafRadius; y<=leafRadius; y++) {
      for(let z=-leafRadius; z<=leafRadius; z++) {
        const dist = Math.sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z);
        if(dist <= leafRadius) {
          const col = (hasBlossoms && Math.random()<0.15) ? blossomColor : leafColor;
          addVoxel(baseX+x, height+y, baseZ+z, col);
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

// Scatter a few trees
createTree(-12, -8, 6, true);
createTree( 10, -12, 5, false);
createTree( -5,  14, 7, true);
createTree( 13,  9, 6, false);

// ----- Pagoda -----
function createPagoda(cx, cz) {
  const baseHeight = 2;
  const tierHeight = 3;
  const tiers = 4;
  const tierSize = 12; // width of the lowest tier (in voxels)
  const colors = [0xd35400, 0xf39c12, 0xe67e22, 0xf1c40f]; // warm palette

  // Main body
  for(let t=0; t<tiers; t++) {
    const size = tierSize - t*2; // each tier shrinks by 2 voxels
    const y0 = baseHeight + t*tierHeight;
    const col = colors[t % colors.length];
    for(let x=-size/2; x<size/2; x++) {
      for(let z=-size/2; z<size/2; z++) {
        for(let y=0; y<tierHeight; y++) {
          addVoxel(cx+x, y0+y, cz+z, col);
        }
      }
    }
    // Roof eaves (simple overhang)
    const roofHeight = y0 + tierHeight;
    const overhang = 1;
    for(let x=-size/2-overhang; x<size/2+overhang; x++) {
      for(let z=-size/2-overhang; z<size/2+overhang; z++) {
        if(Math.abs(x)===size/2+overhang || Math.abs(z)===size/2+overhang) {
          addVoxel(cx+x, roofHeight, cz+z, 0xc0392b);
        }
      }
    }
    // Roof slab
    for(let x=-size/2; x<size/2; x++) {
      for(let z=-size/2; z<size/2; z++) {
        addVoxel(cx+x, roofHeight+1, cz+z, 0xc0392b);
      }
    }
  }

  // Central pillar
  const pillarHeight = baseHeight + tiers*tierHeight + 4;
  for(let y=1; y<pillarHeight; y++) {
    addVoxel(cx, y, cz, 0x7f8c8d);
  }

  // Lanterns (simple cubes)
  const lanternColor = 0xf1c40f;
  const lanternOffsets = [
    [ -4, pillarHeight, -4],
    [  4, pillarHeight, -4],
    [ -4, pillarHeight,  4],
    [  4, pillarHeight,  4]
  ];
  lanternOffsets.forEach(o=> {
    addVoxel(cx+o[0], o[1], cz+o[2], lanternColor);
    addVoxel(cx+o[0], o[1]+1, cz+o[2], lanternColor);
  });
}
createPagoda(0,0);

// ----- Animation Loop -----
function animate() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  controls.update();
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

// ----- Resize -----
function onWindowResize() {
  camera.aspect = window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
