question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
  <style>
    html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #87c6ff; }
    canvas { display: block; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from "https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js";
import { OrbitControls } from "https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js";

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x9ed6ff);
scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x9ed6ff, 90, 210);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55, innerWidth / innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
camera.position.set(55, 42, 72);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
renderer.setPixelRatio(devicePixelRatio);
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.target.set(0, 12, 8);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.maxPolarAngle = Math.PI * 0.48;
controls.minDistance = 30;
controls.maxDistance = 180;

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xdff3ff, 0x4f5d3d, 0.8));

const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.0);
sun.position.set(70, 90, 30);
sun.castShadow = true;
sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
sun.shadow.camera.near = 1;
sun.shadow.camera.far = 260;
sun.shadow.camera.left = -90;
sun.shadow.camera.right = 90;
sun.shadow.camera.top = 90;
sun.shadow.camera.bottom = -90;
scene.add(sun);

// ---------- Utilities ----------
const fract = (v) => v - Math.floor(v);
const hash2 = (x, z) => fract(Math.sin(x * 127.1 + z * 311.7) * 43758.5453123);

function mulberry32(a) {
  return function() {
    let t = a += 0x6D2B79F5;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
const rand = mulberry32(1337);

// ---------- Voxel batching ----------
const voxelsByColor = new Map();
function addVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
  const key = color >>> 0;
  if (!voxelsByColor.has(key)) voxelsByColor.set(key, []);
  voxelsByColor.get(key).push([x, y, z]);
}
function addBox(x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1, color) {
  for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++)
    for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++)
      for (let z = z0; z <= z1; z++)
        addVoxel(x, y, z, color);
}

// ---------- Palette ----------
const C = {
  GRASS: 0x66b95a,
  GRASS2: 0x75c967,
  DIRT: 0x8d6a4f,
  STONE: 0x9da4ac,
  STONE2: 0xb5bcc5,
  PATH: 0xc9b38f,
  SAND: 0xd9c291,
  WATER: 0x57a7e6,
  WOOD: 0x7a4f2f,
  WOOD_DARK: 0x5a3621,
  RED: 0xb73b3f,
  GOLD: 0xe2b545,
  ROOF: 0x2d343f,
  ROOF2: 0x3a4551,
  WALL: 0xe8ddc8,
  LANTERN: 0xffc56a,
  LEAF_G: 0x3d8f46,
  LEAF_G2: 0x4ca85b,
  LEAF_O: 0xd58a3e,
  CHERRY: 0xf4a8cb,
  CHERRY2: 0xf8c4de,
  CHERRY3: 0xffffff,
  FLOWER_R: 0xe84f5f,
  FLOWER_B: 0x5d82ff,
  FLOWER_Y: 0xf4d44f,
  BRIDGE: 0xad2f34
};

function terrainHeight(x, z) {
  let h = Math.floor(
    2 +
    1.35 * Math.sin(x * 0.16) +
    1.2 * Math.cos(z * 0.13) +
    0.8 * Math.sin((x + z) * 0.09)
  );
  h = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, h));
  if (Math.abs(x) <= 14 && Math.abs(z - 10) <= 14) h = 3; // pagoda plateau
  return h;
}
function isPond(x, z) {
  const dx = (x + 20) / 9.5;
  const dz = (z - 12) / 7.5;
  return dx * dx + dz * dz < 1.0;
}
function isPath(x, z) {
  const cx = Math.sin((z + 40) * 0.13) * 2.5;
  return z < 14 && z > -45 && Math.abs(x - cx) < 3.2;
}

// ---------- Terrain ----------
for (let x = -50; x <= 50; x++) {
  for (let z = -50; z <= 50; z++) {
    let h = terrainHeight(x, z);
    const pond = isPond(x, z);
    if (pond) h = 1;
    for (let y = -2; y < h; y++) addVoxel(x, y, z, C.DIRT);

    let top = C.GRASS;
    const hv = hash2(x, z);
    if (pond) {
      const rim = ((x + 20) / 9.5) ** 2 + ((z - 12) / 7.5) ** 2;
      top = rim > 0.78 ? C.SAND : C.WATER;
    } else if (isPath(x, z)) {
      top = C.PATH;
    } else {
      top = hv > 0.45 ? C.GRASS : C.GRASS2;
    }
    addVoxel(x, h, z, top);
  }
}

// ---------- Bridge over pond ----------
(function buildBridge() {
  const cx = -20, cz = 12, yBase = 3;
  for (let i = -6; i <= 6; i++) {
    const y = yBase + Math.floor(Math.sin((i + 6) / 12 * Math.PI) * 2);
    addVoxel(cx + i, y, cz, C.BRIDGE);
    addVoxel(cx + i, y, cz + 1, C.BRIDGE);
    if (i % 2 === 0 && Math.abs(i) > 1) {
      addVoxel(cx + i, y + 1, cz - 1, C.BRIDGE);
      addVoxel(cx + i, y + 1, cz + 2, C.BRIDGE);
    }
  }
})();

// ---------- Pagoda ----------
function buildRoof(cx, y, cz, half) {
  for (let l = 0; l < 4; l++) {
    const r = half + 3 - l;
    for (let x = -r; x <= r; x++) {
      for (let z = -r; z <= r; z++) {
        addVoxel(cx + x, y + l, cz + z, (l % 2 === 0) ? C.ROOF : C.ROOF2);
      }
    }
  }
  const rr = half + 3;
  for (let x = -rr; x <= rr; x++) {
    addVoxel(cx + x, y, cz - rr, C.GOLD);
    addVoxel(cx + x, y, cz + rr, C.GOLD);
  }
  for (let z = -rr; z <= rr; z++) {
    addVoxel(cx - rr, y, cz + z, C.GOLD);
    addVoxel(cx + rr, y, cz + z, C.GOLD);
  }
  // upturned corners
  [[-1,-1],[1,-1],[-1,1],[1,1]].forEach(([sx, sz]) => {
    addVoxel(cx + sx * (rr + 1), y + 1, cz + sz * (rr + 1), C.ROOF2);
    addVoxel(cx + sx * (rr + 2), y + 2, cz + sz * (rr + 2), C.ROOF2);
  });
  return y + 4;
}

function buildLevel(cx, cz, floorY, half, wallH) {
  addBox(cx - half, cx + half, floorY, floorY, cz - half, cz + half, C.WOOD);

  // rail
  for (let x = -half; x <= half; x++) {
    addVoxel(cx + x, floorY + 1, cz - half, C.WOOD_DARK);
    addVoxel(cx + x, floorY + 1, cz + half, C.WOOD_DARK);
  }
  for (let z = -half; z <= half; z++) {
    addVoxel(cx - half, floorY + 1, cz + z, C.WOOD_DARK);
    addVoxel(cx + half, floorY + 1, cz + z, C.WOOD_DARK);
  }

  // walls + openings
  for (let y = floorY + 2; y <= floorY + wallH; y++) {
    for (let x = -half + 1; x <= half - 1; x++) {
      if (Math.abs(x) > 1) {
        addVoxel(cx + x, y, cz - half + 1, C.WALL);
        addVoxel(cx + x, y, cz + half - 1, C.WALL);
      }
    }
    for (let z = -half + 1; z <= half - 1; z++) {
      if (Math.abs(z) > 1) {
        addVoxel(cx - half + 1, y, cz + z, C.WALL);
        addVoxel(cx + half - 1, y, cz + z, C.WALL);
      }
    }
  }

  // pillars
  const p = [
    [ half, half],[ half,-half],[-half, half],[-half,-half],
    [ 0, half],[ 0,-half],[ half, 0],[-half, 0]
  ];
  for (const [px, pz] of p) {
    for (let y = floorY + 1; y <= floorY + wallH + 1; y++) {
      addVoxel(cx + px, y, cz + pz, C.RED);
    }
  }

  // warm windows
  addVoxel(cx, floorY + wallH, cz - half + 1, C.LANTERN);
  addVoxel(cx, floorY + wallH, cz + half - 1, C.LANTERN);

  return buildRoof(cx, floorY + wallH + 2, cz, half);
}

(function buildPagoda() {
  const cx = 0, cz = 10, by = 4;
  addBox(cx - 10, cx + 10, by - 2, by - 1, cz - 10, cz + 10, C.STONE);
  addBox(cx - 9, cx + 9, by, by, cz - 9, cz + 9, C.STONE2);

  for (let s = 0; s < 6; s++) {
    addBox(cx - 2, cx + 2, by - 1 - s, by - 1 - s, cz - 10 - s, cz - 10 - s, C.STONE2);
  }

  let top = buildLevel(cx, cz, by + 1, 7, 4);
  top = buildLevel(cx, cz, top + 1, 5, 3);
  top = buildLevel(cx, cz, top + 1, 3, 3);

  for (let y = top + 1; y <= top + 7; y++) addVoxel(cx, y, cz, (y % 2) ? C.GOLD : C.RED);
  addVoxel(cx, top + 8, cz, C.GOLD);
})();

// ---------- Trees ----------
function buildTree(x, z, height, cherry = false) {
  const g = terrainHeight(x, z) + 1;
  for (let y = g; y < g + height; y++) addVoxel(x, y, z, C.WOOD_DARK);

  // branches
  const branchCount = 2 + Math.floor(rand() * 3);
  for (let i = 0; i < branchCount; i++) {
    const by = g + Math.floor(height * (0.45 + rand() * 0.45));
    const dx = Math.floor(rand() * 3) - 1;
    const dz = Math.floor(rand() * 3) - 1;
    if (dx || dz) {
      addVoxel(x + dx, by, z + dz, C.WOOD_DARK);
      addVoxel(x + dx * 2, by + 1, z + dz * 2, C.WOOD_DARK);
    }
  }

  const r = cherry ? 4 : 3;
  const y0 = g + height - 2;
  for (let dx = -r; dx <= r; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -2; dy <= 3; dy++) {
      for (let dz = -r; dz <= r; dz++) {
        const d = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz + (dy*1.3)*(dy*1.3));
        if (d < r + (rand() - 0.5) * 0.9) {
          let col;
          if (cherry) {
            const t = rand();
            col = t < 0.55 ? C.CHERRY : t < 0.85 ? C.CHERRY2 : C.CHERRY3;
          } else {
            const t = rand();
            col = t < 0.55 ? C.LEAF_G : t < 0.9 ? C.LEAF_G2 : C.LEAF_O;
          }
          addVoxel(x + dx, y0 + dy, z + dz, col);
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

// Planned cherry grove near pond + pagoda
const cherrySpots = [[-30,8],[-26,18],[-15,20],[-8,4],[12,20],[18,6],[24,18]];
for (const [x, z] of cherrySpots) buildTree(x, z, 7 + Math.floor(rand()*3), true);

// Mixed trees
for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
  const x = Math.floor(rand() * 92) - 46;
  const z = Math.floor(rand() * 92) - 46;
  if (Math.abs(x) < 17 && Math.abs(z - 10) < 17) continue;
  if (isPond(x, z) || isPath(x, z)) continue;
  buildTree(x, z, 6 + Math.floor(rand() * 4), rand() < 0.22);
}

// ---------- Lantern path ----------
for (let z = -38; z <= 8; z += 8) {
  const x = Math.round(Math.sin((z + 40) * 0.13) * 2.5) + (rand() < 0.5 ? -4 : 4);
  const y = terrainHeight(x, z) + 1;
  addVoxel(x, y, z, C.STONE2);
  addVoxel(x, y + 1, z, C.STONE2);
  addVoxel(x, y + 2, z, C.LANTERN);

  const p = new THREE.PointLight(0xffc577, 0.6, 14, 2);
  p.position.set(x, y + 2.3, z);
  scene.add(p);
}

// ---------- Flowers ----------
const flowerColors = [C.FLOWER_R, C.FLOWER_B, C.FLOWER_Y, C.CHERRY, C.LEAF_O];
for (let i = 0; i < 420; i++) {
  const x = Math.floor(rand() * 96) - 48;
  const z = Math.floor(rand() * 96) - 48;
  if (isPond(x, z) || isPath(x, z)) continue;
  if (Math.abs(x) < 14 && Math.abs(z - 10) < 14) continue;
  if (rand() < 0.45) continue;
  const y = terrainHeight(x, z) + 1;
  addVoxel(x, y, z, C.LEAF_G2);
  addVoxel(x, y + 1, z, flowerColors[Math.floor(rand() * flowerColors.length)]);
}

// ---------- Build instanced meshes ----------
const cubeGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
const dummy = new THREE.Object3D();

const materialOverrides = {
  [C.WATER]: { roughness: 0.25, metalness: 0.05, emissive: 0x103050, emissiveIntensity: 0.2 },
  [C.LANTERN]: { roughness: 0.35, emissive: 0xffa540, emissiveIntensity: 0.85 },
  [C.GOLD]: { roughness: 0.35, metalness: 0.25, emissive: 0x7a5a14, emissiveIntensity: 0.15 }
};

for (const [col, items] of voxelsByColor.entries()) {
  const opts = materialOverrides[col] || {};
  const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: col, ...opts });
  const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(cubeGeo, mat, items.length);
  mesh.castShadow = true;
  mesh.receiveShadow = true;
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    const [x, y, z] = items[i];
    dummy.position.set(x, y, z);
    dummy.updateMatrix();
    mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);
  }
  scene.add(mesh);
}

// soft ground shadow plane
const plane = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(220, 220),
  new THREE.ShadowMaterial({ opacity: 0.12 })
);
plane.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
plane.position.y = -2.5;
plane.receiveShadow = true;
scene.add(plane);

addEventListener("resize", () => {
  camera.aspect = innerWidth / innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
});

renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => {
  controls.update();
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #87CEEB; }</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
    import * as THREE from 'https://cdn.skypack.dev/three@0.136.0';

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias: true});
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const cubeGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
    
    function addVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(cubeGeo, new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color}));
        mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
        scene.add(mesh);
    }

    // Ground
    for(let i=-15; i<15; i++) for(let j=-15; j<15; j++) addVoxel(i, 0, j, 0x4a7c44);

    // Pagoda
    for(let level=0; level<3; level++) {
        const h = level * 3;
        for(let i=-2+level; i<=2-level; i++) {
            for(let j=-2+level; j<=2-level; j++) {
                addVoxel(i, h+1, j, 0x8b0000);
            }
        }
        // Roof
        for(let i=-3+level; i<=3-level; i++) {
            for(let j=-3+level; j<=3-level; j++) {
                addVoxel(i, h+2, j, 0xffd700);
            }
        }
    }

    // Cherry Blossom Trees
    function createTree(x, z) {
        for(let i=0; i<4; i++) addVoxel(x, i+1, z, 0x5d4037); // Trunk
        for(let i=-2; i<=2; i++) for(let j=-2; j<=2; j++) {
            if(Math.random() > 0.3) addVoxel(x+i, 5, z+j, 0xffb7c5);
            if(Math.random() > 0.5) addVoxel(x+i, 6, z+j, 0xffb7c5);
        }
    }
    createTree(6, 6); createTree(-7, 5); createTree(5, -8);

    // Pond
    for(let i=-4; i<0; i++) for(let j=-4; j<0; j++) addVoxel(i, 0.1, j, 0x0077be);

    const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
    light.position.set(10, 20, 10);
    scene.add(light);
    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040));

    camera.position.set(20, 15, 20);
    camera.lookAt(0, 5, 0);

    function animate() {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        scene.rotation.y += 0.005;
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }
    animate();
</script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
<style>
  body { margin:0; overflow:hidden; background:#111; }
  canvas { display:block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.158.0/build/three.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.158.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
<script>
// ----- basic three.js setup -----
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x202020);
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 500);
camera.position.set(40, 30, 60);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.enableDamping = true;

// ----- lights -----
const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
scene.add(ambient);
const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
dirLight.position.set(30,50,30);
scene.add(dirLight);

// ----- voxel helper -----
const voxelSize = 1;
function makeVoxel(x,y,z,color){
    const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(voxelSize, voxelSize, voxelSize);
    const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color});
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
    mesh.position.set(x*voxelSize, y*voxelSize, z*voxelSize);
    scene.add(mesh);
}

// ----- ground -----
for(let x=-30;x<=30;x++){
  for(let z=-30;z<=30;z++){
    makeVoxel(x,0,z,0x2c7a2c); // grass green
  }
}

// ----- pagoda -----
function buildPagoda(centerX, centerZ){
  const levels = [
    {size:12, height:4, roofHeight:2, roofColor:0x8b4513},
    {size:9,  height:4, roofHeight:2, roofColor:0x8b4513},
    {size:6,  height:4, roofHeight:2, roofColor:0x8b4513},
    {size:3,  height:4, roofHeight:2, roofColor:0x8b4513}
  ];
  let baseY = 1;
  levels.forEach((lvl,i)=>{
    const half = Math.floor(lvl.size/2);
    // walls
    for(let x=-half;x<=half;x++){
      for(let z=-half;z<=half;z++){
        if(Math.abs(x)===half || Math.abs(z)===half){
          for(let y=0;y<lvl.height;y++){
            makeVoxel(centerX+x, baseY+y, centerZ+z, 0x8b4513);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    // roof (simple stepped)
    for(let y=0;y<lvl.roofHeight;y++){
      const r = half - y;
      for(let x=-r;x<=r;x++){
        for(let z=-r;z<=r;z++){
          makeVoxel(centerX+x, baseY+lvl.height+y, centerZ+z, lvl.roofColor);
        }
      }
    }
    baseY += lvl.height + lvl.roofHeight;
  });
}
buildPagoda(0,0);

// ----- trees -----
function addTree(x,z){
  const trunkHeight = 6;
  const trunkRadius = 1;
  // trunk
  for(let y=1;y<=trunkHeight;y++){
    makeVoxel(x, y, z, 0x8b5a2b);
  }
  // foliage
  const foliageHeight = 4;
  for(let y=trunkHeight+1; y<=trunkHeight+foliageHeight; y++){
    const radius = 3 - (y-trunkHeight-1);
    for(let dx=-radius;dx<=radius;dx++){
      for(let dz=-radius;dz<=radius;dz++){
        if(dx*dx+dz*dz <= radius*radius){
          makeVoxel(x+dx, y, z+dz, 0x2e8b57);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  // cherry blossom petals (pink spheres)
  const petalCount = 30;
  for(let i=0;i<petalCount;i++){
    const px = x + (Math.random()-0.5)*6;
    const py = trunkHeight + Math.random()*foliageHeight;
    const pz = z + (Math.random()-0.5)*6;
    const sphere = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.3,6,6),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0xffc0cb})
    );
    sphere.position.set(px, py, pz);
    scene.add(sphere);
  }
}
addTree(-15, -10);
addTree(20, -12);
addTree(-22, 14);
addTree(12, 18);
addTree(25, 25);

// ----- cherry blossom trees around pagoda -----
for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
  const angle = i * Math.PI/4;
  const radius = 20;
  const tx = Math.cos(angle)*radius;
  const tz = Math.sin(angle)*radius;
  addTree(tx, tz);
}

// ----- animation loop -----
function animate(){
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  controls.update();
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
animate();

// ----- resize handling -----
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{  const w = window.innerWidth;
  const h = window.innerHeight;
  camera.aspect = w/h;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  renderer.setSize(w,h);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
<style>
body { margin:0; overflow:hidden; background:#000; }
canvas { display:block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="importmap">
{
  "imports": {
    "three": "https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/"
  }
}
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

// Scene setup
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB);
scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x87CEEB, 150, 500);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 2000);
camera.position.set(120, 80, 120);
camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;

// Lighting
const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
scene.add(ambientLight);

const sunLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff4e5, 1.0);
sunLight.position.set(100, 150, 100);
sunLight.castShadow = true;
sunLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 2048;
sunLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 2048;
sunLight.shadow.camera.near = 10;
sunLight.shadow.camera.far = 500;
sunLight.shadow.camera.left = -200;
sunLight.shadow.camera.right = 200;
sunLight.shadow.camera.top = 200;
sunLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -200;
scene.add(sunLight);

// Voxel storage
const voxelData = [];

function addVoxel(x, y, z, hexColor) {
  voxelData.push({x, y, z, color: new THREE.Color(hexColor)});
}

// Helper for boxes
function fillBox(x0, y0, z0, w, h, d, color) {
  for(let x = x0; x < x0 + w; x++)
    for(let y = y0; y < y0 + h; y++)
      for(let z = z0; z < z0 + d; z++)
        addVoxel(x, y, z, color);
}

// Ground: grass area
const groundSizeX = 200;
const groundSizeZ = 200;
const groundHeight = 0;
for(let x = -groundSizeX/2; x < groundSizeX/2; x++) {
  for(let z = -groundSizeZ/2; z < groundSizeZ/2; z++) {
    let grassColor = 0x4caf50;
    if(Math.random() < 0.2) grassColor = 0x66bb6a;
    else if(Math.random() < 0.1) grassColor = 0x388e3c;
    addVoxel(x, groundHeight, z, grassColor);
  }
}

// Stone path: a winding path across the garden
function addPath(){
  const pathPoints = [];
  for(let i = -80; i <= 80; i+=2){
    let x = Math.sin(i*0.05)*15 + i*0.5;
    let z = i;
    pathPoints.push({x:Math.round(x), z:Math.round(z)});
  }
  pathPoints.forEach(p => {
    fillBox(p.x-1, 1, p.z-1, 2, 1, 2, 0x9e9e9e);
  });
}
addPath();

// Pond: central area
const pondX = -30, pondZ = -30;
const pondW = 30, pondD = 30;
for(let x = pondX; x < pondX + pondW; x++){
  for(let z = pondZ; z < pondZ + pondD; z++){
    let waterColor = 0x0288d1;
    if(Math.random() < 0.2) waterColor = 0x03a9f4;
    addVoxel(x, 1, z, waterColor);
  }
}
// Lily pads
for(let i = 0; i < 20; i++){
  let x = pondX + Math.floor(Math.random()*pondW);
  let z = pondZ + Math.floor(Math.random()*pondD);
  addVoxel(x, 2, z, 0x2e7d32);
}

// Pagoda
function buildPagoda(cx, baseY, cz){
  // base platform
  fillBox(cx-12, baseY, cz-12, 24, 2, 24, 0x795548);
  // floor 1
  fillBox(cx-10, baseY+2, cz-10, 20, 1, 20, 0x5d4037);
  // walls 1
  fillBox(cx-10, baseY+3, cz-10, 1, 8, 20, 0xb71c1c);
  fillBox(cx+9, baseY+3, cz-10, 1, 8, 20, 0xb71c1c);
  fillBox(cx-10, baseY+3, cz-10, 20, 8, 1, 0xb71c1c);
  fillBox(cx-10, baseY+3, cz+9, 20, 8, 1, 0xb71c1c);
  // pillars
  const pillarColor = 0x4e342e;
  fillBox(cx-10, baseY+3, cz-10, 2, 10, 2, pillarColor);
  fillBox(cx+8, baseY+3, cz-10, 2, 10, 2, pillarColor);
  fillBox(cx-10, baseY+3, cz+8, 2, 10, 2, pillarColor);
  fillBox(cx+8, baseY+3, cz+8, 2, 10, 2, pillarColor);
  // Roof 1
  const roofY1 = baseY+11;
  fillBox(cx-12, roofY1, cz-12, 24, 1, 24, 0x880e4f);
  fillBox(cx-14, roofY1+1, cz-14, 28, 1, 28, 0x880e4f);
  for(let level = 0; level < 4; level++){
    let y = roofY1+2+level;
    let offset = level+2;
    fillBox(cx-12+offset, y, cz-12+offset, 24-offset*2, 1, 24-offset*2, 0xb71c1c);
  }
  // floor 2
  const floor2Y = roofY1+6;
  fillBox(cx-8, floor2Y, cz-8, 16, 1, 16, 0x5d4037);
  // walls 2
  fillBox(cx-8, floor2Y+1, cz-8, 1, 6, 16, 0xf44336);
  fillBox(cx+7, floor2Y+1, cz-8, 1, 6, 16, 0xf44336);
  fillBox(cx-8, floor2Y+1, cz-8, 16, 6, 1, 0xf44336);
  fillBox(cx-8, floor2Y+1, cz+7, 16, 6, 1, 0xf44336);
  // pillars 2
  fillBox(cx-8, floor2Y+1, cz-8, 2, 8, 2, pillarColor);
  fillBox(cx+6, floor2Y+1, cz-8, 2, 8, 2, pillarColor);
  fillBox(cx-8, floor2Y+1, cz+6, 2, 8, 2, pillarColor);
  fillBox(cx+6, floor2Y+1, cz+6, 2, 8, 2, pillarColor);
  // Roof 2
  const roofY2 = floor2Y+8;
  fillBox(cx-10, roofY2, cz-10, 20, 1, 20, 0x880e4f);
  fillBox(cx-12, roofY2+1, cz-12, 24, 1, 24, 0x880e4f);
  for(let level = 0; level < 3; level++){
    let y = roofY2+2+level;
    let offset = level+2;
    fillBox(cx-10+offset, y, cz-10+offset, 20-offset*2, 1, 20-offset*2, 0xf44336);
  }
  // floor 3
  const floor3Y = roofY2+5;
  fillBox(cx-6, floor3Y, cz-6, 12, 1, 12, 0x5d4037);
  // walls 3
  fillBox(cx-6, floor3Y+1, cz-6, 1, 4, 12, 0xe91e63);
  fillBox(cx+5, floor3Y+1, cz-6, 1, 4, 12, 0xe91e63);
  fillBox(cx-6, floor3Y+1, cz-6, 12, 4, 1, 0xe91e63);
  fillBox(cx-6, floor3Y+1, cz+5, 12, 4, 1, 0xe91e63);
  // pillars 3
  fillBox(cx-6, floor3Y+1, cz-6, 2, 6, 2, pillarColor);
  fillBox(cx+4, floor3Y+1, cz-6, 2, 6, 2, pillarColor);
  fillBox(cx-6, floor3Y+1, cz+4, 2, 6, 2, pillarColor);
  fillBox(cx+4, floor3Y+1, cz+4, 2, 6, 2, pillarColor);
  // Roof 3
  const roofY3 = floor3Y+7;
  fillBox(cx-8, roofY3, cz-8, 16, 1, 16, 0x880e4f);
  fillBox(cx-10, roofY3+1, cz-10, 20, 1, 20, 0x880e4f);
  for(let level = 0; level < 2; level++){
    let y = roofY3+2+level;
    let offset = level+2;
    fillBox(cx-8+offset, y, cz-8+offset, 16-offset*2, 1, 16-offset*2, 0xe91e63);
  }
  // top spire
  const spireBase = roofY3+4;
  fillBox(cx-2, spireBase, cz-2, 4, 1, 4, 0x880e4f);
  fillBox(cx-1, spireBase+1, cz-1, 2, 4, 2, 0x880e4f);
  fillBox(cx, spireBase+5, cz, 1, 4, 1, 0xffffff);
}
buildPagoda(0, 2, 0);

// Trees
function createTree(tx, tz, height, trunkColor, leafColor){
  const baseY = 1;
  for(let y = baseY; y < baseY + height; y++){
    addVoxel(tx, y, tz, trunkColor);
  }
  const leafRadius = 3;
  const leafBaseY = baseY + height - 1;
  for(let dx = -leafRadius; dx <= leafRadius; dx++){
    for(let dy = 0; dy <= leafRadius; dy++){
      for(let dz = -leafRadius; dz <= leafRadius; dz++){
        let dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
        if(dist <= leafRadius && Math.random() > 0.3){
          let lx = tx + dx;
          let ly = leafBaseY + dy;
          let lz = tz + dz;
          addVoxel(lx, ly, lz, leafColor);
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

function createCherryTree(tx, tz){
  const height = 6 + Math.floor(Math.random()*3);
  const trunkColor = 0x5d4037;
  const blossomColor = 0xf48fb1;
  createTree(tx, tz, height, trunkColor, blossomColor);
  // floating petals
  for(let i = 0; i < 15; i++){
    let px = tx + Math.floor(Math.random()*6)-3;
    let py = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random()*6);
    let pz = tz + Math.floor(Math.random()*6)-3;
    addVoxel(px, py, pz, 0xf8bbd0);
  }
}

function createRegularTree(tx, tz){
  const height = 5 + Math.floor(Math.random()*4);
  const trunkColor = 0x4e342e;
  const leafColor = 0x2e7d32;
  createTree(tx, tz, height, trunkColor, leafColor);
}

// Distribute trees
for(let i = 0; i < 50; i++){
  let tx = Math.floor(Math.random()*180)-90;
  let tz = Math.floor(Math.random()*180)-90;
  // avoid pagoda and pond
  if(Math.abs(tx) < 30 && Math.abs(tz) < 30) continue;
  if(tx > pondX-5 && tx < pondX+pondW+5 && tz > pondZ-5 && tz < pondZ+pondD+5) continue;
  if(Math.random() < 0.35){
    createCherryTree(tx, tz);
  } else {
    createRegularTree(tx, tz);
  }
}

// Bridge
const bridgeX = pondX + pondW/2;
const bridgeZStart = pondZ - 5;
const bridgeZEnd = pondZ + pondD + 5;
for(let z = bridgeZStart; z <= bridgeZEnd; z++){
  fillBox(bridgeX-2, 2, z, 4, 1, 1, 0x8d6e63);
  if(z % 4 === 0){
    fillBox(bridgeX-2, 3, z, 1, 3, 1, 0x6d4c41);
    fillBox(bridgeX+1, 3, z, 1, 3, 1, 0x6d4c41);

  }
}

// Lanterns

  fillBox(lx-1, ly, lz-1, 2, 1, 2, 0x795548);
  fillBox(lx-1, ly+1, lz-1, 2, 2, 2, 0xfbc02d);
  fillBox(lx-1, ly+3, lz-1, 2, 1, 2, 0x795548);
  addVoxel(lx, ly+2, lz, 0xffeb3b);
}
addLantern(-20, 2, -20);
addLantern(20, 2, -20);
addLantern(-20, 2, 20);
addLantern(20, 2, 20);

// Boulders
function addBoulder(bx, by, bz, radius){
  for(let dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++){
    for(let dy = -radius; dy <= radius; dy++){
      for(let dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++){
        if(Math.random() < 0.6){
          let dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
          if(dist <= radius){
            addVoxel(bx+dx, by+dy, bz+dz, 0x757575);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

    <script>
        // Initialize the scene
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Create a voxel grid
        const voxelSize = 1;
        const gridSize = 20;
        const grid = new THREE.Group();

        // Function to create a voxel
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(voxelSize, voxelSize, voxelSize);
            const material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: color });
            const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            voxel.position.set(x, y, z);
            return voxel;
        }

        // Create the pagoda
        function createPagoda() {
            const pagoda = new THREE.Group();
            const colors = [0xFFD700, 0xFF8C00, 0xFF4500, 0xFF0000, 0x8B0000];
            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                const level = new THREE.Group();
                for (let x = -2; x <= 2; x++) {
                    for (let z = -2; z <= 2; z++) {
                        const voxel = createVoxel(x, i, z, colors[i]);
                        level.add(voxel);
                    }
                }
                pagoda.add(level);
            }
            pagoda.position.set(0, 0, 0);
            return pagoda;
        }

        // Create trees
        function createTree(x, z) {
            const tree = new THREE.Group();
            const trunk = createVoxel(x, 0, z, 0x8B4513);
            tree.add(trunk);
            const leaves = [0x228B22, 0x32CD32, 0x00FF00];
            for (let y = 1; y <= 3; y++) {
                for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                    for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
                        const leaf = createVoxel(x + dx, y, z + dz, leaves[Math.floor(Math.random() * leaves.length)]);
                        tree.add(leaf);
                    }
                }
            }
            return tree;
        }

        // Create cherry blossoms
        function createCherryBlossom(x, z) {
            const blossom = new THREE.Group();
            const trunk = createVoxel(x, 0, z, 0x8B4513);
            blossom.add(trunk);
            const blossomColor = 0xFFB6C1;
            for (let y = 1; y <= 3; y++) {
                for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                    for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
                        const flower = createVoxel(x + dx, y, z + dz, blossomColor);
                        blossom.add(flower);
                    }
                }
            }
            return blossom;
        }

        // Add pagoda to the scene
        const pagoda = createPagoda();
        scene.add(pagoda);

            scene.add(tree);

            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });

        // Start the animation
        animate();
    </script>

// Garden Ground
const groundGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(20, 20);

ground.position.y = -0.5;

  const leavesGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(2, 20, 20);
  const leavesMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: 0x228B22, shininess: 10 }); // Forest Green
  const leaves = new THREE.Mesh(leavesGeometry, leavesMaterial);

  scene.add(leaves);
}

createTree(-5, -5);
createTree(5, -5);
createTree(-5, 5);
createTree(5, 5);

    const cube = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
    cube.position.set(x, y, z);
    scene.add(cube);
  }

  // --- Pagoda Creation ---
  function createPagoda(x, y, z) {
    // Base
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      for (let j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
        createVoxel(x + i, y, z + j, 0x8B4513); // Brown
      }
    }
    // First Tier
    for (let i = 1; i < 5; i++) {
      for (let j = 1; j < 5; j++) {
        createVoxel(x + i, y + 2, z + j, 0xCD853F); // Peru
      }
    }
    // Second Tier
    for (let i = 2; i < 4; i++) {
      for (let j = 2; j < 4; j++) {
        createVoxel(x + i, y + 4, z + j, 0xA0522D); // Sienna
      }
    }
    // Roof
    for (let i = 2; i < 4; i++) {
      createVoxel(x + i, y + 6, z + 2, 0xFF4500); // OrangeRed
      createVoxel(x + i, y + 6, z + 3, 0xFF4500);
    }
    // Roof Peak
    createVoxel(x + 3, y + 7, z + 2.5, 0xFF6347); // Tomato
  }

  // --- Tree Creation ---
  function createTree(x, y, z) {
    // Trunk
    for (let i = 0; i < 1; i++) {
      for (let j = 0; j < 1; j++) {
        for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
          createVoxel(x + i, y + k, z + j, 0x654321); // Dark Brown
        }
      }
    }
    // Leaves - Randomized spherical shape
    for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
      for (let j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {
        for (let k = 1; k <= 3; k++) {
          if (i*i + j*j + k*k <= 4) { // approximate sphere
            createVoxel(x + i, y + 3 + k, z + j, 0x228B22); // ForestGreen
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // --- Cherry Blossom Creation ---
  function createCherryBlossom(x, y, z) {
    const colors = [0xFFB6C1, 0xFFA07A, 0xF4C2C2]; // LightPink, LightSalmon, Seashell
    const color = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
    createVoxel(x, y, z, color);
  }

  // --- Garden Creation ---
  function createGarden() {
    // Ground
    for (let i = -10; i <= 10; i++) {
      for (let j = -10; j <= 10; j++) {
        createVoxel(i, -1, j, 0x3CB371); // MediumSeaGreen

    createTree(5, 0, 5);
    createTree(-8, 0, 2);
    createTree(2, 0, -8);

    // Cherry Blossoms - Scattered around trees
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
      const x = Math.random() * 10 - 5;
      const y = Math.random() * 5;
      const z = Math.random() * 10 - 5;
      createCherryBlossom(x, y, z);
    }

    // Small Stones
    for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {

      const y = -1.5;
      const z = Math.random() * 20 -10;
      createVoxel(x, y, z, 0x708090); // SlateGray
    }
  }

  // --- Initialization ---
  createGarden();

  camera.position.z = 15;
  camera.position.y = 5;
  camera.position.x = 10;
  camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

  // --- Animation Loop ---

    renderer.render( scene, camera );
  }

    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize( window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight );
  } );

  const middleMesh = new THREE.Mesh(middle, baseMaterial);
  middleMesh.position.set(0, 0, pagodaHeight * 0.6);
  scene.add(middleMesh);

  // Top level (small spire)
  const topMesh = new THREE.Mesh(top, baseMaterial);
  topMesh.position.set(0, 0, pagodaHeight * 0.8);
  topMesh.scale.set(0.7, 0.7, 0.7);
  scene.add(topMesh);

  // --- Garden ---
  const groundSize = 50;
  const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x3CB371 }); // Green
  const ground = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(groundSize, groundSize);
  const groundMesh = new THREE.Mesh(ground, groundMaterial);
  groundMesh.position.set(0, -0.5, 0);
  scene.add(groundMesh);

  // Trees
  const numTrees = 10;
  for (let i = 0; i < numTrees; i++) {
    const treeHeight = Math.random() * 15 + 5;
    const treeColor = new THREE.Color(0x6B8E23); // Olive Green
    const treeGeometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 2, treeHeight, 32);
    const treeMesh = new THREE.Mesh(treeGeometry, treeColor);
    treeMesh.position.set(Math.random() * groundSize, 0.5, Math.random() * groundSize);
    scene.add(treeMesh);

    // Leaves (simplified voxel leaves)
    const leafGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(3, 1, 2);
    const leafMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x228B22 }); // Forest Green
    const leaf = new THREE.Mesh(leafGeometry, leafMaterial);
    leaf.position.set(treeMesh.position.x, treeMesh.position.y + treeHeight, treeMesh.position.z);
    treeMesh.add(leaf);
  }

  // Cherry Blossoms
  const numBlossoms = 20;
  for (let i = 0; i < numBlossoms; i++) {
    const blossomRadius = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
    const blossomColor = new THREE.Color(0xFFC0CB); // LightPink
    const blossomGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(blossomRadius, 16, 16);
    const blossomMesh = new THREE.Mesh(blossomGeometry, blossomColor);
    blossomMesh.position.set(Math.random() * groundSize, 1, Math.random() * groundSize);
    scene.add(blossomMesh);
  }

  // --- Detail (Voxel-like blocks for garden border) ---
  const borderHeight = 2;
  const borderColor = 0x8B4513; // SaddleBrown
  const borderGeometry = new THREE.CubeGeometry(groundSize, borderHeight, 1);
  const borderMesh = new THREE.Mesh(borderGeometry, borderColor);
  borderMesh.position.set(0, -0.5 - borderHeight / 2, 0);
  scene.add(borderMesh);

  // --- Rendering ---
  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

  function animate() {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    // You could add subtle animations here, like a slight rotation
    // for the pagoda or gentle swaying for the trees.
    // For simplicity, we'll just render.
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
  }

  animate();
}

createVoxelScene();

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden Scene</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        directionalLight.position.set(50, 50, 50);
        scene.add(directionalLight);
        const pointLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xffcc00, 1, 50);
        pointLight.position.set(10, 15, 10);
        scene.add(pointLight);

        // Materials for voxels
        const grassMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x4ca64c });
        const pathMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x8c8c8c });
        const pagodaMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x8b0000 });
        const roofMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x1a1a1a });
        const treeTrunkMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x4a2f10 });
        const treeLeavesMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x2d5a27 });
        const cherryBlossomMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xffb6c1 });
        const waterMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x1e90ff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.7 });

        // Voxel size
        const voxelSize = 1;

        // Helper to create voxel at position
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, material, size = voxelSize) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
            const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            voxel.position.set(x * size, y * size, z * size);
            scene.add(voxel);
            return voxel;
        }

        // Ground (garden base with grass and paths)
        for (let x = -20; x < 20; x++) {
            for (let z = -20; z < 20; z++) {
                let height = Math.floor(Math.sin(x * 0.1) * Math.cos(z * 0.1) * 2);
                for (let y = 0; y <= height; y++) {
                    createVoxel(x, y, z, grassMat);
                }
                // Paths
                if (Math.abs(x) < 2 && z > -10 && z < 10) {
                    createVoxel(x, height + 1, z, pathMat);
                }
            }
        }

        // Water feature (small pond)
        for (let x = -15; x < -10; x++) {
            for (let z = -5; z < 5; z++) {
                createVoxel(x, 1, z, waterMat);
            }
        }

        // Pagoda structure (multi-tiered)
        const pagodaBase = 5; // Base width
        for (let tier = 0; tier < 5; tier++) {
            let width = pagodaBase - tier;
            let yStart = tier * 4;
            for (let x = -width; x <= width; x++) {
                for (let z = -width; z <= width; z++) {
                    if (tier < 4) createVoxel(x, yStart + 2, z, pagodaMat); // Walls
                    createVoxel(x, yStart + 3, z, roofMat); // Roof layer
                }
            }
        }

        // Trees (trunk and leaves)
        function createTree(x, y, z) {
            // Trunk
            for (let h = 0; h < 5; h++) {
                createVoxel(x, y + h, z, treeTrunkMat);
            }
            // Leaves
            for (let lx = -2; lx <= 2; lx++) {
                for (let ly = 3; ly <= 6; ly++) {
                    for (let lz = -2; lz <= 2; lz++) {
                        if (Math.random() > 0.3) {
                            createVoxel(x + lx, y + ly, z + lz, treeLeavesMat);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        createTree(-10, 3, -10);
        createTree(10, 3, 10);
        createTree(-12, 3, 12);

        // Cherry blossom trees
        function createCherryTree(x, y, z) {
            for (let h = 0; h < 4; h++) {
                createVoxel(x, y + h, z, treeTrunkMat);
            }
            for (let lx = -3; lx <= 3; lx++) {
                for (let ly = 2; ly <= 5; ly++) {
                    for (let lz = -3; lz <= 3; lz++) {
                        if (Math.random() > 0.4) {
                            createVoxel(x + lx, y + ly, z + lz, cherryBlossomMat);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        createCherryTree(8, 3, -8);
        createCherryTree(-8, 3, 8);

        // Falling cherry blossom petals (animated particles)
        const petals = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
            const petal = createVoxel(
                Math.random() * 20 - 10,
                Math.random() * 10 + 5,
                Math.random() * 20 - 10,
                cherryBlossomMat,
                0.2
            );
            petals.push({ mesh: petal, speed: Math.random() * 0.05 + 0.02 });
        }

        // Camera position
        camera.position.set(25, 20, 25);
        camera.lookAt(0, 10, 0);

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            // Animate petals
            petals.forEach(petal => {
                petal.mesh.position.y -= petal.speed;
                petal.mesh.position.x += Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.001) * 0.02;
                if (petal.mesh.position.y < 0) petal.mesh.position.y = 15;
            });
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: #87CEEB;
        }
        canvas {
            display: block;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB);
        scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x87CEEB, 50, 200);

        // Camera setup
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(40, 25, 40);
        camera.lookAt(0, 10, 0);

        // Renderer setup
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        directionalLight.position.set(50, 100, 50);
        directionalLight.castShadow = true;
        directionalLight.shadow.camera.left = -60;
        directionalLight.shadow.camera.right = 60;
        directionalLight.shadow.camera.top = 60;
        directionalLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -60;
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Voxel creation function
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, color, size = 1) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
            const material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: color });
            const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            voxel.position.set(x, y, z);
            voxel.castShadow = true;
            voxel.receiveShadow = true;
            return voxel;
        }

        // Create ground with height variation
        function createTerrain() {
            const groundGroup = new THREE.Group();
            
            // Main ground plane
            for (let x = -50; x <= 50; x += 2) {
                for (let z = -50; z <= 50; z += 2) {
                    // Use Perlin-like noise for height variation
                    const height = Math.sin(x * 0.05) * Math.cos(z * 0.05) * 2;
                    const voxel = createVoxel(x, height - 2, z, 0x4a7c59, 2);
                    groundGroup.add(voxel);
                }
            }
            
            // Path
            for (let x = -10; x <= 10; x += 2) {
                for (let z = -50; z <= 50; z += 2) {
                    const voxel = createVoxel(x, -1.8, z, 0x8b7355, 2);
                    groundGroup.add(voxel);
                }
            }
            
            return groundGroup;
        }

        // Create pagoda with detailed multi-tiered structure
        function createPagoda() {
            const pagodaGroup = new THREE.Group();
            
            // Base platform
            for (let i = -8; i <= 8; i += 2) {
                for (let j = -8; j <= 8; j += 2) {
                    pagodaGroup.add(createVoxel(i, 0, j, 0x696969, 2));
                }
            }
            
            // Main structure - multiple tiers
            const colors = [0x8B4513, 0xA0522D, 0xCD853F, 0xDEB887, 0xF4A460];
            
            for (let tier = 0; tier < 5; tier++) {
                const tierHeight = 4;
                const tierY = 2 + tier * tierHeight;
                const size = 12 - tier * 2;
                
                // Walls
                for (let i = -size/2; i <= size/2; i += 2) {
                    for (let j = -size/2; j <= size/2; j += 2) {
                        if (Math.abs(i) === size/2 || Math.abs(j) === size/2) {
                            pagodaGroup.add(createVoxel(i, tierY, j, colors[tier], 2));
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Roof details
                const roofY = tierY + 2;
                const roofSize = size + 4;
                
                // Roof edges
                for (let i = -roofSize/2; i <= roofSize/2; i += 2) {
                    pagodaGroup.add(createVoxel(i, roofY, -roofSize/2, 0x8B0000, 2));
                    pagodaGroup.add(createVoxel(i, roofY, roofSize/2, 0x8B0000, 2));
                    pagodaGroup.add(createVoxel(-roofSize/2, roofY, i, 0x8B0000, 2));
                    pagodaGroup.add(createVoxel(roofSize/2, roofY, i, 0x8B0000, 2));
                }
                
                // Upturned corners
                pagodaGroup.add(createVoxel(-roofSize/2 - 2, roofY + 1, -roofSize/2 - 2, 0x8B0000, 2));
                pagodaGroup.add(createVoxel(roofSize/2 + 2, roofY + 1, -roofSize/2 - 2, 0x8B0000, 2));
                pagodaGroup.add(createVoxel(-roofSize/2 - 2, roofY + 1, roofSize/2 + 2, 0x8B0000, 2));
                pagodaGroup.add(createVoxel(roofSize/2 + 2, roofY + 1, roofSize/2 + 2, 0x8B0000, 2));
            }
            
            // Spire
            for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                const y = 22 + i * 1.5;
                const size = Math.max(1, 4 - i * 0.5);
                pagodaGroup.add(createVoxel(0, y, 0, 0xFFD700, size));
            }
            
            return pagodaGroup;
        }

        // Create trees with different species
        function createTree(x, z, type = 'normal') {
            const treeGroup = new THREE.Group();
            
            if (type === 'cherry') {
                // Cherry blossom tree
                const trunkHeight = 8 + Math.random() * 4;
                for (let i = 0; i < trunkHeight; i++) {
                    const size = 2 - (i / trunkHeight);
                    treeGroup.add(createVoxel(x, i, z, 0x8B4513, size));
                }
                
                // Fluffy pink canopy
                for (let dx = -6; dx <= 6; dx += 2) {
                    for (let dy = 6; dy <= 12; dy += 2) {
                        for (let dz = -6; dz <= 6; dz += 2) {
                            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + (dy-9)*(dy-9) + dz*dz);
                            if (dist < 6 && Math.random() > 0.3) {
                                treeGroup.add(createVoxel(x + dx, trunkHeight + dy, z + dz, 0xFFB6C1, 2));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else if (type === 'pine') {
                // Pine tree
                for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
                    treeGroup.add(createVoxel(x, i, z, 0x8B4513, 1.5));
                }
                
                // Layered green foliage
                for (let layer = 0; layer < 5; layer++) {
                    const y = 10 + layer * 2;
                    const size = 8 - layer * 1.5;
                    for (let dx = -size/2; dx <= size/2; dx += 2) {
                        for (let dz = -size/2; dz <= size/2; dz += 2) {
                            if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dz) < size) {
                                treeGroup.add(createVoxel(x + dx, y, z + dz, 0x228B22, 2));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                // Regular tree
                const trunkHeight = 6 + Math.random() * 4;
                for (let i = 0; i < trunkHeight; i++) {
                    treeGroup.add(createVoxel(x, i, z, 0x8B4513, 1.5));
                }
                
                // Round canopy
                for (let dx = -4; dx <= 4; dx += 2) {
                    for (let dy = 4; dy <= 10; dy += 2) {
                        for (let dz = -4; dz <= 4; dz += 2) {
                            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + (dy-7)*(dy-7) + dz*dz);
                            if (dist < 5) {
                                const greenShade = 0x228B22 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x002000);
                                treeGroup.add(createVoxel(x + dx, trunkHeight + dy, z + dz, greenShade, 2));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return treeGroup;
        }

        // Create various flowers
        function createFlower(x, z) {
            const flowerGroup = new THREE.Group();
            const colors = [0xFF69B4, 0xFF1493, 0xFF6347, 0xFFD700, 0xFF4500];
            const color = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
            
            // Stem
            flowerGroup.add(createVoxel(x, 0.5, z, 0x228B22, 0.5));
            flowerGroup.add(createVoxel(x, 1, z, 0x228B22, 0.5));
            
            // Flower head
            flowerGroup.add(createVoxel(x, 1.5, z, color, 1));
            
            return flowerGroup;
        }

        // Create rocks
        function createRock(x, z) {
            const rockGroup = new THREE.Group();
            const size = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
            
            for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                const y = i * 0.5;
                const currentSize = size - i * 0.3;
                rockGroup.add(createVoxel(x, y, z, 0x696969, currentSize));
            }
            
            return rockGroup;
        }

        // Add all elements to scene
        scene.add(createTerrain());
        scene.add(createPagoda());

        // Add diverse trees
        scene.add(createTree(-25, -20, 'cherry'));
        scene.add(createTree(30, -25, 'cherry'));
        scene.add(createTree(-30, 20, 'pine'));
        scene.add(createTree(25, 30, 'normal'));
        scene.add(createTree(-15, 35, 'cherry'));
        scene.add(createTree(35, -10, 'pine'));
        scene.add(createTree(-35, -30, 'normal'));
        scene.add(createTree(15, -35, 'cherry'));

        // Add flowers
        for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 25;
            const x = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
            const z = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
            scene.add(createFlower(x, z));
        }

        // Add rocks
        scene.add(createRock(-20, 10));
        scene.add(createRock(20, -15));
        scene.add(createRock(-10, -25));
        scene.add(createRock(15, 20));

        // Mouse controls
        let mouseX = 0, mouseY = 0;
        let targetX = 0, targetY = 0;
        const windowHalfX = window.innerWidth / 2;
        const windowHalfY = window.innerHeight / 2;

        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (event) => {
            mouseX = (event.clientX - windowHalfX) / windowHalfX;
            mouseY = (event.clientY - windowHalfY) / windowHalfY;
        });

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            
            targetX = mouseX * 0.002;
            targetY = mouseY * 0.002;
            
            camera.position.x = 40 * Math.cos(targetX);
            camera.position.z = 40 * Math.sin(targetX);
            camera.position.y = 25 + targetY * 10;
            camera.lookAt(0, 10, 0);
            
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });

        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

  scene.add(ambient);
  const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
  dirLight.position.set(10, 20, 10);
  scene.add(dirLight);

  // Voxel helper
  const voxelSize = 1;
  const voxelGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(voxelSize, voxelSize, voxelSize);
  const voxelMaterials = {
    grass: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x228B22 }),
    trunk: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x8B4513 }),
    foliage: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x006400 }),
    blossom: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xFFB6C1 }),
    pagodaBase: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x8B0000 }),
    pagodaRoof: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xB22222 })
  };

  function addVoxel(x, y, z, materialKey) {
    const material = voxelMaterials[materialKey];
    if (!material) return;
    const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(voxelGeometry, material);
    voxel.position.set(x * voxelSize, y * voxelSize, z * voxelSize);
    scene.add(voxel);
  }

  // Grass plane
  const grassSize = 20;
  for (let x = -grassSize/2; x <= grassSize/2; x++) {
    for (let z = -grassSize/2; z <= grassSize/2; z++) {
      addVoxel(x, 0, z, 'grass');
    }
  }

  // Pagoda
  const pagodaCenter = { x: 0, z: 0 };
  const pagodaLevels = 5;
  const levelSize = 6;
  for (let lvl = 0; lvl < pagodaLevels; lvl++) {
    const size = levelSize - lvl * 1.2;
    const y = lvl + 0.5;
    // Platform
    for (let x = -size/2; x <= size/2; x += 0.5) {
      for (let z = -size/2; z <= size/2; z += 0.5) {
        addVoxel(pagodaCenter.x + x, y, pagodaCenter.z + z, 'pagodaBase');
      }
    }
    // Roof
    if (lvl === pagodaLevels - 1) {
      const roofSize = size - 1;
      for (let x = -roofSize/2; x <= roofSize/2; x += 0.5) {
        for (let z = -roofSize/2; z <= roofSize/2; z += 0.5) {
          addVoxel(pagodaCenter.x + x, y + 0.5, pagodaCenter.z + z, 'pagodaRoof');
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Trees
  const treePositions = [
    { x: -8, z: -8 },
    { x: -8, z: 8 },
    { x: 8, z: -8 },
    { x: 8, z: 8 }
  ];
  treePositions.forEach(pos => {
    // Trunk
    for (let y = 1; y <= 5; y++) {
      addVoxel(pos.x, y, pos.z, 'trunk');
    }
    // Foliage
    for (let y = 6; y <= 8; y++) {
      for (let x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
        for (let z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {
          if (Math.abs(x) + Math.abs(z) <= 1) {
            addVoxel(pos.x + x, y, pos.z + z, 'foliage');
          }
        }
      }
    }
    // Cherry blossoms
    for (let y = 9; y <= 10; y++) {
      for (let x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
        for (let z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {
          if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
            addVoxel(pos.x + x, y, pos.z + z, 'blossom');
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  // Animation
  function animate() {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    controls.update();
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
  }
  animate();

  // Resize handling
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  });
</script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.132.2/build/three.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.132.2/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB);
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Controls
        const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        directionalLight.position.set(1, 1, 1);
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Voxel material
        const voxelMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
            vertexColors: true,
            flatShading: true
        });

        // Create voxel geometry
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
            const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, voxelMaterial);
            mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
            mesh.geometry.attributes.color = new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array([
                color.r, color.g, color.b,
                color.r, color.g, color.b,
                color.r, color.g, color.b,
                color.r, color.g, color.b,
                color.r, color.g, color.b,
                color.r, color.g, color.b,
                color.r, color.g, color.b,
                color.r, color.g, color.b
            ]), 3);
            return mesh;
        }

        // Create pagoda
        function createPagoda() {
            const group = new THREE.Group();

            // Base colors
            const red = new THREE.Color(0xFF0000);
            const white = new THREE.Color(0xFFFFFF);
            const gold = new THREE.Color(0xFFD700);
            const darkRed = new THREE.Color(0x8B0000);

            // Base platform
            for (let x = -5; x <= 5; x++) {
                for (let z = -5; z <= 5; z++) {
                    group.add(createVoxel(x, 0, z, new THREE.Color(0x8B4513)));
                }
            }

            // Pagoda levels
            const levels = [
                { size: 5, height: 3, roofHeight: 2 },
                { size: 4, height: 5, roofHeight: 2 },
                { size: 3, height: 7, roofHeight: 2 },
                { size: 2, height: 9, roofHeight: 2 },
                { size: 1, height: 11, roofHeight: 1 }
            ];

            levels.forEach((level, index) => {
                // Walls
                for (let x = -level.size; x <= level.size; x++) {
                    for (let z = -level.size; z <= level.size; z++) {
                        if (x === -level.size || x === level.size || z === -level.size || z === level.size) {
                            for (let y = 1; y <= level.height; y++) {
                                group.add(createVoxel(x, y, z, index % 2 === 0 ? red : white));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Roof
                for (let y = level.height + 1; y <= level.height + level.roofHeight; y++) {
                    const roofSize = level.size - (y - level.height);
                    for (let x = -roofSize; x <= roofSize; x++) {
                        for (let z = -roofSize; z <= roofSize; z++) {
                            if (Math.abs(x) === roofSize || Math.abs(z) === roofSize) {
                                group.add(createVoxel(x, y, z, gold));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Roof ornament
                group.add(createVoxel(0, level.height + level.roofHeight + 1, 0, gold));
            });

            return group;
        }

        // Create cherry blossom tree
        function createCherryTree(x, z) {
            const group = new THREE.Group();

            // Trunk
            const brown = new THREE.Color(0x8B4513);
            for (let y = 0; y < 5; y++) {
                group.add(createVoxel(x, y, z, brown));
            }

            // Leaves and blossoms
            const colors = [
                new THREE.Color(0xFFB6C1), // Light pink
                new THREE.Color(0xFF69B4), // Hot pink
                new THREE.Color(0xFFC0CB)  // Pink
            ];

            // Create a spherical canopy
            const radius = 4;
            for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
                const theta = Math.random() * Math.PI;
                const phi = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const r = radius * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3);

                const leafX = x + r * Math.sin(theta) * Math.cos(phi);
                const leafY = 5 + r * Math.cos(theta);
                const leafZ = z + r * Math.sin(theta) * Math.sin(phi);

                if (leafY > 4) { // Only above the trunk
                    const color = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
                    group.add(createVoxel(Math.round(leafX), Math.round(leafY), Math.round(leafZ), color));
                }
            }

            return group;
        }

        // Create regular tree
        function createTree(x, z) {
            const group = new THREE.Group();

            // Trunk
            const brown = new THREE.Color(0x8B4513);
            for (let y = 0; y < 4; y++) {
                group.add(createVoxel(x, y, z, brown));
            }

            // Leaves
            const green = new THREE.Color(0x228B22);
            for (let y = 3; y < 7; y++) {
                const radius = 4 - (y - 3);
                for (let dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
                    for (let dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
                        if (Math.abs(dx) === radius || Math.abs(dz) === radius ||
                            (Math.random() > 0.5 && (dx !== 0 || dz !== 0))) {
                            group.add(createVoxel(x + dx, y, z + dz, green));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            return group;
        }

        // Create ground
        function createGround() {
            const group = new THREE.Group();
            const grassColor = new THREE.Color(0x7CFC00);
            const pathColor = new THREE.Color(0xD2B48C);

            for (let x = -20; x <= 20; x++) {
                for (let z = -20; z <= 20; z++) {
                    // Create a winding path
                    if ((x === 0 || z === 0) ||
                        (Math.abs(x) === 5 && z >= -5 && z <= 5) ||
                        (Math.abs(z) === 5 && x >= -5 && x <= 5)) {
                        group.add(createVoxel(x, -0.5, z, pathColor));
                    } else {
                        group.add(createVoxel(x, -0.5, z, grassColor));
                    }
                }
            }

            return group;
        }

        // Create pond
        function createPond() {
            const group = new THREE.Group();
            const waterColor = new THREE.Color(0x1E90FF);

            for (let x = -8; x <= 8; x++) {
                for (let z = -8; z <= 8; z++) {
                    if (Math.sqrt(x*x + z*z) <= 8) {
                        group.add(createVoxel(x, -0.4, z, waterColor));
                    }
                }
            }

            // Add some lily pads
            const lilyColor = new THREE.Color(0x32CD32);
            for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const radius = 4 + Math.random() * 3;
                const x = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
                const z = Math.sin(angle) * radius;

                group.add(createVoxel(Math.round(x), -0.3, Math.round(z), lilyColor));
            }

            return group;
        }

        // Create rocks
        function createRocks() {
            const group = new THREE.Group();
            const rockColor = new THREE.Color(0xA9A9A9);

            const positions = [
                {x: 10, z: 5}, {x: -10, z: 5}, {x: 10, z: -5}, {x: -10, z: -5},
                {x: 5, z: 10}, {x: -5, z: 10}, {x: 5, z: -10}, {x: -5, z: -10}
            ];

            positions.forEach(pos => {
                const size = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
                for (let x = -size; x <= size; x++) {
                    for (let y = 0; y <= size; y++) {
                        for (let z = -size; z <= size; z++) {
                            if (Math.random() > 0.3 || (x === -size || x === size || y === 0 || y === size || z === -size || z === size)) {
                                group.add(createVoxel(pos.x + x, y, pos.z + z, rockColor));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });

            return group;
        }

        // Create lanterns
        function createLanterns() {
            const group = new THREE.Group();
            const lanternColor = new THREE.Color(0xFF4500);
            const poleColor = new THREE.Color(0x808080);

            const positions = [
                {x: 5, z: 5}, {x: -5, z: 5}, {x: 5, z: -5}, {x: -5, z: -5}
            ];

            positions.forEach(pos => {
                // Pole
                for (let y = 0; y < 4; y++) {
                    group.add(createVoxel(pos.x, y, pos.z, poleColor));
                }

                // Lantern
                group.add(createVoxel(pos.x, 4, pos.z, lanternColor));
                group.add(createVoxel(pos.x, 5, pos.z, lanternColor));
                group.add(createVoxel(pos.x, 6, pos.z, lanternColor));

                // Light effect
                const light = new THREE.PointLight(0xFF4500, 1, 5);
                light.position.set(pos.x, 5, pos.z);
                group.add(light);
            });

            return group;
        }

        // Create the scene
        const pagoda = createPagoda();
        pagoda.position.set(0, 0, 0);
        scene.add(pagoda);

        const ground = createGround();
        scene.add(ground);

        const pond = createPond();
        pond.position.set(0, -0.5, 0);
        scene.add(pond);

        const rocks = createRocks();
        scene.add(rocks);

        const lanterns = createLanterns();
        scene.add(lanterns);

        // Add trees
        scene.add(createCherryTree(8, 8));
        scene.add(createCherryTree(-8, 8));
        scene.add(createCherryTree(8, -8));
        scene.add(createCherryTree(-8, -8));
        scene.add(createTree(12, 12));
        scene.add(createTree(-12, 12));
        scene.add(createTree(12, -12));
        scene.add(createTree(-12, -12));

        // Position camera
        camera.position.set(15, 10, 15);
        controls.target.set(0, 5, 0);
        controls.update();

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            controls.update();
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });

        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    // Trees

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <title>Voxel Pagoda in a Garden</title>
  <!--
    This page is fully self-contained except for loading the minified ThreeJS
    from its official CDN. If truly offline usage is desired, you can embed
    the ThreeJS source code here instead. For brevity, we use the CDN.
  -->
  <style>
    html, body {
      margin: 0; 
      padding: 0; 
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    canvas {
      display: block; 
      width: 100vw; 
      height: 100vh;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="sceneCanvas"></canvas>

<!-- ThreeJS via CDN; replace with an inline script for complete offline usage -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.154.0/build/three.min.js"></script>

<script>
(function() {
  // Basic Setup
  const canvas = document.getElementById('sceneCanvas');
  const scene = new THREE.Scene();
  scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xa8def0);

  const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
    60, 
    window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 
    0.1, 
    200
  );
  camera.position.set(25, 25, 25);

  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas: canvas, antialias: true });
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
  renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;

  // Lights
  const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
  scene.add(ambient);

  const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
  dirLight.position.set(30, 50, -30);
  dirLight.castShadow = true;
  dirLight.shadow.camera.left = -50;
  dirLight.shadow.camera.right = 50;
  dirLight.shadow.camera.top = 50;
  dirLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -50;
  dirLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 2048;
  dirLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 2048;
  scene.add(dirLight);

  // A helper function to add a voxel (cube) of a given color at (x, y, z).
  const basicGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
  function addVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
    const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color });
    const vox = new THREE.Mesh(basicGeometry, mat);
    vox.position.set(x, y, z);
    vox.castShadow = true;
    vox.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(vox);
    return vox;
  }

  // Create a "ground" out of voxels (or just a large green ground).
  // For a more "voxel" look, scatter small cubes. 
  // We'll do a flat plane of cubes for visual effect.
  const groundSize = 40;
  for (let gx = -groundSize/2; gx < groundSize/2; gx++) {
    for (let gz = -groundSize/2; gz < groundSize/2; gz++) {
      // Vary the green color slightly
      const shade = 0x006600 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x002200);
      addVoxel(gx, 0, gz, shade);
    }
  }

  // Build a basic multi-level pagoda structure in the center using voxel blocks.
  // We'll do 3 tiers for demonstration; feel free to adjust for more detail.
  // Base:
  for (let x = -4; x <= 4; x++) {
    for (let z = -4; z <= 4; z++) {
      addVoxel(x, 1, z, 0x8B4513); // Base in a brownish color
    }
  }

  // 1st level:
  for (let x = -3; x <= 3; x++) {
    for (let z = -3; z <= 3; z++) {
      addVoxel(x, 2, z, 0xCD853F); // Slightly lighter brown
    }
  }
  // 2nd level:
  for (let x = -2; x <= 2; x++) {
    for (let z = -2; z <= 2; z++) {
      if (Math.abs(x) === 2 || Math.abs(z) === 2) {
        addVoxel(x, 3, z, 0xCD853F);
      } else {
        addVoxel(x, 3, z, 0xFFD700); // Decorate center with gold color
      }
    }
  }
  // 3rd level / top:
  for (let x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
    for (let z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {
      addVoxel(x, 4, z, 0x8B4513);
    }
  }
  // Small spire on top
  addVoxel(0, 5, 0, 0xFFD700);

  // A few columns or corners around the base to evoke pagoda pillars
  for (let y = 2; y <= 5; y++) {
    addVoxel(-4, y, -4, 0x8B4513);
    addVoxel( 4, y, -4, 0x8B4513);
    addVoxel(-4, y,  4, 0x8B4513);
    addVoxel( 4, y,  4, 0x8B4513);
  }

  // Create a few trees around: trunk (brown), leaves (green or pink for cherry blossoms)
  // We'll place them in random positions at the edge.
  function addTree(x, z, isCherry = false) {
    // trunk
    for (let y = 1; y <= 3; y++) {
      addVoxel(x, y, z, 0x8B4513);
    }
    // leaves
    const leafColor = isCherry ? 0xFFB7C5 : 0x228B22; // pink or green
    for (let lx = -1; lx <= 1; lx++) {
      for (let lz = -1; lz <= 1; lz++) {
        for (let ly = 4; ly <= 5; ly++) {
          // Make a nice cubic crown
          if (Math.random() < 0.9) { 
            addVoxel(x+lx, ly, z+lz, leafColor);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Scatter a mix of cherry blossom trees and normal green trees
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const px = Math.floor(Math.random() * groundSize - groundSize/2);
    const pz = Math.floor(Math.random() * groundSize - groundSize/2);
    // Prevent spawning too close to the pagoda
    if (Math.abs(px) < 6 && Math.abs(pz) < 6) continue;
    addTree(px, pz, Math.random() > 0.5); 
  }

  // A simple slow orbit around the center
  let angle = 0;
  function animate() {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    angle += 0.001;
    const radius = 40;
    camera.position.x = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
    camera.position.z = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
    camera.lookAt(0, 2, 0); 
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
  }
  animate();

  // Handle screen resizing
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
    const w = window.innerWidth;
    const h = window.innerHeight;
    camera.aspect = w / h;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(w, h);
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
