<html>
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>Voxel Art Pagoda Garden Scene</title>
    <style>
      body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #87CEEB; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <!-- Three.js from CDN -->
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <!-- OrbitControls for easy scene navigation -->
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
    <script>
      // Basic setup: scene, camera, and renderer
      const scene = new THREE.Scene();
      scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB); // sky blue

      const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
      camera.position.set(20, 20, 20);
      camera.lookAt(0,0,0);

      const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
      document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

      // Add orbit controls so we can pan/zoom
      const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
      controls.target.set(0, 5, 0);
      controls.update();

      // A simple helper function to add a voxel (cube) at a given position with a color.
      function addCube(x, y, z, size, color) {
        const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
        const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: color });
        const cube = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
        cube.position.set(x, y, z);
        scene.add(cube);
      }

      // Create a “voxelized” ground by tiling cubes (a grid of small green cubes)
      function createGround() {
        const groundSize = 31; // odd number so center is zero
        const voxelSize = 1;
        const start = -Math.floor(groundSize/2);
        for (let i = 0; i < groundSize; i++){
          for (let j = 0; j < groundSize; j++){
            // For variety, use slightly different greens.
            let color = (Math.random() < 0.1) ? 0x6B8E23 : 0x228B22;
            addCube(start + i, 0, start + j, voxelSize, color);
          }
        }
      }
      createGround();

      // Build a tiered pagoda out of voxels at a specified center point.
      // We create three floors; each floor is a “frame” of blocks and then a colorful roof.
      function buildPagoda(cx, cy, cz) {
        const voxelSize = 1;
        // For each floor, define outer square size and inner hollow size.
        const floors = [
          { base: cy, outer: 9, inner: 7, color: 0xFFFFFF }, // white stone
          { base: cy + 3, outer: 7, inner: 5, color: 0xF8F8FF },
          { base: cy + 6, outer: 5, inner: 3, color: 0xFFFFFF },
        ];
        floors.forEach(floor => {
          const start = Math.floor(-floor.outer/2);
          const end = Math.floor(floor.outer/2);
          for (let x = start; x <= end; x++){
            for (let z = start; z <= end; z++){
              // Create a border by skipping the inner area.
              if (Math.abs(x) < Math.floor(floor.inner/2)+1 && Math.abs(z) < Math.floor(floor.inner/2)+1) continue;
              addCube(cx + x * voxelSize, floor.base, cz + z * voxelSize, voxelSize, floor.color);
            }
          }
        });
        // Add roofs for each floor with a slight overhang.
        const roofColors = [0xCC0000, 0xB22222, 0xDC143C]; // rich reds
        floors.forEach((floor, idx) => {
          const roofLevel = floor.base + 2; // situate roof a bit higher than floor blocks
          const roofSize = floor.outer + 2; // roof extends out
          const start = -Math.floor(roofSize/2);
          const end = Math.floor(roofSize/2);
          for (let x = start; x <= end; x++){
            for (let z = start; z <= end; z++){
              // Make a sloping roof: higher in the center
              let distance = Math.max(Math.abs(x), Math.abs(z));
              // Use only the outer slope: skip the center too much.
              if(distance < Math.floor(roofSize/2) - 1) continue;
              addCube(cx + x * voxelSize, roofLevel, cz + z * voxelSize, voxelSize, roofColors[idx]);
            }
          }
        });
        // Crown the pagoda with a small dome-like top using a single cube
        addCube(cx, cy + 9, cz, voxelSize, 0xFFD700); // gold color accent.
      }
      buildPagoda(0, 1, 0);

      // Function to create a simple cherry blossom tree at a given position.
      function createCherryTree(x, y, z) {
        const voxelSize = 1;
        // Create trunk: a stack of brown cubes.
        let trunkHeight = 4;
        for (let i = 0; i < trunkHeight; i++){
          addCube(x, y + i, z, voxelSize, 0x8B4513);
        }
        // Create a canopy of pink cubes (cherry blossoms)
        // We form a roughly spherical cluster above the trunk.
        const canopyColors = [0xFFC0CB, 0xFFB6C1];
        for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++){
          for (let dy = 0; dy <= 3; dy++){
            for (let dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++){
              // Use a simple distance measure to create a round shape.
              if (dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz <= 7) {
                // Randomly skip some cubes for a more natural look.
                if (Math.random() < 0.2) continue;
                let col = canopyColors[Math.floor(Math.random()*canopyColors.length)];
                addCube(x + dx, y + trunkHeight + dy, z + dz, voxelSize, col);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Place several cherry blossom trees in the garden.
      const treePositions = [
        {x: 10, z: 10},
        {x: -12, z: 8},
        {x: 8, z: -10},
        {x: -10, z: -8},
        {x: 14, z: -2},
        {x: -14, z: 2}
      ];
      treePositions.forEach(pos => createCherryTree(pos.x, 1, pos.z));

      // Add some subtle ambient and directional lighting.
      const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x888888);
      scene.add(ambientLight);

      const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
      directionalLight.position.set(20, 40, 10);
      scene.add(directionalLight);

      // Handle window resize.
      window.addEventListener('resize', function(){
          renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
          camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
          camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      });

      // Animation loop.
      function animate() {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
      }
      animate();
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.152.2/build/three.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.152.2/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
<script>
  // Basic Three.js setup
  const scene = new THREE.Scene();
  scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xa0d8f0);
  const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 500);
  camera.position.set(30, 30, 30);
  camera.lookAt(0, 5, 0);
  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias: true});
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

  // Controls
  const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
  controls.target.set(0,5,0);
  controls.update();

  // Lights
  scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x555555));
  const dir = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
  dir.position.set(20, 50, 10);
  scene.add(dir);

  // Voxel geometry & material cache
  const voxelGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1);
  const materials = {};
  function getMat(color){
    if(!materials[color]){
      materials[color] = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color: color});
    }
    return materials[color];
  }
  function addVoxel(x,y,z,color){
    const m = getMat(color);
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(voxelGeo, m);
    mesh.position.set(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5);
    scene.add(mesh);
  }

  // Ground (grass)
  for(let x=-15; x<=15; x++){
    for(let z=-15; z<=15; z++){
      // slight color variation
      const c = (Math.random()<0.1 ? 0x1e7a1e : 0x228b22);
      addVoxel(x, 0, z, c);
    }
  }

  // Pagoda builder
  function buildTier(size, baseY, wallHeight, colorWall, colorRoof){
    const half = Math.floor(size/2);
    // walls
    for(let y=baseY; y<baseY+wallHeight; y++){
      for(let x=-half+1; x<=half-1; x++){
        for(let z=-half+1; z<=half-1; z++){
          // border only
          if(Math.abs(x)===half-1 || Math.abs(z)===half-1){
            addVoxel(x, y, z, colorWall);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    // roof overhang
    const roofY = baseY + wallHeight;
    for(let x=-half; x<=half; x++){
      for(let z=-half; z<=half; z++){
        if(Math.abs(x)===half || Math.abs(z)===half){
          addVoxel(x, roofY, z, colorRoof);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Build pagoda: platform + 3 tiers + pinnacle
  // Platform
  for(let x=-5; x<=5; x++){
    for(let z=-5; z<=5; z++){
      addVoxel(x, 1, z, 0x555555);
    }
  }
  // Tier 1
  buildTier(9, 2, 3, 0xaa7744, 0xcc2222);
  // Tier 2
  buildTier(7, 6, 2, 0xaa7744, 0xcc3333);
  // Tier 3
  buildTier(5, 9, 2, 0xaa7744, 0xcc4444);
  // Pinnacle
  addVoxel(0, 12, 0, 0xffcc00);
  addVoxel(0, 13, 0, 0xffcc00);

  // Cherry tree generator
  function addCherryTree(x0, z0){
    const trunkHeight = 4;
    // trunk
    for(let y=1; y<=trunkHeight; y++){
      addVoxel(x0, y, z0, 0x8b4513);
    }
    // blossoms & leaves
    for(let dx=-2; dx<=2; dx++){
      for(let dz=-2; dz<=2; dz++){
        for(let dy=0; dy<=2; dy++){
          const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz + dy*dy);
          if(dist < 3 && Math.random()<0.7){
            const col = (Math.random()<0.6 ? 0xff99cc : 0x88cc88);
            addVoxel(x0+dx, trunkHeight+dy, z0+dz, col);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Pine tree generator
  function addPineTree(x0, z0){
    const h = 5;
    for(let y=1; y<=h; y++){
      addVoxel(x0, y, z0, 0x8b4513);
    }
    // layers of leaves
    for(let lvl=0; lvl<4; lvl++){
      const y = h + lvl;
      const r = 3 - lvl;
      for(let dx=-r; dx<=r; dx++){
        for(let dz=-r; dz<=r; dz++){
          if(Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dz) <= r){
            addVoxel(x0+dx, y, z0+dz, 0x33aa33);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Add some trees
  addCherryTree(-8, -8);
  addCherryTree(7, -7);
  addPineTree(-10, 7);

  // Scattered petals on ground
  for(let i=0; i<200; i++){
    if(Math.random()<0.05){
      const x = Math.floor(Math.random()*31 - 15);
      const z = Math.floor(Math.random()*31 - 15);
      addVoxel(x, 1, z, 0xff99cc);
    }
  }

  // Render loop
  function animate(){
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
  }
  animate();

  // Handle resize
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  });
</script>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
        canvas { display: block; }
        .glow {
            filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px #fff8e1);
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.155.0/build/three.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.155.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene Setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xa2e8af);
        scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xa2e8af, 50, 150);

        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 500);
        camera.position.set(0, 30, 80);

        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias: true});
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
        renderer.domElement.classList.add('glow');

        const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;

        // Materials
        const materials = {
            pagodaWood: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: 0x8b4513}),
            pagodaRoof: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: 0xff4500}),
            pagodaGold: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: 0xffd700}),
            grass: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: 0x228B22}),
            cherryBlossom: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: 0xffb6c1}),
            trunk: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: 0x5c4033}),
            water: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: 0x4682b4, transparent: true, opacity: 0.7})
        };

        // Voxel Creation Helper
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, material, scale = 1) {
            const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1 * scale, 1 * scale, 1 * scale);
            const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, material);
            mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
            return mesh;
        }

        // Pagoda Base
        function buildPagoda() {
            const pagoda = new THREE.Group();
            
            // Foundation
            for (let x = -5; x <= 5; x++) {
                for (let z = -5; z <= 5; z++) {
                    pagoda.add(createVoxel(x, 0, z, materials.pagodaWood));
                }
            }

            // Tiers
            const tierColors = [0xff4500, 0xffd700, 0x00ced1, 0x32cd32, 0x9370db];
            for (let tier = 0; tier < 5; tier++) {
                const size = 10 - tier * 2;
                const y = tier * 3 + 1.5;
                const roofMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: tierColors[tier % tierColors.length]});
                
                // Walls
                for (let x = -size/2; x <= size/2; x++) {
                    for (let z = -size/2; z <= size/2; z++) {
                        if (Math.abs(x) === size/2 || Math.abs(z) === size/2) {
                            pagoda.add(createVoxel(x, y, z, materials.pagodaWood, 1));
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Roof
                pagoda.add(createVoxel(0, y + 1.5, 0, roofMat, size * 1.2));
                
                // Lanterns
                const lanternPos = [-size/2, size/2];
                lanternPos.forEach(px => {
                    lanternPos.forEach(pz => {
                        if (Math.random() > 0.3) {
                            const lantern = createVoxel(px, y + 3, pz, materials.pagodaGold);
                            lantern.userData.isLantern = true;
                            pagoda.add(lantern);
                        }
                    });
                });
            }

            scene.add(pagoda);
            return pagoda;
        }

        // Cherry Blossom Tree
        function createCherryTree(x, z) {
            const tree = new THREE.Group();
            
            // Trunk
            for (let y = 1; y <= 5; y++) {
                tree.add(createVoxel(x, y, z, materials.trunk));
            }
            
            // Leaves
            for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
                const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const radius = Math.random() * 5;
                const y = Math.random() * 3 + 5;
                const offset = Math.random() * 2;
                
                const pos = {
                    x: x + Math.cos(angle) * radius,
                    y: y + Math.random() * 2,
                    z: z + Math.sin(angle) * radius
                };
                
                // Green leaves
                tree.add(createVoxel(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, materials.grass));
                
                // Blossoms
                if (Math.random() > 0.6) {
                    pos.x += Math.random() - 0.5;
                    pos.z += Math.random() - 0.5;
                    tree.add(createVoxel(pos.x, pos.y + offset, pos.z, materials.cherryBlossom));
                }
            }
            
            scene.add(tree);
            return tree;
        }

        // Garden Ground
        function createGround() {
            const ground = new THREE.Group();
            for (let x = -50; x <= 50; x++) {
                for (let z = -50; z <= 50; z++) {
                    if (Math.random() > 0.2) {
                        ground.add(createVoxel(x, -1, z, materials.grass));
                    }
                }
            }
            scene.add(ground);
        }

        // Pond
        function createPond() {
            const pond = new THREE.Group();
            for (let x = -15; x <= -5; x++) {
                for (let z = 15; z <= 25; z++) {
                    pond.add(createVoxel(x, -0.5, z, materials.water));
                }
            }
            // Ripple effects
            for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
                const x = -15 + Math.random() * 10;
                const z = 15 + Math.random() * 10;
                const ripple = createVoxel(x, -0.3, z, materials.water);
                ripple.material.opacity = 0.4;
                pond.add(ripple);
            }
            scene.add(pond);
        }

        // Lighting
        function setupLighting() {
            const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
            scene.add(ambient);
            
            const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
            sun.position.set(20, 50, 30);
            scene.add(sun);
            
            // Lantern glow
            const lanternLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xffd700, 1, 10);
            scene.add(lanternLight);
            return lanternLight;
        }

        // Petal Particle System
        function createPetals() {
            const petalGroup = new THREE.Group();
            const petalGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.3, 0.3, 0.3);
            const petalMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: 0xffb6c1});
            
            for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
                const petal = new THREE.Mesh(petalGeo, petalMat);
                petal.position.set(
                    -25 + Math.random() * 50,
                    10 + Math.random() * 10,
                    -25 + Math.random() * 50
                );
                petal.userData = {
                    speed: 0.01 + Math.random() * 0.02,
                    sway: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
                };
                petalGroup.add(petal);
            }
            scene.add(petalGroup);
            return petalGroup;
        }

        // Build the scene
        const pagoda = buildPagoda();
        createGround();
        createPond();
        const lanternLight = setupLighting();
        const petals = createPetals();

        // Trees around garden
        const treePositions = [
            {x: -20, z: -20}, {x: 15, z: -25}, {x: 25, z: 0},
            {x: -30, z: 10}, {x: 0, z: 25}, {x: 30, z: 20}
        ];
        treePositions.forEach(pos => createCherryTree(pos.x, pos.z));

        // Animation Loop
        let clock = new THREE.Clock();
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            controls.update();
            
            const time = clock.getElapsedTime();
            
            // Animate lantern glow
            lanternLight.intensity = 0.8 + Math.sin(time * 2) * 0.3;
            
            // Animate petals
            petals.children.forEach(petal => {
                petal.position.y -= petal.userData.speed;
                petal.position.x += Math.sin(time + petal.userData.sway) * 0.01;
                
                if (petal.position.y < 0) {
                    petal.position.y = 15 + Math.random() * 5;
                    petal.position.x = -25 + Math.random() * 50;
                }
            });
            
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // Handle resizing
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(45, 25, 45);
        camera.lookAt(15, 5, 15);
        
        // Renderer
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
        
        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        
        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xFFD700, 0.8);
        directionalLight.position.set(20, 30, 20);
        directionalLight.castShadow = true;
        scene.add(directionalLight);
        
        // Ground plane (grass)
        const groundGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(50, 50);
        const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ 
            color: 0x3A7D44,
            emissive: 0x1A5D1A,
            emissiveIntensity: 0.2
        });
        const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);
        ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        ground.position.y = -0.5;
        ground.receiveShadow = true;
        scene.add(ground);
        
        // Voxel generator function
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, color, size = 1) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
            const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ 
                color: color,
                emissive: color * 0.2,
                emissiveIntensity: 0.3,
                shininess: 30
            });
            const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            voxel.position.set(x, y, z);
            voxel.castShadow = true;
            voxel.receiveShadow = true;
            scene.add(voxel);
            return voxel;
        }
        
        // Create pagoda (5-tiered with intricate details)
        function createPagoda() {
            const baseX = 15;
            const baseZ = 15;
            const colors = {
                wood: 0x8B4513,
                roof: 0xB22222,
                gold: 0xD4AF37,
                jade: 0x00A86B,
                lantern: 0xFF4500
            };
            
            // Base platform (stone)
            for (let x = 10; x <= 20; x++) {
                for (let z = 10; z <= 20; z++) {
                    createVoxel(x, 0.5, z, 0x708090, 1);
                }
            }
            
            // First tier (main hall)
            for (let x = 12; x <= 18; x++) {
                for (let z = 12; z <= 18; z++) {
                    createVoxel(x, 1.5, z, colors.wood);
                    if (x === 12 || x === 18 || z === 12 || z === 18) {
                        createVoxel(x, 2.5, z, colors.wood);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // First tier roof (with intricate details)
            for (let x = 11; x <= 19; x++) {
                for (let z = 11; z <= 19; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x - 15) + Math.abs(z - 15) <= 8) {
                        createVoxel(x, 3.5, z, colors.roof);
                        
                        // Roof decorations
                        if ((x === 11 || x === 19) && (z === 11 || z === 19)) {
                            createVoxel(x, 4.5, z, colors.gold);
                            createVoxel(x, 5.5, z, colors.jade);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Second tier
            for (let x = 13; x <= 17; x++) {
                for (let z = 13; z <= 17; z++) {
                    createVoxel(x, 4.5, z, colors.wood);
                    if (x === 13 || x === 17 || z === 13 || z === 17) {
                        createVoxel(x, 5.5, z, colors.wood);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Second tier roof
            for (let x = 12; x <= 18; x++) {
                for (let z = 12; z <= 18; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x - 15) + Math.abs(z - 15) <= 6) {
                        createVoxel(x, 6.5, z, colors.roof);
                        
                        // Roof ornaments
                        if ((x === 12 || x === 18) && (z === 12 || z === 18)) {
                            createVoxel(x, 7.5, z, colors.gold);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Third tier
            for (let x = 14; x <= 16; x++) {
                for (let z = 14; z <= 16; z++) {
                    createVoxel(x, 7.5, z, colors.wood);
                    if (x === 14 || x === 16 || z === 14 || z === 16) {
                        createVoxel(x, 8.5, z, colors.wood);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Third tier roof
            for (let x = 13; x <= 17; x++) {
                for (let z = 13; z <= 17; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x - 15) + Math.abs(z - 15) <= 4) {
                        createVoxel(x, 9.5, z, colors.roof);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Fourth tier (smaller)
            for (let x = 14; x <= 16; x++) {
                for (let z = 14; z <= 16; z++) {
                    if (x === 14 || x === 16 || z === 14 || z === 16) {
                        createVoxel(x, 10.5, z, colors.wood);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Fourth tier roof
            for (let x = 13; x <= 17; x++) {
                for (let z = 13; z <= 17; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x - 15) + Math.abs(z - 15) <= 3) {
                        createVoxel(x, 11.5, z, colors.roof);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Fifth tier (top)
            createVoxel(15, 12.5, 15, colors.wood);
            createVoxel(15, 13.5, 15, colors.roof);
            
            // Spire
            createVoxel(15, 14.5, 15, colors.gold);
            createVoxel(15, 15.5, 15, colors.jade);
            createVoxel(15, 16.5, 15, colors.gold);
            
            // Lanterns
            createVoxel(15, 3, 11, colors.lantern);
            createVoxel(15, 3, 19, colors.lantern);
            createVoxel(11, 3, 15, colors.lantern);
            createVoxel(19, 3, 15, colors.lantern);
            
            // Balcony railings
            for (let x = 12; x <= 18; x += 2) {
                createVoxel(x, 2.5, 11.5, 0x4A3728);
                createVoxel(x, 2.5, 18.5, 0x4A3728);
            }
            for (let z = 12; z <= 18; z += 2) {
                createVoxel(11.5, 2.5, z, 0x4A3728);
                createVoxel(18.5, 2.5, z, 0x4A3728);
            }
        }
        
        // Create cherry blossom tree
        function createCherryBlossomTree(x, z) {
            // Trunk
            for (let y = 1; y <= 4; y++) {
                createVoxel(x, y, z, 0x5D4037);
            }
            
            // Branches (organic structure)
            const branches = [
                {dx: 1, dy: 2, dz: 1, len: 3},
                {dx: -1, dy: 2, dz: -1, len: 3},
                {dx: 2, dy: 3, dz: 0, len: 2},
                {dx: -2, dy: 3, dz: 0, len: 2},
                {dx: 0, dy: 3, dz: 2, len: 2},
                {dx: 0, dy: 3, dz: -2, len: 2}
            ];
            
            branches.forEach(branch => {
                for (let i = 1; i <= branch.len; i++) {
                    createVoxel(
                        x + branch.dx * i,
                        1 + branch.dy + i * 0.3,
                        z + branch.dz * i,
                        0x8D6E63
                    );
                }
            });
            
            // Blossoms (pink spheres)
            const blossomPositions = [
                // Main clusters
                [0, 4, 0], [1, 4.5, 1], [-1, 4.5, -1], [2, 4, 0], [-2, 4, 0],
                [0, 4, 2], [0, 4, -2], [1, 5, -1], [-1, 5, 1], [2, 3.5, 1],
                [-2, 3.5, -1], [1, 3.5, 2], [-1, 3.5, -2], [3, 4, 0], [-3, 4, 0],
                [0, 4, 3], [0, 4, -3], [2, 5, 2], [-2, 5, -2], [2, 5, -2], [-2, 5, 2],
                // Smaller clusters
                [1, 3, 0], [-1, 3, 0], [0, 3, 1], [0, 3, -1], [1.5, 4, 1.5], [-1.5, 4, -1.5]
            ];
            
            blossomPositions.forEach(pos => {
                const colorVariants = [0xFFB6C1, 0xFFC0CB, 0xFF9999, 0xFFE4E1];
                const color = colorVariants[Math.floor(Math.random() * colorVariants.length)];
                
                // Create blossom sphere (approximated with voxels)
                for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
                    for (let j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {
                        for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) {
                            if (Math.random() > 0.3) { // Random density
                                const dist = Math.sqrt(i*i + j*j + k*k);
                                if (dist < 1.2) {
                                    createVoxel(
                                        x + pos[0] + i * 0.5,
                                        1 + pos[1] + j * 0.5,
                                        z + pos[2] + k * 0.5,
                                        color,
                                        0.5
                                    );
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }
        
        // Create regular tree
        function createMapleTree(x, z) {
            // Trunk
            for (let y = 1; y <= 4; y++) {
                createVoxel(x, y, z, 0x5D4037);
            }
            
            // Leaves (colorful autumn palette)
            const leafColors = [0xFF4500, 0xFF8C00, 0xFFD700, 0x32CD32];
            const radius = 3.5;
            
            for (let dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
                for (let dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
                    for (let dy = 0; dy <= radius * 1.5; dy++) {
                        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
                        if (dist < radius && dist > radius - 1.5) {
                            const color = leafColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * leafColors.length)];
                            createVoxel(
                                x + dx,
                                4 + dy,
                                z + dz,
                                color,
                                0.8
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Create pond
        function createPond() {
            const waterColors = [0x1E90FF, 0x00BFFF, 0x87CEFA];
            
            for (let x = 5; x <= 10; x++) {
                for (let z = 20; z <= 25; z++) {
                    // Circular pond shape
                    const centerX = 7.5;
                    const centerZ = 22.5;
                    const dist = Math.sqrt((x - centerX)**2 + (z - centerZ)**2);
                    
                    if (dist < 3.5) {
                        const color = waterColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * waterColors.length)];
                        createVoxel(x, 0.6, z, color, 1, 0.2);
                        
                        // Water lilies
                        if (Math.random() < 0.15 && dist > 2) {
                            createVoxel(x, 0.7, z, 0x008000, 0.8);
                            createVoxel(x, 0.75, z, 0xFFFFFF, 0.5);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Create rock formations
        function createRocks() {
            const rockPositions = [
                {x: 25, z: 25, size: 3}, 
                {x: 5, z: 5, size: 4},
                {x: 25, z: 5, size: 2.5},
                {x: 5, z: 25, size: 3.5}
            ];
            
            rockPositions.forEach(rock => {
                for (let i = 0; i < rock.size * 10; i++) {
                    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                    const radius = rock.size * 0.4 * Math.random();
                    const x = rock.x + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
                    const z = rock.z + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
                    const y = 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5;
                    
                    createVoxel(
                        x, 
                        y, 
                        z, 
                        0x696969 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x333333),
                        0.7 + Math.random() * 0.5
                    );
                }
            });
        }
        
        // Create path
        function createPath() {
            const pathPoints = [
                [15, 0, 5], [15, 0, 10], [15, 0, 15], [15, 0, 20], [15, 0, 25],
                [10, 0, 15], [5, 0, 15], [20, 0, 15], [25, 0, 15]
            ];
            
            pathPoints.forEach(point => {
                createVoxel(point[0], 0.5, point[2], 0xD2B48C, 1.2);
                if (Math.random() > 0.7) {
                    createVoxel(point[0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5, 
                               0.6, 
                               point[2] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5, 
                               0x8B4513, 
                               0.3);
                }
            });
        }
        
        // Create garden elements
        createPagoda();
        createCherryBlossomTree(8, 8);
        createCherryBlossomTree(22, 22);
        createCherryBlossomTree(8, 22);
        createCherryBlossomTree(22, 8);
        createCherryBlossomTree(5, 15);
        createCherryBlossomTree(25, 15);
        createMapleTree(10, 25);
        createMapleTree(20, 5);
        createMapleTree(5, 10);
        createMapleTree(25, 20);
        createPond();
        createRocks();
        createPath();
        
        // Add floating cherry blossoms
        for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
            const x = 10 + Math.random() * 10;
            const z = 10 + Math.random() * 10;
            const y = 5 + Math.random() * 10;
            const size = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4;
            createVoxel(x, y, z, 0xFFB6C1, size);
        }
        
        // Animation
        let rotation = 0;
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            
            // Gentle rotation
            rotation += 0.0005;
            scene.rotation.y = Math.sin(rotation) * 0.05;
            
            // Floating blossoms animation
            const time = Date.now() * 0.001;
            scene.children.forEach(child => {
                if (child.material && child.material.color.getHex() === 0xFFB6C1 && 
                    child.geometry.parameters.width < 0.5) {
                    child.position.y += Math.sin(time + child.position.x) * 0.005;
                    child.position.x += Math.cos(time + child.position.z) * 0.002;
                }
            });
            
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        
        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
        
        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
  <style>
    body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    canvas { display: block; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.155.0/build/three.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.155.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
  <script>
    // Scene setup
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87ceeb); // Sky blue

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    camera.position.set(0, 15, 30);

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // Lighting
    const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
    scene.add(ambientLight);

    const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
    directionalLight.position.set(10, 20, 10);
    scene.add(directionalLight);

    // Voxel creation function
    function createVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
      const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
      const material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color });
      const cube = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      cube.position.set(x, y, z);
      scene.add(cube);
    }

    // Ground (grass)
    for (let x = -20; x <= 20; x++) {
      for (let z = -20; z <= 20; z++) {
        createVoxel(x, 0, z, 0x228B22); // Green
      }
    }

    // Pagoda base
    for (let x = -5; x <= 5; x++) {
      for (let z = -5; z <= 5; z++) {
        createVoxel(x, 0, z, 0x8B4513); // Brown
      }
    }

    // Pagoda tiers
    const tierHeights = [2, 4, 6];
    const tierSizes = [9, 7, 5];
    const tierColors = [0x8B4513, 0xCD5C5C, 0xFF4500]; // Brown, Red, Orange

    for (let i = 0; i < tierHeights.length; i++) {
      const y = tierHeights[i];
      const size = tierSizes[i];
      const color = tierColors[i];

      for (let x = -size / 2; x <= size / 2; x++) {
        for (let z = -size / 2; z <= size / 2; z++) {
          createVoxel(x, y, z, color);
        }
      }
    }

    // Pagoda roof (pyramid)
    for (let x = -2; x <= 2; x++) {
      for (let z = -2; z <= 2; z++) {
        createVoxel(x, 8, z, 0xFF4500); // Orange
      }
    }

    // Tree trunk and leaves
    function createTree(x, z, trunkColor = 0x8B4513, leafColor = 0x228B22) {
      // Trunk
      for (let y = 0; y <= 2; y++) {
        createVoxel(x, y, z, trunkColor);
      }

      // Leaves
      for (let y = 3; y <= 5; y++) {
        for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
          for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
            createVoxel(x + dx, y, z + dz, leafColor);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Add multiple trees
    createTree(10, 10);
    createTree(-10, -10);
    createTree(5, -5);
    createTree(-5, 5);
    createTree(0, 10);

    // Cherry blossoms (pink voxels)
    for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
      const x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20;
      const z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20;
      const y = 5 + Math.random() * 3;
      createVoxel(x, y, z, 0xFFC0CB); // Pink
    }

    // Add decorative rocks (gray voxels)
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20;
      const z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20;
      createVoxel(x, 0.5, z, 0x808080); // Gray
    }

    // Orbit controls
    const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
    controls.enableDamping = true;

    // Animation loop
    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      controls.update();
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }
    animate();

    // Handle window resize
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
</head>
<body style="margin:0; overflow:hidden;">
  <script>
    // Scene setup
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB);
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    camera.position.set(15, 12, 15);
    camera.lookAt(5, 3, 5);
    
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
    
    // Lighting
    const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
    scene.add(ambientLight);
    
    const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
    directionalLight.position.set(10, 20, 10);
    directionalLight.castShadow = true;
    directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 1024;
    directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 1024;
    scene.add(directionalLight);
    
    // Orbit controls
    const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
    controls.enableDamping = true;
    controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;
    
    // Voxel creation function
    function addVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
      const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
      const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ 
        color: color,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide,
        shininess: 30
      });
      const cube = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      cube.position.set(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5);
      cube.castShadow = true;
      cube.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(cube);
      return cube;
    }
    
    // Generate random grass color
    function getRandomGrassColor() {
      const base = 0x009900;
      const r = (base >> 16) & 0xFF;
      const g = (base >> 8) & 0xFF;
      const b = base & 0xFF;
      return new THREE.Color(
        r + Math.random() * 20,
        g + Math.random() * 30,
        b + Math.random() * 10
      );
    }
    
    // Create ground (grass)
    for (let x = -15; x <= 15; x++) {
      for (let z = -15; z <= 15; z++) {
        const y = 0;
        const color = getRandomGrassColor();
        addVoxel(x, y, z, color);
      }
    }
    
    // Create pond
    for (let x = 7; x <= 13; x++) {
      for (let z = 7; z <= 13; z++) {
        const y = 0;
        const waterColor = (x === 7 || x === 13 || z === 7 || z === 13) ? 0x1E90FF : 0x4169E1;
        addVoxel(x, y, z, waterColor);
        
        // Add ripples
        if (Math.random() > 0.7 && (x === 8 || x === 12) && (z === 8 || z === 12)) {
          addVoxel(x, y + 0.1, z, 0x00BFFF);
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Lily pads in pond
    const lilyPadPositions = [
      [9, 0.2, 9], [11, 0.2, 11], [10, 0.2, 10], 
      [8, 0.2, 11], [12, 0.2, 9]
    ];
    for (const [x, y, z] of lilyPadPositions) {
      addVoxel(x, y, z, 0x228B22);
    }
    
    // Bridge over pond
    for (let x = 6; x <= 14; x++) {
      addVoxel(x, 0.5, 10, 0x8B4513);
      if (x === 6 || x === 14) {
        for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
          addVoxel(x, 0.5 + i, 9, 0x8B4513);
          addVoxel(x, 0.5 + i, 11, 0x8B4513);
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Create path
    const pathPoints = [
      {x: 4, z: 5}, {x: 3, z: 4}, {x: 2, z: 3},
      {x: 1, z: 2}, {x: 0, z: 1}, {x: -1, z: 0},
      {x: -1, z: -1}, {x: 0, z: -2}, {x: 1, z: -3},
      {x: 2, z: -4}, {x: 3, z: -5}
    ];
    for (const point of pathPoints) {
      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
        for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
          addVoxel(point.x + dx, 0, point.z + dz, 0x9A9A9A);
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Create cherry blossom trees
    const treePositions = [
      [-7, 3], [-5, -6], [12, -4], [14, 2], [2, 14], [-10, 8]
    ];
    
    function createCherryBlossomTree(x, z) {
      // Trunk
      for (let y = 0; y < 3; y++) {
        addVoxel(x, y, z, 0x8B4513);
      }
      
      // Canopy (pink cherry blossoms)
      const radius = 3;
      for (let i = -radius; i <= radius; i++) {
        for (let j = -radius; j <= radius; j++) {
          for (let k = -radius; k <= radius; k++) {
            const dist = Math.sqrt(i*i + j*j + k*k);
            if (dist < radius && dist > radius * 0.3) {
              const yPos = 3 + j;
              const isBlossom = Math.random() > 0.2;
              const color = isBlossom ? 
                (Math.random() > 0.7 ? 0xFFFFFF : 0xFFB6C1) : 
                (Math.random() > 0.8 ? 0x00FF00 : 0x008000);
              addVoxel(x + i, yPos, z + k, color);
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      // Floating petals
      for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
        const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const dist = Math.random() * 3;
        const height = Math.random() * 2;
        const xPet = x + Math.cos(angle) * dist;
        const zPet = z + Math.sin(angle) * dist;
        const yPet = 4 + height;
        addVoxel(xPet, yPet, zPet, 0xFFB6C1);
      }
    }
    
    treePositions.forEach(pos => createCherryBlossomTree(pos[0], pos[1]));
    
    // Create pagoda
    // Base platform
    for (let x = 1; x <= 5; x++) {
      for (let z = 1; z <= 5; z++) {
        addVoxel(x, 0, z, 0x8B4513);
      }
    }
    
    // Columns
    const columnPositions = [
      [1,1], [1,5], [5,1], [5,5], [3,3]
    ];
    columnPositions.forEach(pos => {
      for (let y = 0; y < 4; y++) {
        addVoxel(pos[0], y, pos[1], 0xFF0000);
      }
    });
    
    // Roof tiers
    const roofTiers = [
      {size: 5, y: 4, color: 0xFFFF00},  // Bottom roof
      {size: 3, y: 6, color: 0x8B0000},
      {size: 1, y: 8, color: 0xFFD700}
    ];
    
    roofTiers.forEach(tier => {
      const start = Math.floor(3 - tier.size/2);
      const end = start + tier.size;
      for (let x = start; x < end; x++) {
        for (let z = start; z < end; z++) {
          addVoxel(x, tier.y, z, tier.color);
        }
      }
    });
    
    // Roof detailing
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      addVoxel(3, 4 + i, 3, 0xFFD700);
      addVoxel(2, 4 + i, 2, 0xFFD700);
      addVoxel(4, 4 + i, 2, 0xFFD700);
      addVoxel(2, 4 + i, 4, 0xFFD700);
      addVoxel(4, 4 + i, 4, 0xFFD700);
    }
    
    // Pagoda finial
    for (let y = 9; y <= 11; y++) {
      addVoxel(3, y, 3, 0xFF4500);
    }
    addVoxel(3, 12, 3, 0xFFD700);
    
    // Decorative elements
    // Flowers on path
    const flowerPositions = [
      [-1, 0, -1], [0, 0, 0], [1, 0, -1],
      [2, 0, -4], [3, 0, -5], [1, 0, -3]
    ];
    flowerPositions.forEach(pos => {
      const color = [0xFF00FF, 0x00FFFF, 0xFFFF00, 0xFF0000][Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)];
      addVoxel(pos[0], pos[1] + 1, pos[2], color);
    });
    
    // Rocks
    const rockPositions = [
      [-12, 0, -8], [-9, 0, -12], [-6, 0, -6],
      [8, 0, -10], [12, 0, 12], [-3, 0, 13]
    ];
    rockPositions.forEach(pos => {
      for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
          addVoxel(pos[0] + i, pos[1], pos[2] + j, 0x808080);
        }
      }
    });
    
    // Bamboo fence
    for (let x = -15; x <= -8; x++) {
      for (let z = -15; z <= -8; z++) {
        if ((x === -15 || x === -8) || (z === -15 || z === -8)) {
          for (let y = 0; y < 2; y++) {
            addVoxel(x, y, z, 0x8B4513);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Render loop
    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      controls.update();
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }
    animate();
    
    // Handle window resize
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Voxel Garden Pagoda</title>
    <style>
        body { 
            margin: 0; 
            overflow: hidden; 
            background: #1a1a2e;
        }
        canvas { 
            display: block; 
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(15, 15, 20);
        camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x40403f, 0.6);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        
        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        directionalLight.position.set(5, 10, 7);
        scene.add(directionalLight);
        
        const cherryLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xff6b8a, 0.5, 50);
        cherryLight.position.set(8, 5, 8);
        scene.add(cherryLight);

        // Voxel material
        const voxelMaterial = (color) => new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ 
            color: color,
            flatShading: true 
        });

        // Color palette
        const colors = {
            pagodaGold: '#FFD700',
            pagodaRed: '#DC143C',
            pagodaGreen: '#228B22',
            stone: '#708090',
            wood: '#DEB887',
            moss: '#556B2F',
            cherryBlossom: '#FFB7C5',
            cherryDark: '#FF69B4',
            grass: '#7CFC00',
            water: '#4A90D9',
            path: '#D2B48C',
            lantern: '#FF4500',
            roofTile: '#8B0000',
            sky: '#87CEEB'
        };

        // Create voxel function
        const createVoxel = (x, y, z, size, color) => {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
            const material = voxelMaterial(color);
            const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            voxel.position.set(x, y, z);
            scene.add(voxel);
            return voxel;
        };

        // Create ground
        const createGround = () => {
            const groundSize = 50;
            const groundGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(groundSize, groundSize);
            const groundMaterial = voxelMaterial(colors.grass);
            const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);
            ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
            ground.position.y = -0.5;
            scene.add(ground);

            // Add moss patches
            for(let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                const mx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * groundSize;
                const mz = (Math.random() - 0.5) * groundSize;
                createVoxel(mx, -0.49, mz, 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5, colors.moss);
            }
        };

        // Create pagoda base
        const createPagodaBase = () => {
            const baseHeight = 1;
            for(let y = 0; y < baseHeight; y++) {
                for(let x = -3; x <= 3; x++) {
                    for(let z = -3; z <= 3; z++) {
                        if(Math.abs(x) <= 2 && Math.abs(z) <= 2) {
                            createVoxel(x, y, z, 1, colors.stone);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        };

        // Create pagoda tiers
        const createPagodaTier = (yOffset, size, color) => {
            for(let y = 0; y < 1; y++) {
                for(let x = -size; x <= size; x++) {
                    for(let z = -size; z <= size; z++) {
                        if(Math.abs(x) <= size && Math.abs(z) <= size && 
                           (Math.abs(x) >= size - 1 || Math.abs(z) >= size - 1)) {
                            createVoxel(x, y + yOffset, z, 1, color);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        };

        // Create pagoda body
        const createPagodaBody = () => {
            const tiers = [
                { y: 0, size: 4, color: colors.pagodaRed },
                { y: 1, size: 3, color: colors.pagodaGreen },
                { y: 2, size: 3, color: colors.pagodaRed },
                { y: 3, size: 2, color: colors.pagodaGreen },
                { y: 4, size: 2, color: colors.pagodaRed },
                { y: 5, size: 1, color: colors.pagodaGreen }
            ];
            
            tiers.forEach(tier => {
                for(let x = -tier.size; x <= tier.size; x++) {
                    for(let z = -tier.size; z <= tier.size; z++) {
                        if(Math.abs(x) <= tier.size && Math.abs(z) <= tier.size && 
                           (Math.abs(x) >= tier.size - 1 || Math.abs(z) >= tier.size - 1)) {
                            createVoxel(x, tier.y + 1, z, 1, tier.color);
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        };

        // Create pagoda roof
        const createPagodaRoof = () => {
            const roofLayers = [
                { y: 7, size: 4, color: colors.roofTile, tiles: 8 },
                { y: 8, size: 3, color: colors.pagodaGold, tiles: 6 },
                { y: 9, size: 2, color: colors.pagodaRed, tiles: 4 },
                { y: 10, size: 1, color: colors.pagodaGold, tiles: 2 },
                { y: 11, size: 0.5, color: colors.pagodaRed, tiles: 1 }
            ];

            roofLayers.forEach(layer => {
                for(let i = 0; i < layer.tiles; i++) {
                    const angle = (i / layer.tiles) * Math.PI * 2;
                    const tx = Math.cos(angle) * layer.size;
                    const tz = Math.sin(angle) * layer.size;
                    
                    for(let x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
                        for(let z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {
                            createVoxel(tx + x, layer.y, tz + z, 1, layer.color);
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Add decorative balls
                if(layer.y > 7) {
                    createVoxel(0, layer.y + 0.5, 0, 0.5, colors.pagodaGold);
                }
            });

            // Lantern
            createVoxel(0, 12.5, 0, 0.5, colors.lantern);
            createVoxel(0, 12, 0, 0.3, colors.pagodaGold);
        };

        // Create pagoda
        const createPagoda = () => {
            createPagodaBase();
            createPagodaBody();
            createPagodaRoof();
        };

        // Create trees
        const createTree = (x, z, height, trunkColor, leafColor) => {
            // Trunk
            for(let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
                createVoxel(x, y, z, 1, trunkColor);
            }
            
            // Leaves
            const layers = Math.floor(height / 3);
            for(let l = 0; l < layers; l++) {
                const layerHeight = height - l;
                const radius = l + 1;
                
                for(let dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
                    for(let dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
                        if(Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dz) <= radius + 1) {
                            createVoxel(x + dx, layerHeight, z + dz, 1, leafColor);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        };

        // Create multiple trees
        const trees = [
            { x: -12, z: -8, height: 8, trunk: colors.wood, leaves: '#228B22' },
            { x: 10, z: -12, height: 6, trunk: colors.wood, leaves: '#32CD32' },
            { x: -8, z: 10, height: 7, trunk: colors.wood, leaves: '#FF6347' },
            { x: 15, z: 5, height: 5, trunk: colors.wood, leaves: '#90EE90' },
            { x: -15, z: 12, height: 9, trunk: colors.wood, leaves: '#FFD700' }
        ];

        trees.forEach(tree => createTree(tree.x, tree.z, tree.height, tree.trunk, tree.leaves));

        // Create cherry blossoms
        const createCherryBlossom = (x, z) => {
            // Trunk
            createVoxel(x, 0, z, 0.3, colors.pagodaRed);
            
            // Blossom clusters
            const blossomPositions = [
                [0, 0.5, 0], [0.3, 0.6, 0.2], [-0.3, 0.6, -0.2],
                [0.2, 0.7, -0.3], [-0.2, 0.7, 0.3], [0, 0.8, 0.1]
            ];
            
            blossomPositions.forEach(pos => {
                createVoxel(x + pos[0], pos[1], z + pos[2], 0.4, colors.cherryBlossom);
                createVoxel(x + pos[0] + 0.1, pos[1] + 0.1, z + pos[2] - 0.1, 0.3, colors.cherryDark);
            });
        };

        // Create scattered cherry blossoms
        const cherryPositions = [
            [-5, -8], [3, -10], [8, 3], [-12, 5], [12, -6],
            [-3, 8], [6, 10], [-10, -3], [0, 12], [14, 2]
        ];

        cherryPositions.forEach(pos => {
            if(Math.random() > 0.3) {
                createCherryBlossom(pos[0], pos[1]);
            }
        });

        // Create garden path
        const createPath = () => {
            const pathWidth = 2;
            const pathLength = 25;
            
            for(let x = -pathLength/2; x <= pathLength/2; x++) {
                for(let z = -pathWidth; z <= pathWidth; z++) {
                    if(Math.abs(z) <= 1) {
                        createVoxel(x, -0.49, z, 1, colors.path);
                    }
                }
            }
        };

        createPath();

        // Create water feature
        const createWater = () => {
            for(let x = -4; x <= 4; x++) {
                for(let z = 6; z <= 10; z++) {
                    if(Math.random() > 0.7) {
                        createVoxel(x, -0.49, z, 1, colors.water);
                    }
                }
            }
        };

        createWater();

        // Create decorative stones
        for(let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            const sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
            const sz = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
            const size = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.5;
            createVoxel(sx, -0.5, sz, size, colors.stone);
        }

        // Create garden beds with flowers
        const flowerColors = ['#FF69B4', '#FF1493', '#DC143C', '#FF6347', '#FFD700'];
        for(let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
            const fx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
            const fz = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
            const flowerColor = flowerColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * flowerColors.length)];
            createVoxel(fx, 0, fz, 0.4, flowerColor);
        }

        // Create decorative lanterns around garden
        const lanternPositions = [
            [-8, -8], [8, 8], [-12, 10], [12, -10], [0, -12]
        ];

        lanternPositions.forEach(pos => {
            createVoxel(pos[0], 0, pos[1], 0.5, colors.lantern);
            createVoxel(pos[0], 0.5, pos[1], 0.3, colors.pagodaGold);
        });

        // Handle window
        createVoxel(0, 3, 0, 0.5, colors.water);

        // Handle resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });

        // Animation loop
        const animate = () => {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        };

        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB); // Sky blue

        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(0, 15, 30);
        camera.lookAt(0, 5, 0);

        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        directionalLight.position.set(10, 20, 10);
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Voxel helper function
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
            const material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color });
            const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            voxel.position.set(x, y, z);
            scene.add(voxel);
            return voxel;
        }

        // Ground
        for (let x = -20; x <= 20; x++) {
            for (let z = -20; z <= 20; z++) {
                createVoxel(x, 0, z, 0x7CFC00); // Lawn green
            }
        }

        // Pagoda base
        for (let x = -3; x <= 3; x++) {
            for (let z = -3; z <= 3; z++) {
                createVoxel(x, 1, z, 0x8B4513); // Brown
            }
        }

        // Pagoda levels
        for (let level = 0; level < 5; level++) {
            const y = 2 + level * 3;
            const size = 3 - level * 0.5;
            for (let x = -size; x <= size; x++) {
                for (let z = -size; z <= size; z++) {
                    createVoxel(x, y, z, 0xFFD700); // Gold
                }
            }
            // Roof
            for (let x = -size - 1; x <= size + 1; x++) {
                for (let z = -size - 1; z <= size + 1; z++) {
                    createVoxel(x, y + 1, z, 0x8B0000); // Dark red
                }
            }
        }

        // Trees
        function createTree(x, z, trunkColor, leafColor) {
            // Trunk
            for (let y = 1; y <= 4; y++) {
                createVoxel(x, y, z, trunkColor);
            }
            // Leaves
            for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
                for (let dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) {
                    for (let dy = 0; dy <= 2; dy++) {
                        if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dz) + Math.abs(dy) <= 3) {
                            createVoxel(x + dx, 5 + dy, z + dz, leafColor);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Cherry blossom trees
        function createCherryBlossomTree(x, z) {
            createTree(x, z, 0x8B4513, 0xFFB6C1); // Pink
        }

        // Place trees
        createTree(-10, -10, 0x8B4513, 0x228B22); // Green tree
        createTree(10, -10, 0x8B4513, 0x228B22);
        createCherryBlossomTree(-10, 10);
        createCherryBlossomTree(10, 10);
        createTree(-15, 0, 0x8B4513, 0x228B22);
        createCherryBlossomTree(15, 0);

        // Flowers
        const flowerColors = [0xFF0000, 0xFFFF00, 0xFF00FF, 0x00FFFF];
        for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            const x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
            const z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
            createVoxel(x, 1, z, flowerColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * flowerColors.length)]);
        }

        // Path
        for (let x = -2; x <= 2; x++) {
            for (let z = 4; z <= 15; z++) {
                createVoxel(x, 0.5, z, 0xD2B48C); // Tan
            }
        }

        // Animation
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            scene.rotation.y += 0.002;
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r134/three.min.js"></script>
    
    <script>
        // Three.js setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(65, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040, 0.7);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        
        const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff4e0, 0.9);
        dirLight.position.set(60, 120, 40);
        scene.add(dirLight);
        
        const dirLight2 = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xa0c4ff, 0.3);
        dirLight2.position.set(-50, 80, -60);
        scene.add(dirLight2);

        // Main group for all voxels (for rotation)
        const mainGroup = new THREE.Group();
        scene.add(mainGroup);

        // Voxel helper function
        function addVoxel(x, y, z, color, group = mainGroup) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
            const material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: color });
            const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            voxel.position.set(x, y, z);
            group.add(voxel);
            return voxel;
        }

        // ===== GROUND AND GARDEN =====
        const groundGroup = new THREE.Group();
        
        // Main grass field
        for (let x = -38; x <= 38; x++) {
            for (let z = -38; z <= 38; z++) {
                let y = 0;
                let color = 0x2E8B57;
                
                // Grass variation
                const noise = Math.sin(x * 0.3) * Math.cos(z * 0.4);
                if (noise > 0.4) color = 0x3CB371;
                if (noise < -0.3) color = 0x228B22;
                
                // Stone path
                if (Math.abs(z) < 3.5 && x > -5) {
                    color = 0x6B7B8C;
                }
                
                // Small hill near pagoda
                if (x > -8 && x < 8 && z > -6 && z < 6) {
                    y = 0.3;
                }
                
                addVoxel(x, y, z, color, groundGroup);
            }
        }
        
        mainGroup.add(groundGroup);

        // Koi pond
        for (let x = -22; x <= -14; x++) {
            for (let z = 12; z <= 20; z++) {
                addVoxel(x, 0, z, 0x1E90FF, groundGroup);
                // Water highlights
                if (Math.random() > 0.85) {
                    addVoxel(x, 0.5, z, 0x87CEEB, groundGroup);
                }
            }
        }

        // Pond rocks
        const rockPositions = [[-23,1,13], [-15,1,13], [-23,1,19], [-15,1,19], [-19,1,12]];
        rockPositions.forEach(pos => {
            addVoxel(pos[0], pos[1], pos[2], 0x696969, groundGroup);
            addVoxel(pos[0], pos[1]+1, pos[2], 0x808080, groundGroup);
        });

        // ===== PAGODA =====
        function createPagoda() {
            const pagoda = new THREE.Group();
            let y = 1;
            let size = 7;
            const roofColors = [0xC41E3A, 0x8B0000, 0xB22222];

            for (let level = 0; level < 4; level++) {
                // Wooden floor
                for (let x = -size; x <= size; x++) {
                    for (let z = -size; z <= size; z++) {
                        const floorColor = level === 0 ? 0xA0522D : 0xD2691E;
                        addVoxel(x, y, z, floorColor, pagoda);
                    }
                }
                y += 1;

                // Pillars and walls
                const wallHeight = 6 - Math.floor(level / 2);
                
                for (let wy = 0; wy < wallHeight; wy++) {
                    // Vertical pillars at corners and intervals
                    const interval = 2;
                    
                    // Left and right walls
                    for (let z = -size; z <= size; z += interval) {
                        addVoxel(-size, y + wy, z, 0x8B4513, pagoda);
                        addVoxel(size, y + wy, z, 0x8B4513, pagoda);
                    }
                    
                    // Front and back walls
                    for (let x = -size; x <= size; x += interval) {
                        addVoxel(x, y + wy, -size, 0x8B4513, pagoda);
                        addVoxel(x, y + wy, size, 0x8B4513, pagoda);
                    }
                }
                y += wallHeight;

                // Tiered roof
                const roofSize = size + 4;
                const roofY = y;
                const roofColor = roofColors[level % 3];

                // Main roof layer
                for (let x = -roofSize; x <= roofSize; x++) {
                    for (let z = -roofSize; z <= roofSize; z++) {
                        addVoxel(x, roofY, z, roofColor, pagoda);
                    }
                }

                // Stepped upper layers
                for (let tier = 1; tier < 5; tier++) {
                    const tierSize = roofSize - tier * 2;
                    if (tierSize < 1) break;
                    
                    for (let x = -tierSize; x <= tierSize; x++) {
                        for (let z = -tierSize; z <= tierSize; z++) {
                            const heightOffset = tier * 0.8;
                            addVoxel(x, roofY + heightOffset, z, roofColor, pagoda);
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Golden corner accents (upturned roof style)
                const corners = [[-roofSize, -roofSize], [roofSize, -roofSize], [-roofSize, roofSize], [roofSize, roofSize]];
                corners.forEach(([cx, cz]) => {
                    addVoxel(cx, roofY + 3.5, cz, 0xFFD700, pagoda);
                    addVoxel(cx + 1, roofY + 3.2, cz, 0xFFD700, pagoda);
                    addVoxel(cx, roofY + 3.2, cz + 1, 0xFFD700, pagoda);
                });

                y += 5;
                size -= 1.8;
            }

            // Top spire
            addVoxel(0, y, 0, 0xFFD700, pagoda);
            for (let i = 1; i < 6; i++) {
                addVoxel(0, y + i * 0.8, 0, 0xFFA500, pagoda);
            }

            // Decorative lanterns on corners
            const lanternPositions = [[-5, 8, -5], [5, 8, 5], [-5, 8, 5], [5, 8, -5]];
            lanternPositions.forEach(([lx, ly, lz]) => {
                addVoxel(lx, ly, lz, 0x2F4F4F, pagoda);
                addVoxel(lx, ly + 1, lz, 0xFFF8DC, pagoda);
                addVoxel(lx, ly + 1.5, lz, 0xFFFFE0, pagoda);
            });

            return pagoda;
        }

        const pagoda = createPagoda();
        mainGroup.add(pagoda);

        // ===== CHERRY BLOSSOM TREES =====
        function createCherryBlossomTree(baseX, baseZ) {
            const tree = new THREE.Group();
            
            // Trunk
            for (let h = 0; h < 7; h++) {
                addVoxel(baseX, h, baseZ, 0x5C4033, tree);
            }
            
            // Main branches
            const branchY = 7;
            // Horizontal branches
            for (let i = -5; i <= 5; i++) {
                if (Math.abs(i) > 1) {
                    addVoxel(baseX + i, branchY, baseZ, 0x5C4033, tree);
                    addVoxel(baseX, branchY, baseZ + i, 0x5C4033, tree);
                }
            }
            
            // Upper branches
            for (let i = -3; i <= 3; i++) {
                addVoxel(baseX + i, branchY + 2, baseZ, 0x5C4033, tree);
            }

            // Cherry blossom foliage
            for (let dx = -6; dx <= 6; dx++) {
                for (let dy = 0; dy < 8; dy++) {
                    for (let dz = -6; dz <= 6; dz++) {
                        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
                        if (dist < 6.5 && dist > 1) {
                            let color = 0xFF69B4;
                            
                            // Color variation for petals
                            const r = Math.random();
                            if (r > 0.75) color = 0xFFB6C1;
                            else if (r > 0.6) color = 0xFF1493;
                            else if (r < 0.15) color = 0x98FB98;
                            
                            addVoxel(baseX + dx, branchY + dy, baseZ + dz, color, tree);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Extra floating petals
            for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
                const px = baseX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12;
                const py = branchY + Math.random() * 9;
                const pz = baseZ + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12;
                if (Math.random() > 0.6) {
                    addVoxel(px, py, pz, 0xFF69B4, tree);
                }
            }

            mainGroup.add(tree);
        }

        // Create several cherry blossom trees
        createCherryBlossomTree(-18, -20);
        createCherryBlossomTree(20, -18);
        createCherryBlossomTree(-16, 22);
        createCherryBlossomTree(18, 19);

        // ===== REGULAR TREES =====
        function createGreenTree(baseX, baseZ, height = 9) {
            const tree = new THREE.Group();
            
            // Trunk
            for (let h = 0; h < height; h++) {
                addVoxel(baseX, h, baseZ, 0x4A3728, tree);
            }
            
            // Foliage
            const foliageY = height - 2;
            for (let dx = -5; dx <= 5; dx++) {
                for (let dy = 0; dy < 6; dy++) {
                    for (let dz = -5; dz <= 5; dz++) {
                        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
                        if (dist < 5.8) {
                            let color = 0x228B22;
                            if (Math.random() > 0.7) color = 0x2E8B57;
                            if (Math.random() > 0.9) color = 0x32CD32;
                            
                            addVoxel(baseX + dx, foliageY + dy, baseZ + dz, color, tree);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            mainGroup.add(tree);
        }

        createGreenTree(-28, 8, 10);
        createGreenTree(26, -25, 8);
        createGreenTree(-25, 25, 9);
        createGreenTree(24, 24, 7);

        // ===== ADDITIONAL GARDEN DETAILS =====
        
        // Scattered flowers
        for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
            const fx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 70;
            const fz = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 70;
            // Avoid pagoda area
            if (Math.abs(fx) < 10 && Math.abs(fz) < 10) continue;
            
            const flowerColor = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 0xFF69B4 : 0xFFD700;
            addVoxel(fx, 1, fz, flowerColor);
        }

        // Small bamboo clusters
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const bx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 50;
            const bz = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 50;
            if (Math.abs(bx) < 12 && Math.abs(bz) < 12) continue;
            
            for (let b = 0; b < 5; b++) {
                addVoxel(bx + b*0.8, 1 + b*1.2, bz, 0x9ACD32);
            }
        }

        // Camera
        camera.position.set(35, 32, 45);
        camera.lookAt(0, 12, 0);

        // Mouse controls for rotation
        let isDragging = false;
        let previousMouseX = 0;
        let previousMouseY = 0;
        let rotY = 0.3;
        let rotX = 0.15;

        function updateRotation() {
            mainGroup.rotation.y = rotY;
            mainGroup.rotation.x = rotX;
        }

        renderer.domElement.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
            isDragging = true;
            previousMouseX = e.clientX;
            previousMouseY = e.clientY;
        });

        window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
            isDragging = false;
        });

        window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            if (!isDragging) return;
            
            const deltaX = e.clientX - previousMouseX;
            const deltaY = e.clientY - previousMouseY;
            
            rotY += deltaX * 0.004;
            rotX += deltaY * 0.004;
            rotX = Math.max(-Math.PI / 2, Math.min(Math.PI / 2, rotX));
            
            previousMouseX = e.clientX;
            previousMouseY = e.clientY;
            
            updateRotation();
        });

        // Auto gentle rotation when not interacting
        let autoRotate = true;
        setInterval(() => {
            if (!isDragging) {
                autoRotate = true;
            }
        }, 3000);

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            
            if (!isDragging && autoRotate) {
                rotY += 0.0008;
                updateRotation();
            }
            
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });

        // Initial rotation
        updateRotation();

        // Start animation
        animate();
        
        // Easter egg: Press 'L' to toggle auto rotation
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 'l') {
                autoRotate = !autoRotate;
            }
        });
    </script>

<!DOCTYPE html>

  body { margin:0; overflow:hidden; background:#87CEEB; }
