<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.152.2/build/three.module.js';
import {OrbitControls} from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.152.2/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';

// ---------- helper ----------
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, innerWidth/innerHeight, 0.1, 200);
camera.position.set(30, 25, 45);
camera.lookAt(0,5,0);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});
renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
renderer.setPixelRatio(devicePixelRatio);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);

// lights
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff,0.6));
const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffeedd,0.8);
dirLight.position.set(30,40,20);
scene.add(dirLight);

// ---------- collect voxels ----------
const positions = [];   // THREE.Vector3
const colorsHex = [];   // number

function add(x,y,z,col){
  positions.push(new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z));
  colorsHex.push(col);
}

// ---------- ground ----------
for(let x=-20; x<=20; x++){
  for(let z=-20; z<=20; z++){
    add(x,0,z,0x5CB85C);
  }
}

// ---------- pagoda ----------
const BROWN = 0x6B4226;
const RED   = 0xC62828;
const PINK  = 0xF8BBD0;
const WHITE = 0xFFFFFF;

const levels = 5;
for(let lvl=0; lvl<levels; lvl++){
  const size = 9 - lvl*2;            // 9,7,5,3,1
  const y0   = 1 + lvl*2;            // each level 2 blocks high
  const half = (size-1)/2;
  // solid block
  for(let dy=0; dy<2; dy++){
    for(let dx=-half; dx<=half; dx++){
      for(let dz=-half; dz<=half; dz++){
        add(dx, y0+dy, dz, BROWN);
      }
    }
  }
  // roof ring (one block higher) for all but top
  if(lvl < levels-1){
    const roofY = y0+2;
    const rim = half;
    for(let i=-rim; i<=rim; i++){
      add(i, roofY, -rim, RED);
      add(i, roofY,  rim, RED);
      add(-rim, roofY, i, RED);
      add( rim, roofY, i, RED);
    }
  }
}
// tip spire
for(let i=1;i<=3;i++){
  add(0, 11+i, 0, PINK);
}
// lanterns on roof edges
for(let a=0; a<4; a++){
  const angle = a * Math.PI/2;
  const lx = Math.round(4*Math.cos(angle));
  const lz = Math.round(4*Math.sin(angle));
  add(lx, 8, lz, 0xFFEB3B);
  add(lx, 9, lz, 0xFFEB3B);
}

// ---------- trees ----------
function addTree(cx,cz){
  const trunkCol = 0x5D4037;
  const leafCol  = 0x2E7D32;
  const blossom  = 0xE91E63;
  // trunk
  for(let y=1; y<=5; y++) add(cx, y, cz, trunkCol);
  // foliage
  for(let dy=5; dy<=7; dy++){
    for(let dx=-2; dx<=2; dx++){
      for(let dz=-2; dz<=2; dz++){
        if(Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dz) < 4){
          const col = (dy==7 && Math.abs(dx)<=1 && Math.abs(dz)<=1) ? blossom : leafCol;
          add(cx+dx, dy, cz+dz, col);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  // cherry blossom petals around
  for(let i=0;i<12;i++){
    const angle = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    const r = 3 + Math.random()*2;
    const px = Math.round(cx + r*Math.cos(angle));
    const pz = Math.round(cz + r*Math.sin(angle));
    add(px, 6 + (i%3), pz, blossom);
  }
}

addTree(6,6);
addTree(-7,5);
addTree(4,-7);
addTree(-5,-6);

// ---------- stone path ----------
for(let i=-5;i<=5;i++){
  add(i,0.5,0, 0x9E9E9E);
  add(0,0.5,i, 0x9E9E9E);
}

// ---------- build InstancedMesh ----------
const total = positions.length;
const geom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1);
const mat  = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true});
const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geom, mat, total);
mesh.castShadow = true;
mesh.receiveShadow = true;

const dummy = new THREE.Object3D();
const col = new THREE.Color();
const matrixArray = new Float32Array(total*16);
const colorArray  = new Float32Array(total*3);

for(let i=0;i<total;i++){
  dummy.position.copy(positions[i]);
  dummy.updateMatrix();
  dummy.matrix.toArray(matrixArray, i*16);
  col.setHex(colorsHex[i]);
  colorArray[i*3]   = col.r;
  colorArray[i*3+1] = col.g;
  colorArray[i*3+2] = col.b;
}
mesh.instanceMatrix.array = matrixArray;
mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
mesh.instanceColor = new THREE.InstancedBufferAttribute(colorArray,3);
scene.add(mesh);

// ---------- render loop ----------
function animate(){
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  renderer.render(scene,camera);
}
animate();

window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{
  camera.aspect = innerWidth/innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  renderer.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight);
});
</script>
</body>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #87CEEB; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        
        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        directionalLight.position.set(1, 1, 1);
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Helper function to create voxel geometry
        function createVoxelGeometry(size, color) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
            const material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color });
            return new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
        }

        // Create pagoda (5 tiers)
        function createPagoda(x, y, z) {
            const group = new THREE.Group();
            
            // Base platform (3x3)
            const base = createVoxelGeometry(3, 0x8B4513);
            base.position.set(x, y, z);
            group.add(base);
            
            // First tier (3x3 roof)
            const tier1Roof = createVoxelGeometry(3.2, 0x8B0000);
            tier1Roof.position.set(x, y + 1.5, z);
            group.add(tier1Roof);
            
            // Second tier (2x2 platform)
            const tier2Platform = createVoxelGeometry(2, 0xCD853F);
            tier2Platform.position.set(x, y + 2.5, z);
            group.add(tier2Platform);
            
            // Second tier roof
            const tier2Roof = createVoxelGeometry(2.2, 0x800000);
            tier2Roof.position.set(x, y + 4, z);
            group.add(tier2Roof);
            
            // Third tier (1x1 platform)
            const tier3Platform = createVoxelGeometry(1, 0xDEB887);
            tier3Platform.position.set(x, y + 5, z);
            group.add(tier3Platform);
            
            // Third tier roof
            const tier3Roof = createVoxelGeometry(1.2, 0x990000);
            tier3Roof.position.set(x, y + 6, z);
            group.add(tier3Roof);
            
            // Finial (golden top)
            const finial = createVoxelGeometry(0.5, 0xFFD700);
            finial.position.set(x, y + 7, z);
            group.add(finial);
            
            // Decorative elements (orange accents)
            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                const accent = createVoxelGeometry(0.3, 0xFFA500);
                accent.position.set(x - 1 + (i * 0.7), y + 6.5, z);
                group.add(accent);
            }
            
            return group;
        }

        // Create cherry blossom tree
        function createCherryTree(x, z) {
            const group = new THREE.Group();
            
            // Trunk (brown)
            for (let y = 0; y < 5; y++) {
                const trunk = createVoxelGeometry(0.8, 0x8B4513);
                trunk.position.set(x, y, z);
                group.add(trunk);
            }
            
            // Branches (darker brown)
            const branchPositions = [
                {x: -1, y: 3, z: 0}, {x: 1, y: 3, z: 0},
                {x: -1.5, y: 4, z: 0}, {x: 1.5, y: 4, z: 0},
                {x: 0, y: 5, z: -1}, {x: 0, y: 5, z: 1}
            ];
            
            branchPositions.forEach(pos => {
                const branch = createVoxelGeometry(0.6, 0x654321);
                branch.position.set(x + pos.x, pos.y, z + pos.z);
                group.add(branch);
            });
            
            // Blossoms (pink variations)
            const blossomColors = [0xFFB6C1, 0xFF69B4, 0xFFC0CB, 0xFF1493];
            
            for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
                const color = blossomColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * blossomColors.length)];
                const blossom = createVoxelGeometry(0.4, color);
                
                // Random position around branches
                const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const distance = 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5;
                const height = 3 + Math.random() * 3;
                
                blossom.position.set(
                    x + Math.cos(angle) * distance,
                    height,
                    z + Math.sin(angle) * distance
                );
                group.add(blossom);
            }
            
            return group;
        }

        // Create garden elements
        function createGarden() {
            const group = new THREE.Group();
            
            // Ground (green grass)
            for (let x = -15; x <= 15; x++) {
                for (let z = -15; z <= 15; z++) {
                    if (Math.random() > 0.7) continue; // Sparse grass
                    const grass = createVoxelGeometry(0.3, 0x228B22);
                    grass.position.set(x, 0.1, z);
                    group.add(grass);
                }
            }
            
            // Path (gray stones)
            const pathPattern = [
                {x: -10, z: -10}, {x: -8, z: -10}, {x: -6, z: -10},
                {x: -4, z: -8}, {x: -2, z: -6}, {x: 0, z: -4},
                {x: 2, z: -2}, {x: 4, z: 0}, {x: 6, z: 2},
                {x: 8, z: 4}, {x: 10, z: 6}
            ];
            
            pathPattern.forEach((pos, i) => {
                for (let y = 0; y < 0.5; y += 0.3) {
                    const stone = createVoxelGeometry(0.8, 0xA9A9A9);
                    stone.position.set(pos.x, y, pos.z);
                    group.add(stone);
                }
            });
            
            // Decorative lanterns (red)
            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                const lantern = createVoxelGeometry(0.5, 0xFF0000);
                lantern.position.set(-12 + (i * 6), 1, -12 + (i % 2 * 4));
                group.add(lantern);
            }
            
            // Small shrubs (green with red flowers)
            for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                const shrub = new THREE.Group();
                
                // Base
                const base = createVoxelGeometry(0.6, 0x2E8B57);
                base.position.set(-8 + (i * 3), 0.3, -8 + (Math.random() * 16));
                shrub.add(base);
                
                // Flowers (random red/pink)
                for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
                    const flower = createVoxelGeometry(0.3, 0xFF0000);
                    flower.position.set(0, 0.5 + (j * 0.3), 0);
                    shrub.add(flower);
                }
                
                shrub.position.x = -10 + (i * 4);
                shrub.position.z = -10 + (i % 2 * 10);
                group.add(shrub);
            }
            
            return group;
        }

        // Create all elements
        const pagoda = createPagoda(0, 0, 0);
        const cherryTrees = [
            createCherryTree(-8, -8),
            createCherryTree(8, -8),
            createCherryTree(-8, 8),
            createCherryTree(8, 8),
            createCherryTree(0, 10)
        ];
        const garden = createGarden();
        
        // Add to scene
        scene.add(pagoda);
        cherryTrees.forEach(tree => scene.add(tree));
        scene.add(garden);
        
        // Camera position
        camera.position.set(15, 15, 15);
        camera.lookAt(0, 3, 0);
        
        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            
            // Add subtle rotation to the scene
            pagoda.rotation.y += 0.001;
            cherryTrees.forEach(tree => {
                tree.rotation.y += 0.0005;
                tree.children.forEach(child => {
                    if (child.material.color.getHex() === 0xFFB6C1 || 
                        child.material.color.getHex() === 0xFF69B4 ||
                        child.material.color.getHex() === 0xFFC0CB ||
                        child.material.color.getHex() === 0xFF1493) {
                        // Make blossoms gently sway
                        child.position.y += Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.001 + child.position.x) * 0.001;
                    }
                });
            });
            
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        
        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
        
        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background-color: #e0f7fa; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <!-- 
        Voxel Art Scene: A whimsical pagoda nestled in a vibrant garden.
        Features:
        - Expansive green grass floor (voxel blocks).
        - Multi-tiered pagoda with lanterns.
        - Three stylized trees with leafy canopies and cherry blossoms.
        - A small ornamental pond and surrounding stones.
        - Colorful voxel blocks create a festive, detailed environment.
    -->
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/build/three.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xe0f7fa);

        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(0, 20, 30);
        camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
        directionalLight.position.set(10, 20, 10);
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        const pointLight1 = new THREE.PointLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        pointLight1.position.set(5, 10, 5);
        scene.add(pointLight1);

        const pointLight2 = new THREE.PointLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
        pointLight2.position.set(-10, 10, -10);
        scene.add(pointLight2);

        // Helper to add a voxel (1x1x1 colored cube)
        function addVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
            const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color });
            const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            voxel.position.set(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5);
            scene.add(voxel);
        }

        // Color definitions
        const grassColor = 0x7CFC00;      // Lime green floor
        const brown = 0x8B4513;           // Tree trunk / pagoda base
        const red = 0xFF0000;             // Mid pagoda tier
        const gold = 0xFFD700;            // Top tier & roof
        const orange = 0xFFA500;          // Lantern body
        const redLantern = 0xFF0000;      // Lantern top
        const foliageGreen = 0x32CD32;    // Tree leaves
        const cherryPink = 0xFFB6C1;      // Cherry blossoms
        const waterBlue = 0x1E90FF;       // Pond water
        const stoneGray = 0x808080;       // Decorative stones

        // ----- Ground (grass) -----
        for (let x = -10; x <= 10; x++) {
            for (let z = -10; z <= 10; z++) {
                addVoxel(x, -0.5, z, grassColor);
            }
        }

        // ----- Pagoda -----
        // Base (5x5, y=0)
        for (let x = -2; x <= 2; x++) {
            for (let z = -2; z <= 2; z++) {
                addVoxel(x, 0, z, brown);
            }
        }

        // Second tier (3x3, y=2)
        for (let x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
            for (let z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {
                addVoxel(x, 2, z, red);
            }
        }

        // Top tier (1x1, y=4)
        addVoxel(0, 4, 0, gold);

        // Simple stepped roof (y=5: 3x3, y=6: 1x1)
        for (let x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
            for (let z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {
                addVoxel(x, 5, z, gold);
            }
        }
        addVoxel(0, 6, 0, gold);

        // Lanterns at each corner of the base
        const lanternCorners = [[-2, -2], [-2, 2], [2, -2], [2, 2]];
        for (const [lx, lz] of lanternCorners) {
            addVoxel(lx, 0, lz, orange);       // body
            addVoxel(lx, 1, lz, redLantern);   // top
        }

        // ----- Trees -----
        function addTree(x, z) {
            // Trunk (2 blocks tall)
            for (let y = 0; y <= 1; y++) {
                addVoxel(x, y, z, brown);
            }

            // Foliage (two layers, radius ≈2)
            for (let dy = 0; dy <= 2; dy++) {
                const y = 2 + dy;
                for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
                    for (let dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) {
                        if (dx * dx + dz * dz <= 4) {
                            addVoxel(x + dx, y, z + dz, foliageGreen);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Cherry blossoms (a few pink cubes near top)
            for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
                const dx = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4) - 2;
                const dz = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4) - 2;
                if (dx * dx + dz * dz <= 8) {
                    const y = 3 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2);
                    addVoxel(x + dx, y, z + dz, cherryPink);
                }
            }
        }

        addTree(-7, -5);
        addTree(7, -5);
        addTree(0, 7);

        // ----- Pond & stones -----
        for (let x = 4; x <= 6; x++) {
            for (let z = 4; z <= 6; z++) {
                addVoxel(x, 0, z, waterBlue);
            }
        }

        // Some decorative stones near the pond
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            const sx = 7 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
            const sz = 7 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
            addVoxel(sx, 0, sz, stoneGray);
        }

        // ----- Animation -----
        let time = 0;
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            // Gentle rotation of the whole scene for a dynamic feel
            scene.rotation.y += 0.001;
            time += 0.01;
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
body { overflow: hidden; background: #87CEEB; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="importmap">
{
  "imports": {
    "three": "https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.1/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.1/examples/jsm/"
  }
}
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB);
scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x87CEEB, 45, 130);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(52, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 250);
camera.position.set(28, 16, 38);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.15;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.target.set(2, 7, 0);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.dampingFactor = 0.06;
controls.autoRotate = true;
controls.autoRotateSpeed = 0.35;
controls.minDistance = 12;
controls.maxDistance = 90;
controls.maxPolarAngle = Math.PI / 2 - 0.08;

const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xb8d4ff, 0x3d5c21, 0.55);
scene.add(hemi);
const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff4d6, 1.25);
sun.position.set(35, 55, 25);
sun.castShadow = true;
sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
sun.shadow.camera.near = 1;
sun.shadow.camera.far = 160;
sun.shadow.camera.left = -55;
sun.shadow.camera.right = 55;
sun.shadow.camera.top = 55;
sun.shadow.camera.bottom = -55;
sun.shadow.bias = -0.0008;
scene.add(sun);
const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x6699cc, 0.25);
fill.position.set(-30, 15, -20);
scene.add(fill);

const voxelData = [];
const occupied = new Set();

function addV(x, y, z, hex) {
  const key = `${x},${y},${z}`;
  if (occupied.has(key)) return;
  occupied.add(key);
  voxelData.push({ x, y, z, hex });
}

function randColor(arr) {
  return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];
}

// Pond
for (let x = 5; x <= 22; x++) {
  for (let z = -8; z <= 8; z++) {
    const dx = (x - 13.5) / 8;
    const dz = z / 7;
    const d = dx * dx + dz * dz;
    if (d < 1) {
      addV(x, 0, z, randColor([0x1E90FF, 0x00BFFF, 0x4169E1, 0x1E90FF]));
    } else if (d < 1.45) {
      addV(x, 0, z, randColor([0xE6C288, 0xD2B48C, 0xF4A460]));
    }
  }
}
// lily pads
[[12,0,0],[15,2],[10,-3],[17,-1],[14,4]].forEach(([lx,lz]) => {
  addV(lx, 1, lz, 0x228B22);
  addV(lx+1, 1, lz, 0x32CD32);
  if (Math.random() > 0.4) addV(lx, 2, lz, randColor([0xFF69B4, 0xFFB6C1, 0xFFFFFF]));
});

// Winding stone path
for (let z = -38; z <= -7; z++) {
  const px = Math.round(3.2 * Math.sin(z * 0.13));
  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
    addV(px + dx, 0, z, randColor([0x7B8B99, 0x8B9AAB, 0x6A7B8A, 0x778899]));
  }
}

// Plaza
for (let x = -9; x <= 9; x++) {
  for (let z = -9; z <= 9; z++) {
    addV(x, 0, z, randColor([0x6B7B8A, 0x708090, 0x5F6F7A, 0x778899]));
  }
}

// Pagoda foundation
for (let x = -7; x <= 7; x++) {
  for (let z = -7; z <= 7; z++) {
    addV(x, 1, z, randColor([0x2F4F4F, 0x3A5A5A, 0x2C3E3E]));
  }
}
// front steps
for (let x = -2; x <= 2; x++) {
  addV(x, 1, -8, 0x4A5A5A);
  addV(x, 0, -9, 0x5A6A6A);
}

const wallRed = [0xB22222, 0xC41E3A, 0xA52A2A];
const frame = 0x3E2723;
const glass = [0x87CEEB, 0xADD8E6, 0xB0E0E6];

// First story walls y=2..6, footprint ~ -5..5
for (let y = 2; y <= 6; y++) {
  for (let x = -5; x <= 5; x++) {
    if (!(y <= 5 && Math.abs(x) <= 1)) addV(x, y, -5, randColor(wallRed));
    addV(x, y, 5, (y >= 3 && y <= 5 && Math.abs(x) <= 1) ? randColor(glass) : randColor(wallRed));
  }
  for (let z = -4; z <= 4; z++) {
    const win = y >= 3 && y <= 5 && Math.abs(z) <= 1;
    addV(-5, y, z, win ? randColor(glass) : randColor(wallRed));
    addV(5, y, z, win ? randColor(glass) : randColor(wallRed));
  }
}
// door frame
for (let y = 2; y <= 5; y++) {
  addV(-2, y, -5, frame);
  addV(2, y, -5, frame);
}
for (let x = -1; x <= 1; x++) addV(x, 5, -5, frame);
// corner pillars extra height/color
[[-5,-5],[5,-5],[-5,5],[5,5]].forEach(([px,pz]) => {
  for (let y = 1; y <= 7; y++) addV(px, y, pz, 0x4A3728);
});

// Roof 1
const roofDark = [0x8B0000, 0x9B111E, 0x800000];
const gold = [0xFFD700, 0xFFC125, 0xDAA520];
for (let layer = 0; layer < 4; layer++) {
  const size = 9 - layer;
  const yy = 7 + layer;
  for (let x = -size; x <= size; x++) {
    for (let z = -size; z <= size; z++) {
      const edge = Math.abs(x) === size || Math.abs(z) === size;
      addV(x, yy, z, edge ? randColor(gold) : randColor(roofDark));
    }
  }
  // upturned corners
  [[size,size],[size,-size],[-size,size],[-size,-size]].forEach(([cx,cz]) => {
    addV(cx + Math.sign(cx), yy + 1, cz, randColor(gold));
    addV(cx, yy + 1, cz + Math.sign(cz), randColor(gold));
    addV(cx + Math.sign(cx), yy + 1, cz + Math.sign(cz), 0xFFD700);
  });
}

// Second story
for (let y = 11; y <= 15; y++) {
  for (let x = -3; x <= 3; x++) {
    const win = y >= 12 && y <= 14 && Math.abs(x) <= 1;
    addV(x, y, -3, win ? randColor(glass) : randColor(wallRed));
    addV(x, y, 3, win ? randColor(glass) : randColor(wallRed));
  }
  for (let z = -2; z <= 2; z++) {
    const win = y >= 12 && y <= 14 && Math.abs(z) <= 1;
    addV(-3, y, z, win ? randColor(glass) : randColor(wallRed));
    addV(3, y, z, win ? randColor(glass) : randColor(wallRed));
  }
}
[[-3,-3],[3,-3],[-3,3],[3,3]].forEach(([px,pz]) => {
  for (let y = 11; y <= 16; y++) addV(px, y, pz, 0x4A3728);
});

// Roof 2
for (let layer = 0; layer < 3; layer++) {
  const size = 6 - layer;
  const yy = 16 + layer;
  for (let x = -size; x <= size; x++) {
    for (let z = -size; z <= size; z++) {
      const edge = Math.abs(x) === size || Math.abs(z) === size;
      addV(x, yy, z, edge ? randColor(gold) : randColor(roofDark));
    }
  }
  [[size,size],[size,-size],[-size,size],[-size,-size]].forEach(([cx,cz]) => {
    addV(cx + Math.sign(cx||1), yy + 1, cz, randColor(gold));
    addV(cx, yy + 1, cz + Math.sign(cz||1), randColor(gold));
  });
}

// Third story
for (let y = 19; y <= 22; y++) {
  for (let x = -2; x <= 2; x++) {
    addV(x, y, -2, randColor(wallRed));
    addV(x, y, 2, randColor(wallRed));
  }
  for (let z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {
    addV(-2, y, z, (y>=20&&y<=21) ? randColor(glass) : randColor(wallRed));
    addV(2, y, z, (y>=20&&y<=21) ? randColor(glass) : randColor(wallRed));
  }
}

// Roof 3 + finial
for (let layer = 0; layer < 3; layer++) {
  const size = 4 - layer;
  const yy = 23 + layer;
  for (let x = -size; x <= size; x++) {
    for (let z = -size; z <= size; z++) {
      const edge = Math.abs(x) === size || Math.abs(z) === size;
      addV(x, yy, z, edge ? randColor(gold) : randColor(roofDark));
    }
  }
}
for (let y = 26; y <= 31; y++) addV(0, y, 0, y > 29 ? 0xFFD700 : 0x8B0000);
addV(0, 32, 0, 0xFFD700);
addV(1, 31, 0, 0xDAA520);
addV(-1, 31, 0, 0xDAA520);
addV(0, 31, 1, 0xDAA520);
addV(0, 31, -1, 0xDAA520);

// Cherry trees
const blossomCols = [0xFFB6C1, 0xFF69B4, 0xFFC0CB, 0xFFF0F5, 0xFF1493, 0xFFB7C5, 0xFFFFFF];
function addCherry(cx, cz) {
  const h = 6 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
  for (let y = 1; y <= h; y++) {
    addV(cx, y, cz, 0x6B3E26);
    if (y < 4) {
      addV(cx + 1, y, cz, 0x5D4037);
      addV(cx, y, cz + (y%2?1:-1), 0x4E342E);
    }
  }
  addV(cx + 2, h - 1, cz, 0x5D4037);
  addV(cx - 2, h - 2, cz + 1, 0x5D4037);
  addV(cx + 1, h - 2, cz - 2, 0x6B3E26);
  for (let i = 0; i < 95; i++) {
    const dx = Math.floor(Math.random() * 11) - 5;
    const dy = Math.floor(Math.random() * 8);
    const dz = Math.floor(Math.random() * 11) - 5;
    if (dx*dx + dz*dz + (dy-3)*(dy-3)*0.7 < 22) {
      addV(cx + dx, h + dy - 2, cz + dz, randColor(blossomCols));
    }
  }
}
[[-20,-12],[-18,17],[20,16],[6,-20],[-22,5],[24,-7],[-7,24],[16,-18],[-14,-22]].forEach(([x,z]) => addCherry(x,z));

// Pines
function addPine(cx, cz) {
  const h = 9 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
  for (let y = 1; y <= h; y++) addV(cx, y, cz, 0x4E342E);
  for (let l = 0; l < 7; l++) {
    const rad = 4.2 - l * 0.55;
    const yy = h - l;
    for (let dx = -4; dx <= 4; dx++) {
      for (let dz = -4; dz <= 4; dz++) {
        if (dx*dx + dz*dz <= rad*rad + Math.random()*1.5) {
          addV(cx+dx, yy, cz+dz, randColor([0x1B5E20, 0x2E7D32, 0x228B22, 0x006400]));
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
addPine(26, 20); addPine(-28, -16); addPine(28, 4); addPine(-26, 22);

// Bamboo grove
for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
  const bx = -12 + Math.floor(Math.random()*6);
  const bz = 18 + Math.floor(Math.random()*7);
  const bh = 5 + Math.floor(Math.random()*7);
  for (let y = 1; y <= bh; y++) {
    addV(bx, y, bz, y % 3 === 0 ? 0x1B5E20 : 0x66BB6A);
  }
}

// Rocks
function addRock(cx, cz, n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const dx = Math.floor(Math.random()*5)-2;
    const dy = Math.floor(Math.random()*3);
    const dz = Math.floor(Math.random()*5)-2;
    addV(cx+dx, 1+dy, cz+dz, randColor([0x707070, 0x8A8A8A, 0x5A5A5A, 0x9E9E9E]));
  }
}
addRock(8, -9, 10); addRock(21, 7, 14); addRock(-3, 13, 7); addRock(19, -6, 8); addRock(-8, -16, 6);

// Lanterns
function addLantern(lx, lz) {
  for (let x = lx-1; x <= lx+1; x++) for (let z = lz-1; z <= lz+1; z++) addV(x, 1, z, 0x607080);
  for (let y = 2; y <= 4; y++) addV(lx, y, lz, 0x546070);
  addV(lx, 5, lz, 0xFFF59D);
  for (let x = lx-1; x <= lx+1; x++) for (let z = lz-1; z <= lz+1; z++) addV(x, 6, z, 0x37474F);
  addV(lx, 7, lz, 0xFFD700);
}
addLantern(-5, -13);
addLantern(9, 11);
addLantern(4, -8);

const glow1 = new THREE.PointLight(0xffee88, 1.4, 12);
glow1.position.set(-5, 6.5, -13);
scene.add(glow1);
const glow2 = new THREE.PointLight(0xffee88, 1.2, 11);
glow2.position.set(9, 6.5, 11);
scene.add(glow2);

// Flowers and tufts
const flowerCols = [0xFF1744, 0xFFEA00, 0xD500F9, 0xFF9100, 0x00E676, 0xFFFFFF, 0xFF4081, 0x651FFF];
for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
  const fx = Math.floor(Math.random()*70)-35;
  const fz = Math.floor(Math.random()*70)-35;
  if (Math.abs(fx) < 11 && Math.abs(fz) < 11) continue;
  addV(fx, 1, fz, randColor(flowerCols));
  if (Math.random() > 0.55) addV(fx, 2, fz, randColor(flowerCols));
}

// Bushes
for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
  const bx = Math.floor(Math.random()*60)-30;
  const bz = Math.floor(Math.random()*60)-30;
  if (Math.abs(bx)<12 && Math.abs(bz)<12) continue;
  for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
    addV(bx + (k%3)-1, 1 + (k>4?1:0), bz + ((k*2)%3)-1, randColor([0x2E7D32, 0x388E3C, 0x1B5E20]));
  }
}

// Grass fill
const grassCols = [0x33691E, 0x558B2F, 0x2E7D32, 0x4CAF50, 0x3E6B1E, 0x689F38];
for (let x = -42; x <= 42; x++) {
  for (let z = -42; z <= 42; z++) {
    if (!occupied.has(`${x},0,${z}`)) {
      addV(x, 0, z, randColor(grassCols));
    }
  }
}
// tall grass specks
for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
  const gx = Math.floor(Math.random()*80)-40;
  const gz = Math.floor(Math.random()*80)-40;
  addV(gx, 1, gz, randColor([0x33691E, 0x2E7D32, 0x1B5E20]));
}

const count = voxelData.length;
const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ roughness: 0.82, metalness: 0.08 });
const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, mat, count);
mesh.castShadow = true;
mesh.receiveShadow = true;

const colors = new Float32Array(count * 3);
const dummy = new THREE.Object3D();
const c = new THREE.Color();
voxelData.forEach((v, i) => {
  dummy.position.set(v.x, v.y + 0.5, v.z);
  dummy.updateMatrix();
  mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);
  c.setHex(v.hex);
  colors[i*3] = c.r;
  colors[i*3+1] = c.g;
  colors[i*3+2] = c.b;
});
mesh.instanceColor = new THREE.InstancedBufferAttribute(colors, 3);
mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
scene.add(mesh);

window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
  camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
});

function animate() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  controls.update();
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
animate();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
        body { overflow: hidden; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simplex-noise@3.0.1/dist/simplex-noise.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        // ==================== VOXEL MANAGEMENT ====================
        const voxelManager = {};
        const sharedBoxGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
        const simplex = new SimplexNoise(42); // Fixed seed for consistent scene

        // Material properties for different voxel colors
        const materialProps = {
            0xffd700: { metalness: 0.8, roughness: 0.2 }, // Gold (pagoda roofs)
            0xffff00: { emissive: 0xffff00, emissiveIntensity: 2.5 }, // Lantern light
            0x00bfff: { metalness: 0.3, roughness: 0.3, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85 }, // Pond water
            default: { metalness: 0.1, roughness: 0.85 }
        };

        // Add voxel to manager (baseY = bottom of voxel, scale = size)
        function addVoxel(x, baseY, z, color, scale = 1) {
            if (!voxelManager[color]) voxelManager[color] = [];
            const matrix = new THREE.Matrix4();
            matrix.makeTranslation(x, baseY + scale/2, z);
            matrix.scale(new THREE.Vector3(scale, scale, scale));
            voxelManager[color].push(matrix);
        }

        // ==================== SCENE SETUP ====================
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB); // Sky blue
        scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x87CEEB, 30, 60);

        // Camera
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(18, 12, 16);
        camera.lookAt(0, 3, -6);

        // Renderer
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Controls
        const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;
        controls.minDistance = 6;
        controls.maxDistance = 55;

        // Lighting
        const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);

        sun.position.set(12, 25, 8);

        sun.shadow.mapSize.width = 2048;

        const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x87CEEB, 0x7CFC00, 0.3);
        scene.add(hemi);

        // ==================== TERRAIN GENERATION ====================
        const TERRAIN_SIZE = 50;
        const HALF_TERRAIN = TERRAIN_SIZE / 2;

        for (let x = -HALF_TERRAIN; x < HALF_TERRAIN; x++) {
            for (let z = -HALF_TERRAIN; z < HALF_TERRAIN; z++) {
                const isPath = x >= -2 && x <= 2 && z >= -10 && z <= 22;
                const isPond = x >= 5 && x <= 15 && z >= 5 && z <= 15;

                if (isPond) {
                    // Pond bottom and water
                    addVoxel(x, -1, z, 0x808080, 1);
                    addVoxel(x, 0, z, 0x00BFFF, 1);
                    // Lily pads
                    if (Math.random() < 0.12) {
                        addVoxel(x, 1, z, 0x228B22, 0.7);
                    }
                } else if (isPath) {
                    // Stone path with variation
                    const pathColor = Math.random() < 0.65 ? 0xD3D3D3 : 0xA9A9A9;
                    addVoxel(x, 0, z, pathColor, 1);
                } else {
                    // Grass with subtle height variation
                    const noise = simplex.noise2D(x * 0.12, z * 0.12);
                    const height = noise > 0.35 ? 0.5 : 0;
                    addVoxel(x, height, z, 0x7CFC00, 1);
                }
            }
        }

        // ==================== PAGODA GENERATION ====================
        function generatePagoda(centerX, centerZ) {
            // Base platform (11x11)
            for (let x = -5; x <= 5; x++) {
                for (let z = -10; z <= 0; z++) {
                    addVoxel(centerX + x, 0, centerZ + z, 0x808080, 1);

            // Pagoda tiers (5 total)
            const tiers = [
                { wallX: [-4,4], wallZ: [-9,-1], wallY: [1,4], pillarSpace: 2, roofBaseY:4, roofHeight:3, hasDoor:true },
                { wallX: [-3,3], wallZ: [-8,-2], wallY: [6,8], pillarSpace:3, roofBaseY:8, roofHeight:2, hasDoor:false },
                { wallX: [-2,2], wallZ: [-7,-3], wallY: [10,11], pillarSpace:2, roofBaseY:11, roofHeight:2, hasDoor:false },
                { wallX: [-1,1], wallZ: [-6,-4], wallY: [12,13], pillarSpace:2, roofBaseY:13, roofHeight:2, hasDoor:false },
                { wallX: [0,0], wallZ: [-5,-5], wallY: [14,15], pillarSpace:0, roofBaseY:15, roofHeight:2, hasDoor:false }
            ];

            tiers.forEach((tier, idx) => {
                const [wxMin, wxMax] = tier.wallX;
                const [wzMin, wzMax] = tier.wallZ;
                const [wyMin, wyMax] = tier.wallY;

                // Walls
                for (let x = wxMin; x <= wxMax; x++) {
                    for (let z = wzMin; z <= wzMax; z++) {
                        for (let y = wyMin; y < wyMax; y++) {
                            let skip = false;
                            // Windows
                            if (idx === 0) {
                                if ((x === -3 || x === 3) && z >= -8 && z <= -4 && y >= 2) skip = true;
                                if (z === -9 && ((x >= -3 && x <= -2) || (x >= 2 && x <= 3)) && y >= 2) skip = true;
                            } else if (idx < 4) {
                                if ((x === wxMin || x === wxMax) && z > wzMin && z < wzMax && y > wyMin) skip = true;
                            }
                            // Door
                            if (tier.hasDoor && z === wzMax && x >= -1 && x <= 1 && y < 3) skip = true;

                            if (!skip) addVoxel(centerX + x, y, centerZ + z, 0xFFFFFF, 1);
                            else addVoxel(centerX + x, y, centerZ + z, 0x2F2F2F, 1);

                    }
                }

                // Pillars
                if (tier.pillarSpace > 0) {
                    const pillarXs = [];
                    for (let x = wxMin; x <= wxMax; x += tier.pillarSpace) pillarXs.push(x);
                    pillarXs.forEach(px => {
                        [wzMin, wzMax].forEach(pz => {
                            for (let y = wyMin; y < wyMax; y++) {

                // Roof with upturned corners
                const rXMin = wxMin - 1, rXMax = wxMax + 1;

                for (let h = 0; h < tier.roofHeight; h++) {
                    const y = tier.roofBaseY + h;
                    const shrink = h;
                    const rxMin = rXMin + shrink, rxMax = rXMax - shrink;
                    const rzMin = rZMin + shrink, rzMax = rZMax - shrink;
                    if (rxMin > rxMax || rzMin > rzMax) break;

                    // Main roof
                    for (let x = rxMin; x <= rxMax; x++) {
                        for (let z = rzMin; z <= rzMax; z++) {
                            addVoxel(centerX + x, y, centerZ + z, 0xFFD700, 1);
                        }
                    }

                    // Upturned corners
                    [[rxMin, rzMin], [rxMax, rzMin], [rxMin, rzMax], [rxMax, rzMax]].forEach(([cx, cz]) => {
                        addVoxel(centerX + cx, y + 1, centerZ + cz, 0xFFD700, 1);
                    });
                }
            });

            // Tapering spire
            const spireStart = 18;
            for (let y = spireStart; y <= 23; y++) {
                const scale = 1 - (y - spireStart) * 0.18;
                if (scale <= 0) break;
                addVoxel(centerX, y, centerZ - 5, 0xFFD700, scale);
            }
        }
        generatePagoda(0, -10);

        // ==================== TREE GENERATION ====================
        function generateTree(x, z, type) {
            const trunkColor = 0x8B4513;
            let trunkH, foliageColors, shape;

            switch(type) {
                case 'cherry': trunkH = 3 + Math.floor(Math.random()*3); foliageColors = [0xFFB6C1, 0xFF69B4, 0xFFFFFF]; shape = 'rounded'; break;
                case 'evergreen': trunkH = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random()*2); foliageColors = [0x006400]; shape = 'conical'; break;
                case 'maple': trunkH = 3 + Math.floor(Math.random()*2); foliageColors = [0xFF4500, 0xFF8C00]; shape = 'rounded'; break;
                default: return;
            }

            // Trunk
            for (let y = 0; y < trunkH; y++) {
                addVoxel(x, y, z, trunkColor, 1);
            }

            // Foliage
            const foliageStart = trunkH - 1;
            if (shape === 'rounded') {
                const radius = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random()*2);
                for (let dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
                    for (let dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
                        for (let dy = 0; dy <= radius; dy++) {
                            const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz + dy*dy);
                            if (dist <= radius && Math.random() < 0.72) {
                                const color = foliageColors[Math.floor(Math.random()*foliageColors.length)];
                                addVoxel(x+dx, foliageStart+dy, z+dz, color, 0.9 + Math.random()*0.2);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else if (shape === 'conical') {
                const height = 3 + Math.floor(Math.random()*2);
                const baseR = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random()*2);
                for (let dy = 0; dy < height; dy++) {
                    const y = foliageStart + dy;
                    const r = baseR * (1 - dy/height);
                    const intR = Math.ceil(r);
                    for (let dx = -intR; dx <= intR; dx++) {
                        for (let dz = -intR; dz <= intR; dz++) {
                            if (Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz) <= r && Math.random() < 0.8) {
                                addVoxel(x+dx, y, z+dz, foliageColors[0], 0.9 + Math.random()*0.2);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Place trees (avoid path, pond, pagoda)
        for (let i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
            let x, z, valid = false, attempts = 0;
            while (!valid && attempts < 100) {
                x = Math.floor(Math.random()*50) - 25;
                z = Math.floor(Math.random()*50) - 25;
                const onPath = x >=-2 && x <=2 && z >=-10 && z <=22;
                const inPond = x >=5 && x <=15 && z >=5 && z <=15;
                const nearPagoda = Math.sqrt(x*x + (z+10)*(z+10)) < 6;
                valid = !onPath && !inPond && !nearPagoda;
                attempts++;
            }
            if (valid) {
                const type = Math.random() < 0.45 ? 'cherry' : (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'evergreen' : 'maple');
                generateTree(x, z, type);
            }
        }

        // ==================== GARDEN DETAILS ====================
        // Lanterns
        function generateLantern(x, z) {
            addVoxel(x, 0, z, 0x808080, 1); // Base
            for (let y = 1; y < 3; y++) addVoxel(x, y, z, 0x8B4513, 0.5); // Post
            addVoxel(x, 3, z, 0xFF0000, 0.8); // Lantern box
            addVoxel(x, 3.25, z, 0xFFFF00, 0.5); // Light
        }
        [18,13,8,3,-2,-7,-12].forEach(z => {
            generateLantern(3, z);

        // Arched bridge over pond
        function generateBridge(xStart, xEnd, zStart, zEnd) {
            const centerX = (xStart + xEnd)/2, centerZ = (zStart + zEnd)/2;
            const xSpan = xEnd - xStart + 1, zSpan = zEnd - zStart + 1;
            for (let x = xStart; x <= xEnd; x++) {
                for (let z = zStart; z <= zEnd; z++) {
                    const dx = (x - centerX)/(xSpan/2), dz = (z - centerZ)/(zSpan/2);

                    }
                    const fracH = height - intH;
                    if (fracH > 0.1) addVoxel(x, intH, z, 0x8B4513, fracH);
                }
            }
        }
        generateBridge(4,6,7,13);

        // Flowers
        const flowerColors = [0xFF0000, 0xFFFF00, 0x800080, 0xFF1493, 0x00FF00];
        for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
            let x, z, valid = false, attempts = 0;
            while (!valid && attempts < 50) {
                x = Math.random()*50 -25;
                z = Math.random()*50 -25;
                valid = !(x >=-2 && x <=2 && z >=-10 && z <=22) && !(x >=5 && x <=15 && z >=5 && z <=15);
                attempts++;
            }
            if (valid) {
                const color = flowerColors[Math.floor(Math.random()*flowerColors.length)];
                addVoxel(x, 0, z, color, 0.3);
            }
        }

        // Rocks
        const rockColors = [0x696969, 0x8B7355, 0xA0522D];
        for (let i = 0; i < 45; i++) {
            let x, z, valid = false, attempts = 0;
            while (!valid && attempts < 50) {
                x = Math.random()*50 -25;
                z = Math.random()*50 -25;
                valid = !(x >=-2 && x <=2 && z >=-10 && z <=22) && !(x >=5 && x <=15 && z >=5 && z <=15);
                attempts++;
            }
            if (valid) {
                const color = rockColors[Math.floor(Math.random()*rockColors.length)];
                const scale = 0.5 + Math.random()*1.5;
                addVoxel(x, 0, z, color, scale);
            }
        }

        // ==================== CHERRY BLOSSOM PETALS ====================
        const PETAL_COUNT = 6000;
        const petalGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
        const petalPos = new Float32Array(PETAL_COUNT * 3);
        const petalCol = new Float32Array(PETAL_COUNT * 3);
        const petalPhases = new Float32Array(PETAL_COUNT * 2);

        const pink = new THREE.Color(0xFFB6C1);
        const lightPink = new THREE.Color(0xFFE4E1);
        const white = new THREE.Color(0xFFFFFF);

        for (let i = 0; i < PETAL_COUNT; i++) {
            petalPos[i*3] = Math.random()*50 -25;
            petalPos[i*3+1] = Math.random()*18 +5;
            petalPos[i*3+2] = Math.random()*50 -25;

            const col = [pink, lightPink, white][Math.floor(Math.random()*3)];
            petalCol[i*3] = col.r;
            petalCol[i*3+1] = col.g;
            petalCol[i*3+2] = col.b;

            petalPhases[i*2] = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
            petalPhases[i*2+1] = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
        }

        petalGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(petalPos, 3));
        petalGeo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(petalCol, 3));

        const petalMat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
            size: 0.35,
            vertexColors: true,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.85,
            sizeAttenuation: true
        });

        const petals = new THREE.Points(petalGeo, petalMat);
        scene.add(petals);

        function animatePetals(time) {
            const pos = petals.geometry.attributes.position.array;
            for (let i = 0; i < PETAL_COUNT; i++) {
                // Fall
                pos[i*3+1] -= 0.022;
                // Reset if below ground
                if (pos[i*3+1] < 0) {
                    pos[i*3+1] = 22;
                    pos[i*3] = Math.random()*50 -25;
                    pos[i*3+2] = Math.random()*50 -25;
                }
                // Sway
                const px = petalPhases[i*2];
                const pz = petalPhases[i*2+1];
                pos[i*3] += 0.012 * Math.sin(time*0.001 + px);
                pos[i*3+2] += 0.012 * Math.cos(time*0.001 + pz);
            }
            petals.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
        }

        // ==================== BUILD INSTANCED MESHES ====================
        Object.keys(voxelManager).forEach(colorKey => {
            const color = parseInt(colorKey);
            const matrices = voxelManager[color];
            const count = matrices.length;

            // Get material properties
            const props = materialProps[color] || materialProps.default;
            const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, ...props });

            // Create instanced mesh
            const instanced = new THREE.InstancedMesh(sharedBoxGeometry, material, count);
            matrices.forEach((mat, idx) => instanced.setMatrixAt(idx, mat));
            instanced.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;

            // Shadows

            instanced.receiveShadow = true;

            scene.add(instanced);

        // ==================== ANIMATION LOOP ====================
        function animate(time) {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            animatePetals(time);
            controls.update();
            renderer.render(scene, camera);

        // ==================== RESIZE HANDLER ====================
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });

        animate();

    <script type="module">
        import * as THREE from 'three';

        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87ceeb);
        scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x87ceeb, 0.004);

        sunLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 2048;

        sunLight.shadow.camera.right = 70;
        sunLight.shadow.camera.top = 70;
        sunLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -70;
        sunLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
        sunLight.shadow.camera.far = 250;
        sunLight.shadow.bias = -0.0005;
        scene.add(sunLight);

        // Voxel storage
        const opaqueVoxels = {};
        const transparentVoxels = {};

        function addVoxel(i, j, k, color, transparent = false) {
            const target = transparent ? transparentVoxels : opaqueVoxels;
            const colorKey = color.toString(16).padStart(6, '0');
            if (!target[colorKey]) target[colorKey] = [];
            target[colorKey].push([i + 0.5, j + 0.5, k + 0.5]);
        }

        // Build voxel meshes
        function buildVoxelMeshes(voxelMap, transparent = false) {
            const group = new THREE.Group();
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
            const dummy = new THREE.Object3D();

            for (const colorKey in voxelMap) {
                const positions = voxelMap[colorKey];
                const count = positions.length;
                if (count === 0) continue;

                const color = parseInt(colorKey, 16);
                const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                    color: color,
                    transparent: transparent,
                    opacity: transparent ? 0.6 : 1,
                    roughness: 0.75,
                    metalness: 0.05,
                });

                // Special material for water
                if (transparent && color === 0x4da6ff) {
                    material.opacity = 0.55;
                    material.roughness = 0.2;
                    material.metalness = 0.1;
                }

                const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geometry, material, count);
                mesh.castShadow = !transparent;
                mesh.receiveShadow = true;

                for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                    const [x, y, z] = positions[i];
                    dummy.position.set(x, y, z);
                    dummy.updateMatrix();
                    mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);
                }
                mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
                group.add(mesh);
            }
            return group;
        }

        // -------------------- GROUND GENERATION --------------------
        const GROUND_SIZE = 100;
        const HALF_GROUND = GROUND_SIZE / 2;

        // Ground types: 0=grass, 1=path, 2=pond
        const groundGrid = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < GROUND_SIZE; i++) {
            groundGrid[i] = [];
            for (let k = 0; k < GROUND_SIZE; k++) {
                groundGrid[i][k] = 0; // grass
            }
        }

        // Carve irregular pond
        const pondCenterI = 15;
        const pondCenterK = 8;
        for (let i = 0; i < GROUND_SIZE; i++) {
            for (let k = 0; k < GROUND_SIZE; k++) {
                const di = (i - HALF_GROUND) - pondCenterI;
                const dk = (k - HALF_GROUND) - pondCenterK;
                const dist = Math.sqrt(di * di + dk * dk);
                const radius = 9 + 2.5 * Math.sin(di * 0.15) + 2 * Math.cos(dk * 0.2) + 1.2 * Math.sin(di * 0.3 + dk * 0.2);
                if (dist < radius) {
                    groundGrid[i][k] = 2; // pond
                }
            }
        }

        // Create winding path using bezier curves
        function createPath() {
            const start = new THREE.Vector2(-45, -45);
            const control1 = new THREE.Vector2(-20, -30);
            const control2 = new THREE.Vector2(10, -15);
            const midEnd = new THREE.Vector2(14, 0); // South bridge end
            const midStart = new THREE.Vector2(14, 6); // North bridge end
            const control3 = new THREE.Vector2(5, 10);
            const end = new THREE.Vector2(0, -8); // Pagoda front

            const curve1 = new THREE.CubicBezierCurve(start, control1, control2, midEnd);
            const curve2 = new THREE.CubicBezierCurve(midStart, control3, new THREE.Vector2(-5, -5), end);

            const pathWidth = 3;
            const halfWidth = Math.floor(pathWidth / 2);

            function markCurve(curve, steps = 200) {
                const points = curve.getPoints(steps);
                for (const point of points) {
                    const i = Math.round(point.x);
                    const k = Math.round(point.y);
                    for (let di = -halfWidth; di <= halfWidth; di++) {
                        for (let dk = -halfWidth; dk <= halfWidth; dk++) {
                            const gi = Math.floor(i + di + HALF_GROUND);
                            const gk = Math.floor(k + dk + HALF_GROUND);
                            if (gi >= 0 && gi < GROUND_SIZE && gk >=0 && gk < GROUND_SIZE) {
                                if (groundGrid[gi][gk] !== 2) {
                                    groundGrid[gi][gk] = 1; // path
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            markCurve(curve1);
            markCurve(curve2);
        }
        createPath();

        // Add ground voxels
        const grassColors = [0x4caf50, 0x43a047, 0x66bb6a, 0x388e3c];
        const pathColors = [0xbdbdbd, 0x9e9e9e, 0xe0e0e0];
        const waterColor = 0x4da6ff;
        const sandColor = 0xf5deb3;

        for (let i = 0; i < GROUND_SIZE; i++) {
            for (let k = 0; k < GROUND_SIZE; k++) {
                const worldI = i - HALF_GROUND;
                const worldK = k - HALF_GROUND;
                const type = groundGrid[i][k];

                if (type === 2) {
                    addVoxel(worldI, -1, worldK, sandColor);
                    addVoxel(worldI, 0, worldK, waterColor, true);
                } else if (type === 1) {
                    const color = pathColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * pathColors.length)];
                    addVoxel(worldI, 0, worldK, color);
                } else {
                    const color = grassColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * grassColors.length)];
                    addVoxel(worldI, 0, worldK, color);
                }
            }
        }

        // -------------------- STONE BRIDGE --------------------
        function buildBridge(centerI, centerK, length, width, archHeight) {
            const halfLength = Math.floor(length / 2);
            const halfWidth = Math.floor(width / 2);

            for (let dk = -halfLength; dk <= halfLength; dk++) {
                const height = Math.round(archHeight * (1 - (dk * dk) / (halfLength * halfLength)));
                const k = centerK + dk;

                for (let di = -halfWidth; di <= halfWidth; di++) {
                    const i = centerI + di;
                    addVoxel(i, height, k, 0xbdbdbd);
                    // Railings
                    if (di === -halfWidth || di === halfWidth) {
                        addVoxel(i, height + 1, k, 0x8d6e63);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        buildBridge(14, 3, 7, 5, 2);

        // -------------------- PAGODA --------------------
        function buildPagoda(centerI, centerK, tiers = 5, baseWidth = 15) {
            const baseHalf = Math.floor(baseWidth / 2);

            // Base platforms
            for (let i = -baseHalf; i <= baseHalf; i++) {
                for (let k = -baseHalf; k <= baseHalf; k++) {
                    addVoxel(centerI + i, 1, centerK + k, 0x9e9e9e);
                }
            }
            for (let i = -(baseHalf -1); i <= baseHalf -1; i++) {
                for (let k = -(baseHalf -1); k <= baseHalf -1; k++) {
                    addVoxel(centerI + i, 2, centerK + k, 0x8d8d8d);
                }
            }

            let currentWallWidth = baseWidth - 2;
            let currentFloorJ = 2;
            const wallHeight = 3;
            const roofLayers = 4;
            const roofOverhang = 2;
            const pillarColor = 0xc62828;
            const wallColor = 0xfafafa;
            const roofColor = 0x37474f;
            const goldColor = 0xffd700;

            const pointLights = [];

            for (let t = 0; t < tiers; t++) {
                const hw = Math.floor(currentWallWidth / 2);

                // Build pillars (3 per side: corners + middle)
                const pillarPositions = new Set();
                // Front/back
                for (let i = -hw; i <= hw; i += hw) {
                    pillarPositions.add(`${i},${-hw}`);
                    pillarPositions.add(`${i},${hw}`);
                }
                // Left/right middles
                pillarPositions.add(`${-hw},0`);
                pillarPositions.add(`${hw},0`);

                for (const pos of pillarPositions) {
                    const [pi, pk] = pos.split(',').map(Number);
                    for (let j = 0; j < wallHeight; j++) {
                        addVoxel(centerI + pi, currentFloorJ + j, centerK + pk, pillarColor);
                    }
                }

                // Build walls with windows
                function buildWall(axis, pos, hw, floorJ, wallColor) {
                    const isXAxis = axis === 'x';
                    const start = -hw + 1;
                    const end = hw - 1;
                    
                    for (let a = start; a <= end; a++) {
                        if (a === 0) continue; // skip middle pillar
                        for (let j = 0; j < wallHeight; j++) {
                            const inLeftPanel = a < 0;
                            const panelMiddle = inLeftPanel ? Math.floor(-hw / 2) : Math.ceil(hw / 2);
                            const isWindow = (a === panelMiddle) && (j >= 1);
                            
                            if (!isWindow) {
                                if (isXAxis) {
                                    addVoxel(centerI + a, floorJ + j, centerK + pos, wallColor);
                                } else {
                                    addVoxel(centerI + pos, floorJ + j, centerK + a, wallColor);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                buildWall('x', -hw, hw, currentFloorJ, wallColor); // Front
                buildWall('x', hw, hw, currentFloorJ, wallColor);  // Back
                buildWall('z', -hw, hw, currentFloorJ, wallColor); // Left
                buildWall('z', hw, hw, currentFloorJ, wallColor);  // Right

                // Interior light
                const lightJ = currentFloorJ + Math.floor(wallHeight / 2);
                const light = new THREE.PointLight(0xffe0b0, 0.8, currentWallWidth + 4);
                light.position.set(centerI + 0.5, lightJ + 0.5, centerK + 0.5);
                pointLights.push(light);

                // Build roof
                const roofStartJ = currentFloorJ + wallHeight;
                for (let r = 0; r < roofLayers; r++) {
                    const rhw = hw + roofOverhang - r;
                    const j = roofStartJ + r;

                    for (let i = -rhw; i <= rhw; i++) {
                        for (let k = -rhw; k <= rhw; k++) {
                            if (r === roofLayers - 1) {
                                const isPerimeter = i === -rhw || i === rhw || k === -rhw || k === rhw;
                                addVoxel(centerI + i, j, centerK + k, isPerimeter ? goldColor : roofColor);
                            } else {
                                addVoxel(centerI + i, j, centerK + k, roofColor);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Upturned corners for first 2 layers
                    if (r < 2) {
                        const cornerSize = 2;
                        const corners = [
                            [-rhw, -rhw], [rhw - cornerSize + 1, -rhw],
                            [-rhw, rhw - cornerSize + 1], [rhw - cornerSize + 1, rhw - cornerSize + 1]
                        ];
                        
                        for (const [ci, ck] of corners) {
                            for (let di = 0; di < cornerSize; di++) {
                                for (let dk = 0; dk < cornerSize; dk++) {
                                    addVoxel(centerI + ci + di, j + 1, centerK + ck + dk, roofColor);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Eave gold trim
                const eaveHw = hw + roofOverhang;
                for (let i = -eaveHw; i <= eaveHw; i++) {
                    addVoxel(centerI + i, roofStartJ, centerK + (-eaveHw), goldColor);
                    addVoxel(centerI + i, roofStartJ, centerK + eaveHw, goldColor);
                }
                for (let k = -eaveHw + 1; k < eaveHw; k++) {
                    addVoxel(centerI + (-eaveHw), roofStartJ, centerK + k, goldColor);
                    addVoxel(centerI + eaveHw, roofStartJ, centerK + k, goldColor);
                }

                currentWallWidth -= 2;
                currentFloorJ = roofStartJ + roofLayers - 1;
            }

            // Spire
            const spireBaseJ = currentFloorJ + 1;
            for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
                for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) {
                    addVoxel(centerI + i, spireBaseJ, centerK + k, roofColor);
                }
            }
            
            // Gold shaft
            for (let j = 1; j <= 7; j++) {
                addVoxel(centerI, spireBaseJ + j, centerK, goldColor);
            }

            // Golden orb (voxel sphere)
            const orbRadius = 2;
            const orbCenterJ = spireBaseJ + 7 + orbRadius;
            for (let di = -orbRadius; di <= orbRadius; di++) {
                for (let dj = -orbRadius; dj <= orbRadius; dj++) {
                    for (let dk = -orbRadius; dk <= orbRadius; dk++) {
                        const dist = Math.sqrt(di*di + dj*dj + dk*dk);
                        if (dist <= orbRadius + 0.3) {
                            addVoxel(centerI + di, orbCenterJ + dj, centerK + dk, goldColor);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Top spike
            addVoxel(centerI, orbCenterJ + orbRadius + 1, centerK, goldColor);

            return pointLights;
        }

        const pagodaLights = buildPagoda(0, 0, 5, 15);
        pagodaLights.forEach(light => scene.add(light));

        // -------------------- TREES --------------------
        // Cherry blossom tree
        function buildCherryTree(i, k, trunkHeight = 10, canopyRadius = 6) {
            const trunkColor = 0x6d4c41;
            const canopyColors = [0xffb6c1, 0xffc0cb, 0xff69b4, 0xffffff, 0xf8bbd0];

            // Tapered trunk
            for (let j = 1; j <= trunkHeight; j++) {
                const radius = Math.max(0.5, 2 - (j / trunkHeight) * 1.5);
                for (let di = -Math.ceil(radius); di <= Math.ceil(radius); di++) {
                    for (let dk = -Math.ceil(radius); dk <= Math.ceil(radius); dk++) {
                        if (Math.sqrt(di*di + dk*dk) <= radius) {
                            addVoxel(i + di, j, k + dk, trunkColor);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Irregular canopy (multiple clumps)
            const canopyCenterJ = trunkHeight + Math.floor(canopyRadius * 0.6);
            const clumps = [
                { di: 0, dj: 0, dk: 0, r: canopyRadius },
                { di: -2, dj: 1, dk: -1, r: canopyRadius * 0.7 },
                { di: 3, dj: -1, dk: 2, r: canopyRadius * 0.8 },
                { di: 1, dj: 2, dk: -3, r: canopyRadius * 0.6 },
                { di: -3, dj: -1, dk: 2, r: canopyRadius * 0.7 },
            ];

            for (const clump of clumps) {
                const r = clump.r;
                for (let di = -Math.ceil(r); di <= Math.ceil(r); di++) {
                    for (let dj = -Math.ceil(r); dj <= Math.ceil(r); dj++) {
                        for (let dk = -Math.ceil(r); dk <= Math.ceil(r); dk++) {
                            if (Math.sqrt(di*di + dj*dj + dk*dk) <= r + 0.2) {
                                const color = canopyColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * canopyColors.length)];
                                const ci = i + clump.di + di;
                                const cj = canopyCenterJ + clump.dj + dj;
                                const ck = k + clump.dk + dk;
                                if (cj <= trunkHeight && Math.abs(ci - i) < 2 && Math.abs(ck - k) < 2) continue;
                                addVoxel(ci, cj, ck, color);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Fallen petals on ground
            for (let p = 0; p < 30; p++) {
                const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const dist = Math.random() * canopyRadius * 1.5;
                const pi = Math.round(i + Math.cos(angle) * dist);
                const pk = Math.round(k + Math.sin(angle) * dist);
                const gi = pi + HALF_GROUND;
                const gk = pk + HALF_GROUND;
                if (gi >=0 && gi < GROUND_SIZE && gk >=0 && gk < GROUND_SIZE && groundGrid[gi][gk] === 0) {
                    const color = canopyColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * canopyColors.length)];
                    addVoxel(pi, 1, pk, color);
                }
            }
        }

        // Pine tree
        function buildPineTree(i, k, height = 12) {
            const trunkColor = 0x5d4037;
            const foliageColor = 0x2e7d32;
            const trunkHeight = Math.floor(height * 0.3);

            // Trunk
            for (let j = 1; j <= trunkHeight; j++) {
                addVoxel(i, j, k, trunkColor);
            }

            // Conical foliage
            for (let layer = 0; layer < height - trunkHeight; layer++) {
                const j = trunkHeight + 1 + layer;
                const radius = Math.max(0, (height - trunkHeight - layer) * 0.8);
                for (let di = -Math.ceil(radius); di <= Math.ceil(radius); di++) {
                    for (let dk = -Math.ceil(radius); dk <= Math.ceil(radius); dk++) {
                        if (Math.sqrt(di*di + dk*dk) <= radius) {
                            addVoxel(i + di, j, k + dk, foliageColor);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Maple tree
        function buildMapleTree(i, k, trunkHeight = 8, canopyRadius = 5) {
            const trunkColor = 0x5d4037;
            const foliageColors = [0xff5722, 0xff7043, 0xff8a65, 0xf4511e];

            // Trunk
            for (let j = 1; j <= trunkHeight; j++) {
                const radius = Math.max(0.5, 1.5 - (j / trunkHeight));
                for (let di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
                    for (let dk = -1; dk <= 1; dk++) {
                        if (Math.sqrt(di*di + dk*dk) <= radius) {
                            addVoxel(i + di, j, k + dk, trunkColor);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Canopy
            const canopyCenterJ = trunkHeight + Math.floor(canopyRadius * 0.5);
            for (let di = -canopyRadius; di <= canopyRadius; di++) {
                for (let dj = -canopyRadius; dj <= canopyRadius; dj++) {
                    for (let dk = -canopyRadius; dk <= canopyRadius; dk++) {
                        const dist = Math.sqrt(di*di + dj*dj + dk*dk);
                        if (dist <= canopyRadius + 0.3 && Math.random() > 0.15) {
                            const color = foliageColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * foliageColors.length)];
                            const cj = canopyCenterJ + dj;
                            if (cj <= trunkHeight && Math.abs(di) < 2 && Math.abs(dk) < 2) continue;
                            addVoxel(i + di, cj, k + dk, color);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // -------------------- GARDEN DETAILS --------------------
        // Stone lantern
        function buildStoneLantern(i, k) {
            const grey = 0x757575;
            const red = 0xb71c1c;
            const gold = 0xffd700;

            // Base
            for (let di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
                for (let dk = -1; dk <= 1; dk++) {
                    addVoxel(i + di, 1, k + dk, grey);
                    addVoxel(i + di, 2, k + dk, grey);
                }
            }

            // Pillar
            addVoxel(i, 3, k, grey);
            addVoxel(i, 4, k, grey);

            // Lantern house (hollow with windows)
            for (let di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
                for (let dk = -1; dk <= 1; dk++) {
                    for (let dj = 0; dj < 3; dj++) {
                        const j = 5 + dj;
                        const isWall = di === -1 || di === 1 || dk === -1 || dk === 1 || dj === 0 || dj === 2;
                        if (isWall) {
                            const isFrontWindow = dk === -1 && di === 0 && dj === 1;
                            const isBackWindow = dk === 1 && di === 0 && dj === 1;
                            const isLeftWindow = di === -1 && dk === 0 && dj === 1;
                            const isRightWindow = di === 1 && dk === 0 && dj === 1;
                            if (!isFrontWindow && !isBackWindow && !isLeftWindow && !isRightWindow) {
                                addVoxel(i + di, j, k + dk, red);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Roof
            for (let di = -2; di <= 2; di++) {
                for (let dk = -2; dk <= 2; dk++) {
                    addVoxel(i + di, 8, k + dk, grey);
                }
            }
            for (let di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
                for (let dk = -1; dk <= 1; dk++) {
                    addVoxel(i + di, 9, k + dk, grey);
                }
            }
            addVoxel(i, 10, k, gold);

            // Interior light
            const light = new THREE.PointLight(0xffaa55, 0.7, 8);
            light.position.set(i + 0.5, 6.5, k + 0.5);
            scene.add(light);
        }

        buildStoneLantern(-5, -10);

        // Bamboo cluster
        function buildBambooCluster(centerI, centerK, count = 6) {

            for (let s = 0; s < count; s++) {
                const di = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5) - 2;

                const height = 8 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 7);
                const i = centerI + di;

                // Stalk
                for (let j = 1; j <= height; j++) {
                    addVoxel(i, j, k, green);
                }

                // Leaves
                for (let l = 0; l < 6; l++) {
                    const li = i + (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : 0);
                    const lk = k + (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : 0);
                    const lj = height - Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
                    if (li !== i || lk !== k) {

                    }
                }

        // Wooden bench
        function buildBench(i, k, length = 4, facing = 'north') {
            const wood = 0x8d6e63;
            const darkWood = 0x6d4c41;

            const axis = facing === 'north' || facing === 'south' ? 'i' : 'k';
            const backDir = facing === 'north' ? 1 : facing === 'south' ? -1 : facing === 'east' ? 1 : -1;

            // Seat
            for (let l = 0; l < length; l++) {
                const li = axis === 'i' ? i + l : i;
                const lk = axis === 'k' ? k + l : k;
                addVoxel(li, 2, lk, wood);
                
                if (l === 0 || l === length - 1) {
                    addVoxel(li, 1, lk, darkWood);
                    if (axis === 'i') {
                        addVoxel(li, 1, lk + backDir, darkWood);
                    } else {
                        addVoxel(li + backDir, 1, lk, darkWood);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Backrest
            for (let l = 0; l < length; l++) {
                const li = axis === 'i' ? i + l : i;
                const lk = axis === 'k' ? k + l : k;
                const bli = axis === 'i' ? li : li + backDir;
                const blk = axis === 'k' ? lk : lk + backDir;
                addVoxel(bli, 3, blk, wood);
                addVoxel(bli, 4, blk, wood);
            }
        }

        // Koi fish
        const koi = [];
        function buildKoi(x, z, color) {

            const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: color });
            const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            mesh.position.set(x, 0.3, z);

            return {

        // -------------------- FALLING CHERRY PETALS --------------------
        const petalCount = 300;
        const petalGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.25, 0.05, 0.25);
        const petalMaterials = [
            new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffb6c1 }),
            new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff }),
            new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffc0cb }),
        ];

        const petalMeshes = petalMaterials.map(mat => new THREE.InstancedMesh(petalGeometry, mat, Math.floor(petalCount / 3)));
        petalMeshes.forEach(mesh => {
            mesh.castShadow = false;
