        const cherryTreePositions = [
            { x: -20, z: -15, radius: 7, height: 11 },
            { x: 25, z: -10, radius: 6, height: 9 },
            { x: -10, z: 25, radius: 7, height: 12 },
        ];

        const petalData = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < petalCount; i++) {
            const tree = cherryTreePositions[Math.floor(Math.random() * cherryTreePositions.length)];
            const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
            const dist = Math.random() * tree.radius * 1.5;
            petalData.push({
                x: tree.x + Math.cos(angle) * dist,
                y: tree.height + Math.random() * 8,
                z: tree.z + Math.sin(angle) * dist,
                vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05,
                vy: -0.02 - Math.random() * 0.03,
                vz: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05,
                rotY: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
                rotSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05,
                type: Math.floor(Math.random() * 3),
            });
        }

        function updatePetals(delta) {
            const dummy = new THREE.Object3D();
            const counts = [0, 0, 0];

            for (const petal of petalData) {
                petal.x += petal.vx * delta * 60;
                petal.y += petal.vy * delta * 60;
                petal.z += petal.vz * delta * 60;
                petal.rotY += petal.rotSpeed * delta * 60;

                if (petal.y < 1) {
                    const tree = cherryTreePositions[Math.floor(Math.random() * cherryTreePositions.length)];
                    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                    const dist = Math.random() * tree.radius * 1.5;
                    petal.x = tree.x + Math.cos(angle) * dist;
                    petal.y = tree.height + Math.random() * 8;
                    petal.z = tree.z + Math.sin(angle) * dist;
                }

                petal.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.002;
                petal.vz += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.002;

                const idx = counts[petal.type];
                dummy.position.set(petal.x, petal.y, petal.z);
                dummy.rotation.y = petal.rotY;
                dummy.rotation.x = Math.sin(petal.rotY * 2) * 0.3;
                dummy.updateMatrix();
                petalMeshes[petal.type].setMatrixAt(idx, dummy.matrix);
                counts[petal.type]++;
            }

            petalMeshes.forEach(mesh => mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true);
        }

        // -------------------- CLOUDS --------------------
        const clouds = [];
        function createCloud(x, y, z, scale = 1) {
            const group = new THREE.Group();
            const cloudColors = [0xffffff, 0xf5f5f5, 0xeeeeee];
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);

            const clumps = [
                { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, r: 3 },
                { x: 2, y: 0.5, z: 1, r: 2.5 },
                { x: -2, y: -0.5, z: -1, r: 2 },
                { x: 1, y: 1, z: -2, r: 2.2 },
                { x: -1.5, y: 0.5, z: 1.5, r: 2.3 },
            ];

            const colorMap = {};
            for (const clump of clumps) {
                const r = clump.r * scale;
                for (let di = -Math.ceil(r); di <= Math.ceil(r); di++) {
                    for (let dj = -Math.ceil(r); dj <= Math.ceil(r); dj++) {
                        for (let dk = -Math.ceil(r); dk <= Math.ceil(r); dk++) {
                            if (Math.sqrt(di*di + dj*dj + dk*dk) <= r + 0.3 && Math.random() > 0.2) {
                                const color = cloudColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * cloudColors.length)];
                                const key = color.toString(16);
                                if (!colorMap[key]) colorMap[key] = [];
                                colorMap[key].push([clump.x + di, clump.y + dj, clump.z + dk]);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            const dummy = new THREE.Object3D();
            for (const colorKey in colorMap) {
                const positions = colorMap[colorKey];
                const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                    color: parseInt(colorKey, 16),
                    transparent: true,
                    opacity: 0.9,
                    roughness: 1,
                });
                const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geometry, material, positions.length);
                for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i++) {
                    dummy.position.set(positions[i][0], positions[i][1], positions[i][2]);
                    dummy.updateMatrix();
                    mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);
                }
                mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
                group.add(mesh);
            }

            group.position.set(x, y, z);
            group.speed = 0.01 + Math.random() * 0.02;
            scene.add(group);
            return group;
        }

        clouds.push(createCloud(-30, 55, -40, 1.2));
        clouds.push(createCloud(20, 60, -30, 1));
        clouds.push(createCloud(40, 50, 20, 1.5));
        clouds.push(createCloud(-40, 65, 20, 0.8));
        clouds.push(createCloud(0, 70, -50, 1.3));

        function updateClouds(delta) {
            for (const cloud of clouds) {
                cloud.position.x += cloud.speed * delta * 60;
                if (cloud.position.x > 80) {
                    cloud.position.x = -80;
                    cloud.position.z = Math.random() * 100 - 50;
                }
            }
        }

        // -------------------- ANIMATION LOOP --------------------
        const clock = new THREE.Clock();

        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            const delta = clock.getDelta();

            controls.update();
            updatePetals(delta);
            updateClouds(delta);

            // Animate koi
            for (const fish of koi) {
                fish.mesh.rotation.y += fish.turnSpeed * delta * 60;
                const speed = fish.speed * delta * 60;
                fish.mesh.position.x += Math.sin(fish.mesh.rotation.y) * speed;
                fish.mesh.position.z += Math.cos(fish.mesh.rotation.y) * speed;

                const dx = fish.mesh.position.x - 15;
                const dz = fish.mesh.position.z - 8;
                if (Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz) > 7) {
                    fish.turnSpeed += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05;
                }
                if (Math.random() < 0.01) {
                    fish.turnSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.03;
                }
            }

            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });

        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
  <style>
    body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #e0f7ff; }
    canvas { display: block; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.159.0/build/three.module.js';

    // Scene setup
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xe0f7ff);
    
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    camera.position.set(0, 8, 25);
    camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
    
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
    
    // Voxel material palette (colors as RGB)
    const voxelColors = [
      // Ground (soft green)
      new THREE.Color(0x8fd8b3),
      // Pagoda roof layers (gradient pink-to-purple)
      new THREE.Color(0xff99cc), new THREE.Color(0xdd66cc), new THREE.Color(0xbb55aa),
      // Pagoda walls (terracotta)
      new THREE.Color(0xff9933),
      // Tree trunks (brown)
      new THREE.Color(0x8b5a2b),
      // Tree leaves (deep green)
      new THREE.Color(0x2e8b57),
      // Cherry blossoms (soft pink + white)
      new THREE.Color(0xffd1dc), new THREE.Color(0xfff5f8),
      // Pond/water (light blue)
      new THREE.Color(0x99ccff),
      // Path stones (gray with highlight)
      new THREE.Color(0x7a7a7a), new THREE.Color(0xe0e0e0),
      // Sky highlight (very light blue)
      new THREE.Color(0xcfe8ff)
    ];
    
    // Simple voxel "block" function
    function createVoxel(position, colorIndex) {
      const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
      const material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: voxelColors[colorIndex], vertexColors: true });
      const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      voxel.position.set(position.x, position.y, position.z);
      scene.add(voxel);
      return voxel;
    }
    
    // Build pagoda (central structure)
    const pagodaBase = [];
    // Base platform
    for (let x = -2; x <= 2; x++) {
      for (let z = -2; z <= 2; z++) {
        pagodaBase.push(createVoxel({ x, y: 1, z }, 1)); // Ground color
      }
    }
    // Walls
    for (let y = 2; y <= 4; y++) {
      for (let x = -2; x <= 2; x++) {
        pagodaBase.push(createVoxel({ x, y, -2 }, 3)); // Left wall
        pagodaBase.push(createVoxel({ x, y, 2 }, 3));  // Right wall
      }
    }
    // Roofs (tiered)
    for (let y = 5; y <= 7; y++) {
      for (let x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
        for (let z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {
          pagodaBase.push(createVoxel({ x, y, z }, 0)); // Top roof layer (pink)
        }
      }
      for (let x = -2; x <= 2; x++) {
        for (let z = -2; z <= 2; z++) {
          pagodaBase.push(createVoxel({ x, y + 0.5, z }, 1)); // Middle roof layer
        }
      }
      for (let x = -3; x <= 3; x++) {
        for (let z = -3; z <= 3; z++) {
          pagodaBase.push(createVoxel({ x, y + 1, z }, 2)); // Base roof layer (purple)
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Build garden
    const garden = [];
    
    // Ground with path
    for (let x = -8; x <= 8; x++) {
      for (let z = -8; z <= 8; z++) {
        if (Math.abs(x) <= 2 && Math.abs(z) <= 2 && (x % 2 === 0 || z % 2 === 0)) {
          // Path stones
          if ((x + z) % 4 === 0) garden.push(createVoxel({ x, 0, z }, 6)); // Dark gray
          else garden.push(createVoxel({ x, 0, z }, 7)); // Light gray highlight
        } else {
          garden.push(createVoxel({ x, 0, z }, 0)); // Ground color
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Cherry blossom tree (simple canopy)
    const cherryTree = [];
    // Trunk
    for (let y = 0; y < 4; y++) {
      cherryTree.push(createVoxel({ 0, y, 0 }, 4)); // Brown trunk
    }
    // Blossom layer (spread)
    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
      for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
        for (let dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) {
          if (dx*dx + dz*dz <= 4) {
            cherryTree.push(createVoxel({ dx, 3 + dy, dz }, 6)); // Pink blossom
          }
        }
      }
    }
    // Leaf layer
    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
      for (let dx = -3; dx <= 3; dx++) {
        for (let dz = -3; dz <= 3; dz++) {
          if (dx*dx + dz*dz <= 9) {
            cherryTree.push(createVoxel({ dx, 4 + dy, dz }, 2)); // Green leaves
          }
        }
      }
    }
    garden.push(...cherryTree);
    
    // Second tree with pond nearby
    const pineTree = [];
    // Trunk
    for (let y = 0; y < 5; y++) {
      pineTree.push(createVoxel({ -3, y, 3 }, 4)); // Brown
    }
    // Leaves (sparse)
    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
      for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
        for (let dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) {
          if (dx*dx + dz*dz <= 4) {
            pineTree.push(createVoxel({ dx, 3 + dy, dz }, 2)); // Green
          }
        }
      }
    }
    garden.push(...pineTree);
    
    // Small pond (flat water surface)
    for (let x = -3; x <= 3; x++) {
      for (let z = -3; z <= 3; z++) {
        if (x >= -2 && x <= 2 && z >= -2 && z <= 2) {
          garden.push(createVoxel({ x, 0, z }, 7)); // Water color
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Add all garden voxels
    scene.add(...garden);
    scene.add(...pagodaBase);
    
    // Lighting
    const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
    dirLight.position.set(5, 10, 5);
    scene.add(dirLight);
    dirLight.castShadow = true;
    
    const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404060, 0.5);
    scene.add(ambientLight);
    
    // Animation loop (simple blossom drift)
    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      
      // Slight upward drift for cherry blossoms
      cherryTree.forEach(voxel => {
        if (voxel.userData.colorIndex === 6) { // Blossom color
          voxel.position.y += 0.001;
        }
      });
      
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }
    
    animate();
    
    // Handle window resize
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      const aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.aspect = aspect;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB);
        
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(30, 25, 40);
        
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
        
        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        
        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        directionalLight.position.set(10, 20, 15);
        directionalLight.castShadow = true;
        directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 1024;
        directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 1024;
        scene.add(directionalLight);
        
        // Voxel geometry
        const voxelGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
        
        // Materials
        const materials = {
            wood: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x8B4513 }),
            roof: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x8B0000 }),
            gold: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xFFD700 }),
            green: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x228B22 }),
            darkGreen: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x006400 }),
            pink: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xFFC0CB }),
            white: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xFFFFFF }),
            gray: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x808080 })
        };
        
        // Helper function to create a voxel
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, material) {
            const voxel = new THREE.Mesh(voxelGeometry, material);
            voxel.position.set(x, y, z);
            voxel.castShadow = true;
            voxel.receiveShadow = true;
            scene.add(voxel);
            return voxel;
        }
        
        // Ground
        for (let x = -50; x <= 50; x++) {
            for (let z = -50; z <= 50; z++) {
                createVoxel(x, -1, z, materials.green);
            }
        }
        
        // Pagoda structure
        function createPagoda() {
            // Base level (largest)
            for (let x = -4; x <= 4; x++) {
                for (let z = -4; z <= 4; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x) === 4 || Math.abs(z) === 4 || 
                        (Math.abs(x) === 3 && Math.abs(z) === 3)) {
                        createVoxel(x, 0, z, materials.wood);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Second level
            for (let x = -3; x <= 3; x++) {
                for (let z = -3; z <= 3; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x) === 3 || Math.abs(z) === 3) {
                        createVoxel(x, 3, z, materials.wood);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Third level (smallest)
            for (let x = -2; x <= 2; x++) {
                for (let z = -2; z <= 2; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x) === 2 || Math.abs(z) === 2) {
                        createVoxel(x, 6, z, materials.wood);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Roof layers
            // First roof
            for (let x = -5; x <= 5; x++) {
                for (let z = -5; z <= 5; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x) + Math.abs(z) <= 5) {
                        createVoxel(x, 1, z, materials.roof);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Second roof
            for (let x = -4; x <= 4; x++) {
                for (let z = -4; z <= 4; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x) + Math.abs(z) <= 4) {
                        createVoxel(x, 4, z, materials.roof);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Third roof
            for (let x = -3; x <= 3; x++) {
                for (let z = -3; z <= 3; z++) {
                    if (Math.abs(x) + Math.abs(z) <= 3) {
                        createVoxel(x, 7, z, materials.roof);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Roof edges (golden)
            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                const angle = (i * Math.PI / 2);
                const x = Math.cos(angle) * 6;
                const z = Math.sin(angle) * 6;
                createVoxel(x, 2, z, materials.gold);
                
                const x2 = Math.cos(angle) * 5;
                const z2 = Math.sin(angle) * 5;
                createVoxel(x2, 5, z2, materials.gold);
                
                const x3 = Math.cos(angle) * 4;
                const z3 = Math.sin(angle) * 4;
                createVoxel(x3, 8, z3, materials.gold);
            }
            
            // Pagoda details
            // Vertical supports
            for (let y = 1; y < 3; y++) {
                createVoxel(-4, y, -4, materials.wood);
                createVoxel(4, y, -4, materials.wood);
                createVoxel(-4, y, 4, materials.wood);
                createVoxel(4, y, 4, materials.wood);
            }
            
            for (let y = 4; y < 6; y++) {
                createVoxel(-3, y, -3, materials.wood);
                createVoxel(3, y, -3, materials.wood);
                createVoxel(-3, y, 3, materials.wood);
                createVoxel(3, y, 3, materials.wood);
            }
            
            // Lantern at top
            for (let x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
                for (let z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {
                    createVoxel(x, 10, z, materials.gold);
                }
            }
            createVoxel(0, 11, 0, materials.gold);
        }
        
        createPagoda();
        
        // Cherry trees
        function createCherryTree(x, z) {
            // Trunk
            for (let y = 0; y < 5; y++) {
                createVoxel(x, y, z, materials.brown);
            }
            
            // Leaves with cherry blossoms
            const leafLayers = [
                { y: 5, size: 3, density: 0.7 },
                { y: 6, size: 4, density: 0.8 },
                { y: 7, size: 3, density: 0.6 },
                { y: 8, size: 2, density: 0.5 }
            ];
            
            for (const layer of leafLayers) {
                for (let dx = -layer.size; dx <= layer.size; dx++) {
                    for (let dz = -layer.size; dz <= layer.size; dz++) {
                        if (Math.random() < layer.density) {
                            const distance = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz);
                            if (distance <= layer.size) {
                                // Alternate between green leaves and pink blossoms
                                if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
                                    createVoxel(x + dx, layer.y, z + dz, materials.pink);
                                } else {
                                    createVoxel(x + dx, layer.y, z + dz, materials.green);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Create multiple cherry trees around the pagoda
        createCherryTree(-15, -10);
        createCherryTree(15, -10);
        createCherryTree(-15, 15);
        createCherryTree(15, 15);
        createCherryTree(0, -20);
        createCherryTree(0, 20);
        
        // Additional decorative elements
        // Stone lanterns
        function createStoneLantern(x, z) {
            // Base
            for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
                    createVoxel(x + dx, 0, z + dz, materials.gray);
                }
            }
            
            // Pillar
            for (let y = 1; y <= 4; y++) {
                createVoxel(x, y, z, materials.gray);
            }
            
            // Top platform
            for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
                    createVoxel(x + dx, 5, z + dz, materials.gray);
                }
            }
            
            // Light
            createVoxel(x, 6, z, materials.gold);
        }
        
        createStoneLantern(-10, 0);
        createStoneLantern(10, 0);
        createStoneLantern(0, 10);
        createStoneLantern(0, -5);
        
        // Pathway stones
        for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            createVoxel(-10 + i*2, 0, 0, materials.gray);
        }
        
        // Falling cherry blossoms (particles)
        const blossomGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.3, 6, 6);
        const blossomMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xFFC0CB });
        const blossoms = [];
        
        for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            const blossom = new THREE.Mesh(blossomGeometry, blossomMaterial);
            blossom.position.set(
                (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60,
                Math.random() * 20 + 5,
                (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60
            );
            blossom.userData = {
                speed: 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.2,
                rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
            };
            scene.add(blossom);
            blossoms.push(blossom);
        }
        
        // Animation
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            
            // Rotate camera around the scene
            camera.position.x = 30 * Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.0005);
            camera.position.z = 30 * Math.cos(Date.now() * 0.0005);
            camera.lookAt(0, 5, 0);
            
            // Animate falling blossoms
            for (const blossom of blossoms) {
                blossom.position.y -= blossom.userData.speed;
                blossom.rotation.y += 0.01;
                
                if (blossom.position.y < -1) {
                    blossom.position.y = 25;
                    blossom.position.x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60;
                    blossom.position.z = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60;
                }
            }
            
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        
        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
        
        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Voxel Pagoda Garden</title>
<style>
  body { margin:0; overflow:hidden; background:#87ceeb; }
  canvas { display:block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.166.0/build/three.module.js';
import { OrbitControls } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.166.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';

let scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87ceeb); // sky blue

let camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
camera.position.set(0, 20, 40);

let renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias:true });
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

let controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.enableDamping = true;

// ----- voxel creator -----
function createBox(x, y, z, color) {
  const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
  const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color});
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
  scene.add(mesh);
}

// ----- ground (voxel plane) -----
function createGround() {
  const size = 20; // half-extent
  const y = 0;
  for (let x = -size; x <= size; x++) {
    for (let z = -size; z <= size; z++) {
      createBox(x, y, z, new THREE.Color(0x228B22)); // forest‑green
    }
  }
}

// ----- pagoda (stacked square tiers) -----
function createPagoda(levels, baseSize, startY) {
  let y = startY;
  for (let i = 0; i < levels; i++) {
    const size = baseSize - i * 2; // each tier shrinks by 2 units
    const half = size / 2;
    for (let x = -half; x <= half; x++) {
      for (let z = -half; z <= half; z++) {
        // Different colors per tier for visual variety
        const tierColor = new THREE.Color(0x8B4513 + (i * 0x100000)); // brown → orange → yellow
        createBox(x, y, z, tierColor);
      }
    }
    y += 1; // go up one unit for next tier
  }
  // small roof pyramid on top
  const roofSize = baseSize - levels * 2;
  const roofY = y;
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const size = roofSize - i * 2;
    const half = size / 2;
    for (let x = -half; x <= half; x++) {
      for (let z = -half; z <= half; z++) {
        const roofColor = new THREE.Color(0x4B2E2A - (i * 0x20000)); // dark brown → darker
        createBox(x, roofY + i, z, roofColor);
      }
    }
  }
}

// ----- trees -----
function createTree(pos, isCherry = false) {
  const [x, y, z] = pos;
  const trunkHeight = 5;
  const trunkWidth = 1;
  // trunk
  for (let i = 0; i < trunkHeight; i++) {
    createBox(x, y + i, z, new THREE.Color(0x8B4513)); // brown
  }
  // foliage
  const foliageSize = 4;
  const half = foliageSize / 2;
  const foliageColor = isCherry ? new THREE.Color(0xFFB6C1) : new THREE.Color(0x2E8B57); // pink or green
  for (let dx = -half; dx <= half; dx++) {
    for (let dz = -half; dz <= half; dz++) {
      createBox(x + dx, y + trunkHeight + 1, z + dz, foliageColor);
    }
  }
}

// ----- build scene -----
createGround();
createPagoda(5, 12, 1); // 5 levels, base size 12, start at y=1

// regular green trees
createTree([-8, 1, 0]);
createTree([8, 1, 0]);

// cherry blossom trees (pink)
createTree([-4, 1, -6], true);
createTree([4, 1, -6], true);
createTree([0, 1, -10], true);

// ----- lights -----
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6));
let dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
dirLight.position.set(5, 10, 7);
scene.add(dirLight);

// ----- animation loop -----
function animate() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  controls.update();
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
animate();

// ----- responsive resize -----
window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
  camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

question: voxel-art-pagoda-garden
prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Output only a single-page self-contained page, you can use ThreeJS.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>Voxel Pagoda Garden Scene</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.126.1/build/three.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Basic Scene Setup
        let scene = new THREE.Scene();
        let camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        let renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Orbit Controls
        let controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        camera.position.set(50, 50, 50);
        controls.update();

        // Lighting
        let ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        let directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
        directionalLight.position.set(1, 1, 1);
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Voxel Art Helper Function
        function createVoxel(x, y, z, color) {
            let geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
            let material = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color: color});
            let voxel = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            voxel.position.set(x, y, z);
            scene.add(voxel);
        }

        // Pagoda
        for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            createVoxel(0, i, 0, 0x8B4513); // Central pillar
        }

        // Creating the roof
        for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
            for (let j = -2; j <= 2; j++) {
                if (Math.abs(i) + Math.abs(j) < 3) {
                    createVoxel(i, 10, j, 0x800000); // Roof color
                }
            }
        }

        // Trees and Blossoms
        function addTree(x, z, blossomColor) {
            let trunkHeight = 5;
            for (let y = 0; y < trunkHeight; y++) {
                createVoxel(x, y, z, 0x8B4513); // Trunk
            }
            for (let i = -3; i <= 3; i++) {
                for (let j = -3; j <= 3; j++) {
                    for (let k = -3; k <= 3; k++) {
                        if (Math.sqrt(i*i + j*j + k*k) < 4) {
                            createVoxel(x+i, trunkHeight+j, z+k, blossomColor);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Example Trees
        addTree(-10, -10, 0xFF69B4); // Cherry Blossoms
        addTree(10, 10, 0x228B22); // Green Tree

        // Render Loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            controls.update();
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
